Turn heat to low and cook about 30 to 45 minutes.
Coat chicken with flour, salt and pepper.
Heat
oil in large skillet and stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes.
Push chicken aside and add green pepper, onions and garlic.
Saute until onions are soft, stirring frequently.
Cream butter and sugar until fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time and beat after each addition.
Add lemon rind, juice and vanilla. Mix well.
Mix 1/4 cup flour with nuts and cherries.
Sift the remaining flour with baking powder and salt.
Add to creamed mixture.
Fold in nuts and cherries.
Pour into greased tube pan. Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 50 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool completely.
Freezes well.
Place lettuce leaf on salad plate; top with banana.
Cut 1/4-inch V-shaped slices halfway through the banana, spacing about 1-inch apart.
Place an apple slice, peel side up, in each cut. For eyes, gently press raisins into one end of banana.
Serve immediately.
Dredge roast in flour, garlic powder, salt and pepper, then brown on all sides in large skillet in hot olive oil.
(You can skip browning, but it adds flavor and helps thicken.) Combine remaining ingredients in crock-pot.
Add browned roast, turning to coat with liquids.
Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.
Serves 6 to 8.
Preheat oven to 450°.
Place 3 tablespoons of vegetable oil in an 8 or 9-inch cast-iron skillet and preheat skillet while preparing ingredients.
Crack eggs into large mixing bowl and beat slightly; add buttermilk, 1/4 cup vegetable oil and salsa and mix well by hand.
Add dry ingredients and stir until smooth.
Pour into hot skillet and bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.
Serves 8.
Press rolls into lipped cookie sheet.
Melt margarine.
Slowly add brown sugar and vanilla; boil for 1 minute.
Pour over dough. Top with pecans.
Bake at 375° for 14 to 18 minutes.
Sprinkle with chocolate chips.
Swirl cool.
Cut into bars.
Drain beets and save 1 cup of juice.
Bring sugar, vinegar and spices if used, to a boil.
Cut up beets and add to liquid, bring to a boil again.
Remove from heat.
Store in refrigertor.
Can be eaten after one day.
Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot water.
Save juice from drained pineapple.
If, when ready to use the juice, it doesn't quite come to a full cup, add a little water to make up the difference. While Jell-O is cooling, mix remaining ingredients thoroughly.
Add to Jell-O mix; pour into mold.
Serves 10.
In skillet saute bacon and onion until golden brown; drain. Put into crock-pot with clams.
Add all remaining ingredients, except cream.
Cover; cook on HIGH 3 to 4 hours or until potatoes are tender.
During the last hour of cooking, combine 1 cup of milk with the cornstarch; add that and the remaining milk and blend thoroughly.
Heat through until chowder is thickened and bubbly, stirring frequently.
Combine first 5 ingredients in bowl and mix well.
Beat in eggs one at a time.
Add milk and mix well.
Stir in pecans and vanilla.
Mix well and pour in a 9-inch pie shell.
Cook in a 400° oven for 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and cook an additional 35 to 40 minutes or until filling is puffed in center and is well browned.
Let cool before cutting.
In shallow bowl, beat eggs, milk, sugar and cinnamon.
Dip bread in egg mixture, coating both sides.
In a skillet, cook bread on both sides in a small amount of butter, margarine or Pam over medium heat until golden brown.
Add more butter as needed. Serve with maple syrup. Makes 5 servings.
Mix cake mix, oil, eggs and juice of oranges well (3 to 4 minutes); add oranges and nuts.
Grease 2 (8-inch) round or 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Cool completely.
Take chicken and coat by sprinkling with cayenne pepper.
Make it red.
Then douse with hot sauce.
Refrigerate for hours.
Dip chicken in milk, then dredge in flour until coated.
Place coated pieces of chicken in medium-high heated oil.
Cook in oil at medium-high for 5 minutes on both sides until slightly crusty. Lower heat to medium and cook until golden brown which should take 20 to 30 minutes depending.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve warm.
Mix vanilla pudding and milk.
Stir in cinnamon, Cool Whip and well drained peach slices.
Crumble an oatmeal cookie in the bottom of 6 glasses and top with 1/4 cup pudding mixture.
Repeat layers, then cover and chill.
Garnish with peach slices and oatmeal cookie when ready to serve.
In skillet, brown beef; stir to separate meat.
Blend in soup and water.
Heat; stir now and then.
Serve in buns; top with cheese.
Makes 6 servings.
Boil or microwave chicken until cooked; drain.
Cube and set aside.
In bowl, mix sour cream, milk and soup.
Prepare stuffing mix according to directions on package.
Saute chopped onion until transparent, in oil.
Add eggplant and stir well.
Cover and simmer 10 minutes.
Add seasonings, raisins, sugar and the can of tomatoes with juice.
Simmer 5 to 10 minutes, then pour into a casserole dish and put into a 325° oven for about 1 hour to thicken and bring it all together. Meanwhile, put the rice on to cook.
Serve over the hot rice.
In Dutch oven, cook beef, onion, green pepper and celery until meat is brown and vegetables are tender.
Add chopped tomatoes, tomato paste and seasonings.
Cover; simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Add kidney beans the last 20 minutes.
Mix hamburger, milk, salt, cracker crumbs and onion.
Make into meatballs.
Put in 9 x 13 pan (shallow pan).
Mix together catsup, vinegar and brown sugar.
Pour over meatballs.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

Bring the chicken stock to a boil in a stockpot. Add the onions, 4 red peppers, tomatoes, garlic and carrots. Cook until the vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally. Season with the curry powder, salt and pepper. Pour into a blender container. Process until pured. Ladle into soup bowls. Top each serving with sliced roasted peppers.
Fry 4 slices bacon in large frypan until crisp.
Remove bacon and add onion and potatoes and fry for a short time. Add water to cover potatoes and lay fish on top of potatoes. Cook until fish turns white and solid (15 minutes).

recipes.t: Poulet Grille Farci Au Citron(Lemon Broiled Chicken)
d: Wipe the chicken carefully and split it in two; use a good sturdy knife, insert the point at the tip of the breast and press down firmly with both hands.
Quite easy really!
Rub both pieces well with salt and pepper and about 1 tablespoon of butter.
Place rather low under the preheated broiler and cook, basting frequently with a little butter and lemon juice, until it turns a beautiful golden color.
About 15 minutes should do it.
Blend together cream cheese, lemon juice and mayonnaise until smooth.
Fold in olives, then tuna, then pecans.
Cook bacon; drain and crumble.
Remove stems from mushrooms, chop finely and place in mixing bowl.
Add bacon, cheese, onion and parsley.
Mix well.
Fill mushroom caps, place on baking sheet and bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
In bowl, beat eggs until foamy.
Gradually beat in oil and sugar.
Add grated zucchini, cinnamon, salt, baking soda and baking powder, mixing well.
Gradually blend in flour, mixing well after each addition.
Fold in chopped nuts.
Pour into a greased Bundt pan and bake in moderate oven for 1 hour or until cake tests done and starts to leave sides of pan.
Cool in pan for 10 minutes on a rack.
Heat soup and juice from asparagus can to boiling.
Remove from heat.
Add gelatin and cream cheese; stir until dissolved. Add water and mayonnaise; beat or stir until blended.
Stir in remaining ingredients; turn into mold or Tupperware container. Garnish on bibb lettuce with white asparagus tips.
Cook noodles and drain.
Brown hot dogs and beef in butter. Add tomatoes, sauce mix, celery and onion.
Boil and turn to simmer for 10 minutes, stirring.
Add noodles.
Put in casserole. Top with cheese.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
Cut margarine into flour until mixture is crumbly.
Press into bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Cool.
Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar until smooth.
Fold in Cool Whip, reserving about 1/3 to smooth over cooled pastry. Combine pudding mix and add milk.
Beat until smooth and thickened.
Add lemon juice.
Spread over cream cheese mixture. Spread reserved Cool Whip over top.
Fry sausage and onions in skillet until meat is thoroughly cooked; drain.
Add chilies and tomatoes and cook uncovered for 15 minutes.
Add sour cream and cream cheese.
Simmer for 30 minutes, stirring often.
Keep warm when serving with chips.
In a well buttered 2-quart casserole pan, lay potatoes, onion and salt.
In a small saucepan, heat soup, milk and Worcestershire sauce.
Pour over potatoes.
Cover and cook at 375° for 45 minutes.
Crush enough cookies finely to cover bottom of square or oblong pan.
Cover cookies with soft ice cream carefully.
Freeze. Mix evaporated milk, butter or margarine, unsweetened chocolate and sugar.
Cook and stir until thick.
Cool thoroughly.
Pour over top of refrozen ice cream.
Freeze again until firm.
Cover hash browns with 1 quart of hot water and let stand 10 minutes; drain.
Beat eggs.
Add potatoes and remaining ingredients.
Pour into well-greased pie plate.
Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours.
Place cold pie plate (uncovered) in cold oven.
Turn heat to 350° and bake 35 minutes or until potatoes are tender and eggs are set.
Excellent idea for a brunch.
Bagels go very well with this dish.

Preheat oven to 350°. Beat egg whites, brown sugar, yogurt and vanilla until well blended. Gradually add the mixed dry ingredients until moistened. Pour into 8-inch square pan that has been sprayed with cooking spray and dusted with flour. Bake at 350° for about 35 minutes. Cool pan on rack for 20 minutes. Put on plate and dust with powdered sugar. Serves 6.
Cook macaroni using package directions; drain.
Saute onion in 1/4 cup margarine in skillet.
Add ground beef, salt and pepper. Cook until ground beef is brown and crumbly, stirring frequently; drain.
Layer macaroni, ground beef mixture and cheese in baking dish.
Combine soup and milk in bowl; mix well.
Pour over layers. Top with mixture of bread crumbs and 2 tablespoons margarine. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Yield:
8 servings.
Preheat oven to 450 degrees.
Lightly grease a cookie sheet. Mix together, bisquick, cheese, and water.
Drop in large spoonfuls onto cookie sheet.
Bake for 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, melt butter and combine with garlic and other seasonings.
Brush melted butter over hot biscuits.
Serve warm.
Beat egg.
Melt butter.
Add all remaining ingredients to egg and butter.
Mix well.
Pour into raw pie shell.
Bake 10 minutes at 450°.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake for additional 30 minutes.
Mix first four ingredients with mayonnaise.
Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Cool.
Add to tuna mixture and spread in 8 x 8 x 2 pyrex dish.
Refrigerate.
Butter bread slices & cut into small squares.
Sprinkle cheese over bread in a baking dish.
Mix milk, eggs, salt, pepper & mustard.
Pour over bread.
Bake until custard is set.
Serves 6.
In large pan, saute shallots and garlic in butter and oil. Add shrimp and cook until pink and then remove shrimp and set aside.
Add flour to pan with sauteed shallots and garlic and cook 1 to 2 minutes.
Add chicken broth, wine and parsley and cook until thickened.
Add heavy cream and continue to cook 4 to 5 minutes.
Simmer gently.
Add cooked shrimp to sauce and simmer gently until warmed and sauce is bubbling.
Serve over 1 pound cooked linguine.
Combine salmon, pepper, onion, flour and cheese; mix.
In separate bowl, beat eggs and milk.
Put salmon mixture in unbaked pie shell.
Pour egg and milk over the salmon mixture.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until you can insert knife and it comes out clean.
Let stand 10 minutes, then serve.
In a large skillet, heat oil and brown chicken; drain.
Add peas and carrots, Lipton soup mix and parsley; blend with water. Simmer, covered, for 45 minutes or until chicken is tender.
Serve with hot mashed potatoes, if desired.
Cook steak with mixture of flour, salt and pepper.
With wooden mallet, pound steak between wax paper until 1/2 inch thick. Cut in serving pieces.
Heat oil in a large skillet and add onion and garlic; saute until tender.
Add tomatoes and broth.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour.
Add potatoes; cover and simmer 45 minutes. Makes 4 servings.
In a soup pot or Dutch oven, brown vermicelli in hot oil.
Add onion and garlic.
Saute until onion is tender.
Add peas and carrots, tomatoes with their liquid, green chilies, chicken broth and mushrooms.
Cover and simmer 10 minutes.
Garnish each serving with parsley.
In an adequate cauldron containing 2 gallons of water, place salt, bay leaves, garlic clove and mustard.
Bring to a boil and add shrimp and maintain the boil until the shrimp float and are easily removed from the shell.
Drain and place in the refrigerator with a damp pad of paper towels until cold and ready to eat with your favorite cocktail sauce.
In a bowl combine butter, sugar, and cocoa.
Stir in eggs, milk, and vanilla.
Blend in flour, baking powder, and salt.
Stir in bananas and nuts.
Melt the butter in frying pan and add green pepper and onion. Cook until tender.
Stir in chicken and rice soup, tomato soup and beef stock.
Using the first four ingredients, make meatballs. After the meatballs are cooked, drop them into soup mixture. Serve over rice or noodles.
Whip egg whites very stiff.
Add 1/2 cup sugar and instant coffee.
Whip the cream and add 2 tablespoons sugar, dash of salt and vanilla.
Fold whipped cream into egg whites.
Add browned almond slivers.
Spoon into paper lined muffin cups.
Freeze. Take out of freezer shortly before serving
to slightly thaw. Serves 10.
Can be made well in advance.
Will keep in the freezer for up to two weeks.
Mix
chicken
with
salt,
pepper and 1/2 of the onion. Let it sit for 1 hour.
Measure and prepare all other ingredients.
Beat together cake mix, butterscotch pudding, vanilla pudding, water and eggs.
First, beat egg and milk until beaten.
Then pound pork chops about 1/8-inch thick.
Dip pork chop in egg mixture and then in cracker crumbs.
Place in fryer in medium hot oil until golden brown.
Chop shrimp.
Heat tomato soup and cream cheese in top of double boiler until cream cheese melts.
Cool slightly.
Stir in gelatin and mix well.
Add shrimp, mayonnaise, celery, pepper, onion, Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice.
Mix well.
Pour into well-greased 1 1/2-quart mold (use fish-shaped).
Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours.
Serve with crackers.
Makes about 50 appetizer servings.
Combine oleo and flour in saucepan.
Add milk and cook until thick.
Add cheese, salt, pepper, Ro-Tel, tuna and onion.
Heat and stir until cheese melts.
Serve over toast, rice or chips. Good served with English peas.
Melt the margarine in a saucepan.
Add the pumpkin, salt, syrup, spices and sugars.
Cook for about 10 minutes, stirring. Then stir in egg yolks.
Cook for about 15 minutes longer, stirring frequently.
Add pecans, raisins and cherries and place in pie crust.
Bake at 400° for about 40 minutes.
In a large bowl combine milk and pudding mix.
Beat 2 minutes until well blended.
Refrigerate about 5 minutes.
Add sugar, half and half, maple flavoring and eggs to pudding mix until well blended.
Stir in nuts.
Pour into freezer can.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Makes 3 quarts or 24 (1/2 cup) servings.
In a 9 x 11-inch pan, layer lettuce.
Spread cheese over lettuce.
Mix mayonnaise well with lettuce and cheese.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
In separate pan, slice tomatoes.
Pour approximately 4 ounces Italian dressing over tomatoes. Refrigerate overnight.
Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Combine remaining ingredients, stirring well.
Pour sauce over chicken and bake, uncovered, for 1 hour or 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
Brown beef and onion, drain.
Combine soups, rice and beef mixture.
Pour into casserole dish.
Top casserole with cracker crumbs or bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Beat egg whites until frothy.
Add cream of tartar and beat until soft peaks form.
Add sugar gradually and beat until very stiff.
Fold in pecans.
Spread mixture evenly on 3 (8-inch) circles drawn on brown paper or baking paper that has been placed on cookie sheets.
Bake at 275° for 45 minutes.
Turn oven off and leave meringues in oven with door closed for 45 minutes more. Remove from oven; let cool 10 minutes, then carefully peel off brown paper.
Use 9 x 13-inch casserole.
Alternate layer bread, cheese, sausage (about 2 layers).
Mix remaining ingredients (except magarine) and pour over layered dish.
Pour melted margarine over all.
Refrigerate 3 hours or overnight is best.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Preheat oven to 325°.
Butter a deep casserole; make layers of cheeses and chilies.
Separate eggs.
Beat egg whites until stiff. Beat egg yolks and fold into egg whites.
Gently pour the egg mixture over the cheeses and chilies.
Bake for 1/2 hour.
Add drained tomatoes, pushing them down with a fork.
Bake for another half hour.
Brown the ground beef and sausage; drain and set aside. Combine
remaining
ingredients,
except
chips.
Place on low heat
and
stir until cheese is melted.
Add meat mixture; mix well.
Pour into crock-pot to keep hot.
Serve with corn chips for dipping.
Peel, core and cube pears and sprinkle with lemon juice.
Mix with sour cream, honey, liqueur and ginger.
Serve chilled.
Do not prepare more than 1 hour or 2
in advance, as the pears will get too soft.
Makes 6 servings.
Drain peas and pimentos. Mix ingredients with mayonnaise dressing and serve on crisp lettuce leaves.
Mix batter, using eggs, flour, water, salt, cayenne and turmeric.
Heat the oil in a heavy saucepan.
Dip blossoms in batter until well-coated, then fry in hot oil (375°) until golden brown; takes less than a minute for each.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm.
Put raw yams in a casserole dish.
Sprinkle on brown sugar and nutmeg.
Pour on pineapple juice or water.
Cook 1 to 1 1/4 hours at 350°, depending on yams.
Add crushed pineapple.
Add pecans. Put back in oven to brown for 15 minutes.
Mix beef, crumbs, onion, beaten egg, salt, pepper and 1/2 cup tomato sauce.
Form into loaf and put in baking dish.
Combine remaining ingredients and sauce.
Pour over loaf; bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.
Baste occasionally.
Layer crushed pineapple, diced cream cheese and marshmallows in baking dish.
Mix sugar and flour together, stir in pineapple juice and beat in egg.
Cook mixture slowly, boil until very thick, stirring to keep from sticking.
(Double boiler works well.)
With a whisk, mix egg, oil, milk, water and vanilla in a bowl. In another bowl mix pancake mix, sugar and baking powder. Gradually add dry ingredients to liquid mixture, mixing well with a whisk.
Cook pancakes on slightly greased griddle, using 1/4 cup batter for each pancake.

recipes.t: Blueberry Loaf Cake(It Has Excellent Texture And Contains No Fat)
d: Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and sugar. Add beaten egg until
thick.
Add orange rind.
Stir in orange juice. Add to
dry
ingredients.
Add
blueberries
and
mix lightly. Turn into greased loaf
pan
x
x 2 1/2-inches. Bake at
for
about 50 minutes until tester inserted in center comes out clean.
Turn out on wire rack and cool.
Store in tightly
covered
container
several hours or overnight to ripen before slicing.
In a 9 x 13-inch baking pan, combine dry frosting and cinnamon; reserve 1 cup for topping.
To the frosting mix in pan, add pineapple and egg yolks.
Stir well to blend and spread evenly over bottom of pan.
In large mixer bowl, combine dry cake mix, egg whites and water.
Blend until moistened.
Beat as directed on cake package.
Spread batter over pineapple mixture.
Cut butter into thin slices over batter. Sprinkle reserved frosting mix over butter.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.
Serve warm or cool. Store in refrigerator.
Mix and bake the cake according to directions in a 9 x 12 x 2-inch pan.
While the cake is baking, heat the milk and sugar to boiling; stir to dissolve.
Five minutes before cake is done, remove from the oven.
Poke holes all over the top with a fork. Pour the hot sugar and milk mixture over the top.
Return to the oven for 5 more minutes.
Once cool, frost the cake with Cool Whip topping.
Sprinkle with coconut and/or chopped nuts.
Let set overnight in refrigerator before serving.
Dissolve yeast in warm water in large bowl.
Stir in sugar, salt and wheat flour; beat.
Cover.
Let rise 30 minutes. Dissolve dry milk in water; bring to boil and add sugars, molasses and margarine.
Cool to lukewarm.
Stir sponge down; add rest and half the
whole wheat flour.
Beat well; add enough more flour to make soft dough.
Turn out on floured board and cover.
Let rest 10 minutes.
Knead 10 minutes or until smooth and elastic.
Place in greased bowl; cover and let rise until double.
Make into 2 loaves; place in greased bread tins.
Let rise.
Bake in 350° oven for about 50 minutes or until done.
Cook onion in oil until transparent.
Add ground beef and cook until brown.
Add salt, pepper, mushrooms, tomato soup, milk and catsup.
Pour into greased 2-quart shallow casserole.
Have cream chilled in refrigerator; turn into chilled bowl. Beat with chilled beater until thick.
Add lemon juice and beat until quite stiff.
Fold in pineapple, chopped dates and salt. Fold in sugar to suit taste.
Serve immediately.
Makes 5 servings.
Mix oil, pinenuts, parsley, capers, rosemary, sage and basil. Stir in tomatoes. Cook vermicelli as directed on package; drain. Mix vermicelli and herb mixture. Serve with pepper.
Spread a layer of chips on cookie tin or large oblong casserole.
Heat can of refried beans mixed with 1/3 can of water.
Spread on chips.
Top with shredded Monterey Jack cheese. Place sliced jalapenos over cheese (if you like things hot).
Put in 350° oven until cheese melts and is bubbly.
Serve with salsa for dipping.
Pan-fry fat back.
Drain oil, except for approximately 1 teaspoon.
Add sliced or chopped apples.
Sprinkle sugar, salt and other seasonings to taste.
Cover and simmer until apples are soft by fork-touch.
Saute onion in butter until golden brown.
Mix together sauteed onion, meat, bacon, cheese, celery salt, pepper and egg. Shape into 6 patties.
Pan-fry in the same pan used to fry onion.
Top each half of English muffin with turkey and tomato slices. Top with cheese slice.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake until cheese is melted.
Makes 2 sandwiches.
Wash greens carefully with cold water to remove all the grit and sand.
Drain well.
Put water in 4-quart stock pot.
Add salt pork; bring to a brisk boil and then add greens (never put greens in cold water to start).
Salt to taste.
Add shortening; boil until tender, about 1 hour.
If frozen greens are used, cook according to package instructions.
Delicious with cornbread.
Melt oleo.
Add sugar.
Blend in eggs and vanilla.
Add dry ingredients.
Spread in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Sprinkle with nuts and chips.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Make dough: Sprinkle yeast and a pinch of sugar over warm water in measuring cup.
Stir.
Let stand just until foamy, 2 to 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, whisk together 2 cups flour, 1/2 cup sugar, salt and cardamom in large bowl.
With pastry blender or 2 knives, cut butter into flour mixture until coarse crumbs form.
Whisk together lukewarm milk, 2 eggs and egg yolk in medium bowl until blended: whisk in other ingredients and knead.
Let rise.
Press one piece of dough into a 16 X 9 inch rectangle onto a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper.
Cut twelve 1-inch strips of dough along each side of filling.
Gently stretch strips across filling; alternating side to side and pressing gently. Roll two 16-inch-long ropes of dough.
Join one end of ropes and twist together: arrange down center of loaf.
Wash small potatoes well.
Fry bacon until crisp.
Remove bacon and add onion in skillet and saute until brown.
Return bacon bits to pan. Add potatoes.
Cover and simmer until potatoes are tender.
Add water as needed to keep from sticking.
Add cooked peas and cream.
Simmer for a short time.
Sort and wash beans; place in large Dutch oven.
Cover with water, 2-inches above beans.
Let soak 8 hours.
Drain beans and return to Dutch oven.
Add water, chilies, garlic, chili powder and salt to beans.
Bring to boil, cover, reduce heat and simmer 2 hours or until beans are tender, stirring occasionally.
Transfer to serving dish and sprinkle with cheese.
Season chicken (salt and pepper).
Place chicken in casserole dish.
Mix onion soup mix with juice.
Mix cornstarch with 1/4 cup water.
Combine liquids and pour over chicken.
Cover and bake 1 1/2 hours in 350° oven.
(Given to me by my lovely daughter-in-law, Mindy Bess.)
Cook wild rice according to package directions.
Combine soup (or sauce whichever you use), onion and sour cream.
Place wild rice on the bottom of a casserole.
Lay asparagus spears on top. Pour sauce over asparagus, then top with cheese and bacon.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 6.
Place contents of rice and seasoning packets in 2-quart casserole.
Melt butter.
Add apples and sprinkle with brown sugar.
Cook until apples are lightly glazed.
Add celery, raisins and water.
Bring to a boil.
Pour over rice, stir and cover. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Uncover, stir and bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes longer.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
Combine coconut, marshmallows, pineapple, oranges and blueberries in bowl; mix well.
Fold in sour cream.
Makes 8 servings.
1st Layer:
Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water.
Add 2 cups cold water and 1 can drained, crushed pineapple.
Save juice for 3rd Layer, 1 1/3 cups.
Put into long dish and let set completely.
Cook hamburg and drain; add peas, cream of mushroom soup and milk and mix.
Bake 1/2 hour to heat through.
Last few minutes of cooking, add onion rings on top.
Melt the first 4 ingredients in a double boiler; cool.
In a 9 x 13-inch pan, melt the oleo in oven.
Add the brown sugar, flour and chopped pecans; mix and spread in pan.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350°, stirring every 4 to 5 minutes with a fork until mixture is crumbly.
Remove 1/3 of this mixture for topping; pat the rest in bottom of pan.
Add a 1-inch layer of butter pecan ice cream.
Cover with cooled fudge mixture; top with remaining crumbs. Freeze.
Remove from freezer just before serving.
Serves 16.
Cream the butter.
Add sugar, then whole eggs and brandy.
Add flour last.
Batter will be very thick.
Bake in a tube pan at 350° for 1 hour.
Coat veal cubes well in flour.
Slowly heat butter in 8-quart kettle.
In it, brown veal cubes well, turning on all sides.
Add onion, okra and tomatoes.
Cover and cook 15 minutes.
Add 2 quarts of water and remaining ingredients.
Cover and bring to boiling.
Reduce heat; simmer 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Makes 5 quarts (20 servings).
In 10-inch skillet over medium heat, in hot oil, cook onion until golden brown and tender.
Push onions to one side; add pork. Cook until browned.
Spoon off fat.
Stir in soup, water, sugar, vinegar and Worcestershire sauce.
Cook 5 minutes.
Spoon mixture over potatoes.
Melt the butter or margarine in the bottom of a large saucepan. Add the onions and cook until they are tender and transparent.
Add the meat and continue to cook until the meat loses its redness. Add the salt and chili powder.
Continue to cook for a few seconds longer.
Add the potatoes, green pepper, celery, tomatoes and the tomato soup.
Simmer for 15 minutes longer, or until the edges of the potato cubes become transparent.
Add the beans and simmer for 15 minutes more.
Prepare gelatin according to directions.
Chill until set. Put milk, bowl and beaters in freezer for about 1 hour.
Milk should be icy.
Add half sugar to strawberries.
Beat milk with vanilla and remaining sugar at high speed until stiff peaks form. Quickly whip gelatin until no white streaks remain.
Taste for sweetness and more sugar to taste.
Dissolve
bouillon
in
water.
Cook onion in butter or margarine
until
tender.
Blend in flour and seasonings.
Add milk
and bouillon gradually.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture thickens.
Add crabmeat and heat, but do not boil.
Garnish with parsley.
Serves 6.
Cut bread crosswise like a pineapple (about 1 inch cuts) just down to the bottom crust.
Mix cheese with mushrooms and stuff into the cuts.
Place on a large sheet of heavy aluminum foil. (May do this much the night before.
Wrap and refrigerate.)
Spread marmalade in bottom of greased 12-cup Bundt pan. Sprinkle with nuts.
Combine brown sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl.
Separate biscuits; dip in butter and dredge in sugar mixture.
Stand each biscuit on edge around pan, spacing evenly. Drizzle with remaining butter and top with remaining sugar mixture.
Drop lobster tails into boiling salted water and cook for 10 minutes.
Remove from water and cool.
Combine the remaining ingredients in a small saucepan and keep warm.
Trim the shell and loosen the lobster meat from shell.
Place in a shallow pan and baste with the butter mixture.
Broil until brown, basting frequently.
Serve immediately.
Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Add sugar and stir until sugar dissolves, but don't boil.
Add cold water and let mixture cool, but not congeal.
Pour into a punch bowl and add the cranberry juice.
Add the ginger ale just before serving.
Serves 12.

recipes.t: Peanut Butter And Jelly Cookie Bars
d: Preheat oven to 375°.
Stir flour, sugar, and butter until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Add egg and vanilla and blend well. Reserve 1/2 c. mixture for later.
Pour remaining mixture in baking pan and bake 10 minutes until lightly brown.
Remove from oven and spread jam over warm crust.
Sprinkle with 1 cup of peanut butter chips.
Mix together reserved crust mixture and remaining peanut butter chips and sprinkle over top.
In a large pot (5-quart), saute seasoning in butter.
Add raw shrimp when seasoning is soft.
Cook until shrimp are pink, stirring often.
This is when I add about 1/4 teaspoon tarragon. Add Ro-Tel, V-8, corn and potatoes with water to fill pot, about 2 cups.
Cook on medium-low fire for about 45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are done.
Serve with garlic bread. Enjoy!
Mash avocado, garlic, lemon juice and mayo.
Spread evenly in 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Spread sour cream over.
Drain picante sauce and spoon over.
Top with layer of olives and tomatoes.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Yields 6 cups.
Combine molasses, eggs and shortening.
Mix well.
Sift dry ingredients together and stir into mix; mix well.
Add nuts and raisins.
Pour into a well-greased 7 1/2 x 11 1/2-inch or similar size pan.
Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 25 minutes or until golden brown and leaves sides of pan.
Cool on wire rack, then cut into bar sizes.
Since this has only 1/2 cup sugar, you may adjust it into a diabetic diet.
Gently pound the veal until thin and flat, but not broken. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Dredge lightly in flour.
Heat olive oil in pan.
Add veal; turn up heat and saute veal quickly. Drain off grease and add beef stock, lemon juice, butter and parsley.
Stir well; heat sauce thoroughly.
Spoon sauce over veal scallops to serve.
Serves 6.
Preparation time:
15 minutes.
Prepare noodles as label directs, drain and stir in butter or margarine.
Keep warm.
Meanwhile, cut round steak lengthwise in half, then slice in 1/8 inch slices.
In small bowl, stir flour, dry mustard, pepper and mushrooms with their liquid; stir until well blended.
In large skillet, over medium high heat, cook steak in broth about 1 hour or until meat is tender.
Stir in mushroom mixture and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is thickened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in sour cream; heat through but do not boil. To serve, arrange meat mixture and noodles on warm platter; sprinkle parsley over meat.
Makes 6 servings.
Generously grease 3 to 4-quart casserole.
Slightly fry bacon; drain and discard fat.
Peel and slice potatoes and onions.

Place in alternate layers in casserole the onions, potatoes and bacon. Mix soup, tomato paste and seasonings and pour over casserole. Cover casserole and bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours, until tender and slightly brown.
Serves 6 (depending on appetites!).
Combine chicken, celery and almonds.
Mix mayonnaise, sour cream, salt, onion and lemon juice together.
Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with crushed chips and cheese.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Dissolve orange and lemon jello in boiling water.
Add orange juice.
Refrigerate (after mixing well) until slightly thickened. Mix together (with mixer) softened cream cheese, Cool Whip and pecans.
Fold into jello mixture.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex. Chill until almost firm.
Dissolve the peach jello in 1 cup boiling water.
Stir the peach pie filling in.
Chill until partially congealed and pour over top of other layer.
Cut up bacon and fry until crisp; drain.
Beat egg whites until firm.
Add milk and soup, then bread, bacon and cheese. Grease baking dish.
Let set in refrigerator overnight, unbaked. Bake at 250° for 1 1/2 hours.
Put pineapple, cranberry and water in large coffee pot.
In basket of coffee pot, put cinnamon sticks broken in 1/2, cloves and sugars.
Perk.
Cut onions and green peppers in eighths.
Clean livers and season lightly.
Put livers in frying pan, hot with medium-high heat.
Cook livers 3 to 5 minutes, while stirring.
Take livers out and set on side.
Place all vegetables in pan and put top on pan.
Steam vegetables and stir occasionally for 3 to 5 minutes (enable asparagus to break apart).
Put livers back in pan with vegetables, mixing well.
Put cooking wine in and simmer about 5 minutes.
Beat egg yolks until light.
Add salt and sugar; blend.
Add hot milk, almond flavoring and vanilla.
Beat egg whites until stiff; fold into hot mixture.
Pour into cups.
Garnish with dollops of whipped cream and slivered almonds, if desired.
Yield: 6 servings.
Brown the meat.
Saute onion in the oil. Add soup, sauerkraut, salt and pepper.
Cook the noodles according to directions on package.
Add to meat mixture.
Put in 3-quart casserole that has been greased.
Mix bread crumbs, cheese and melted butter. Sprinkle over the top and bake at 350° for 30 minutes, uncovered.
Cook Brussels sprouts and drain.
Make white sauce.
Melt butter; add flour and add chicken broth and cream.
Add cheese; fold in Brussels sprouts and chestnuts.
Sprinkle with bacon and season.
Reheat in 350° oven for 30 to 45 minutes.
Preheat oven to 450°.
Grease 13 x 9-inch glass baking dish. Cut off and discard ends from zucchini.
Slice each zucchini in half lengthwise, then in half again, forming 12 spears.
Combine dry ingredients.
In shallow bowl, combine egg and milk.
Roll zucchini in cornmeal mixture.
Dip into egg mixture, then again in cornmeal mixture to coat thoroughly.
Place in prepared dish. Drizzle with oleo.
Bake 15 minutes or until tender.
Serves 6.
Dissolve 1 package jello in hot water.
Add cold water and pour into a pan at least 8 x 12-inch.
Refrigerate until firm.
In a small bowl, soften gelatin in cold water.
Heat skim milk but do not boil.
Add milk to gelatin and stir in cheese, vanilla and Equal.
Blend until creamy.
Place on top of firm raspberry layer and refrigerate to set.
Cook 1 pint blueberries in 2 cups water just until soft.
Stir in raspberry jello until dissolved.
Add cold water.
Cool and pour on top of cheese layer.
Refrigerate until firm.
Makes 12 to 24 servings (1/12 equals 88 calories, 1/24 equals 44 calories with Equal).
Cook broccoli according to package directions.
Drain well; set aside.
In same saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons butter.
Stir in flour, salt and pepper.
Add milk, garlic and onion.
Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Cook and stir 2 minutes more. Add cream cheese;
stir until melted.
Stir in broccoli.
Spread oil evenly over bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Add other ingredients, stir until well mixed.
(Don't add pudding if it is already in cake mix.)
Sprinkle nuts on top.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Saute onion and mushrooms in butter until onions are translucent.
Add peas and corn; combine with onions, etc.
Add water and bouillon; bring to boil.
Add rice and grated Parmesan. Lower heat and simmer 20 minutes, covered.
Remove from heat, let stand 5 minutes, covered.

Add juice to flour to make a paste in double boiler. Add butter, sugar and salt. Cook 10 minutes. Add egg slightly beaten and cook 4 minutes, stirring constantly. Let cool and add fruit, nuts and marshmallows. Fold in whipped cream. Place in freezer.
Measure 1/2 cup of pineapple juice into a blender and add gelatine.
Add remainder of ingredients, adding the cottage cheese last.
Blend until smooth.
Fold in pineapple.
Cook in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish or sheet cake pan. Sprinkle pineapple in pan first.
Layer the fruit evenly all over the pan, then sprinkle cake mix over fruit.
Mix melted margarine and 1/4 cup milk together.
Pour over ingredients.
Top with coconut and pecans.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.
Turn down heat and bake at 325° for 15 minutes.
Trim crusts from bread.
Spread with butter.
Mix cheeses, mayonnaise and thyme.
Spread on buttered bread and carefully roll up.
Place, seam side down, in shallow baking pan.
Melt 1/4 cup butter and spoon over rolls.
Bake in 450° oven 6 minutes or until toasted.
Cut each roll into 2 pieces.
Serve hot.
Makes 16 pieces.
Flour bottom of tart pan and add crust.
Bake unfilled pie crust at 450° for 15 minutes.
Let cool.
Blend together next 4 ingredients and pour into cooled baked shell.
Let chill 45 minutes.
Arrange fresh fruit slices on top of cream cheese mixture.
Melt jelly and pour over fruit for glaze.
Let chill and serve.
Butter both sides of Hoagie bun and broil in oven for 2-3 minutes.
Take out of oven and place shredded Mozzarella cheese on one side of Hoagie.
Then place lettuce, tomato slices and bacon strips on top of cheese.
Fold Hoagie together and place back in oven for 5- 7 minutes or until cheese is melted.
Take out and drip olive oil inside of Hoagie.
Spread Mayonnaise on top inside bun (optional).
If using canned peaches, drain and puree them in saucepan. If fresh peaches, peel, puree and add sugar to them in saucepan. Add 3 mint sprigs and stir until mint is thoroughly bruised. Cool.
Remove mint and add the juices and grated bits of rind; chill.
Just before serving, add ginger ale and garnish with remaining mint sprigs.

recipes.t: Diabetic Apricot Bread(A Sweet Loaf Filled With Bits Of Dried Apricots.)
d: Beat together the eggs and mashed banana until creamy.
Add water, vanilla extract and oil; beat.
Measure in flour, baking soda and baking powder; beat well.
Stir in chopped apricot until evenly blended.
Spoon batter into an oiled and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Spread batter evenly in pan.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes, or until a knife inserted comes out clean.
Cool completely on a wire rack before slicing.
Serves 6.
Stir the cream cheese and gradually beat in the milk and cream until smooth.
Stir in the bananas, lemon juice, sugar and instant pudding.
Spoon into dessert dishes and chill.
Makes 6-8 servings.
Blend together mustard and molasses in a saucepan.
Stir in soy sauce, vinegar, pineapple and ginger.
Mix well.
Bring to a boil. Pour into desired jar. Cover tightly.
Makes 2 3/4 cups sauce.
Roll crackers fine; reserve 3 tablespoons of crumbs for top of pie.
Mix remainder with softened butter and sugar.
Press the mixture firmly against the bottom and sides of well buttered pie tin.
Cook first 3 ingredients on high until it spins a thread from spoon.
Add 1 pat of butter and peanuts.
Boil about 7 minutes until peanuts smell and liquid has become golden brown color.
Add soda and salt quickly.
Stir in pat of butter and start dipping out with metal ladle into 7 to 9-inch buttered aluminum pie pans. Shake evenly out.
(Helps if someone will shake down while the other pours out the mixture.)
Preheat oven to 450°.
Leaving skins on, scrub potatoes and cut
lengthwise
into
1/2 inch
strips.
In
small
bowl combine oil,
salt, seasoned pepper and paprika.
Toss potato wedges in seasoned
oil.
Place potatoes on foil lined baking sheet and bake
for
about
20 minutes or until tender.
Turn potatoes once while baking.
Brown ground beef.
Add onion, green pepper, red pepper and garlic salt.
Cook until peppers and onions are tender.
Divide each biscuit into two or three pieces (biscuits are flaky and will pull apart).
Place biscuit slices into bottom of ungreased casserole dish.
Pour meat mixture over this.
Spread Cheddar cheese over meat mixture.
Top with Ragu Pizza Quick.
Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top and bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes or until crust is done.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Brown and season meat and onion.
Add 1/2 cup rice, chicken rice soup and can of mushroom soup.
Mix well and put in baking dish.
Corn flakes or chips may be crumbled over top or left plain.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Spray pan with nonstick cooking spray. In small saucepan, melt margarine.
Add mushrooms; cook, stirring frequently, for 2 minutes.
Stir in flour; cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in broth and 1/2 cup water; stir until blended. Cook 2 to 3 minutes, stirring, until thickened.
Remove from heat; stir in milk, almonds and basil.
Place spaghetti in pan; top with chicken.
Pour mushroom sauce over chicken; sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until lightly browned and bubbly.
Dice celery and onion; cook in chicken broth until done.
Mix sausage, apples, cracker crumbs and crumbled corn bread.
Add the onion and celery.
Add the sage the last thing to suit your taste. I bake this separately at 400°.
I make gravy and put some on top of dressing when it is served.
Preheat oven at 350°.
In a medium saucepan, boil tofu for 15 minutes.
Drain well and place in bowl and mash.
Add chestnuts, crab, mayonnaise, eggs, shiitake, carrots and green onions.
Mix well.
Place into greased loaf pan and bake for 45 minutes. Remove pan from oven and pour cream of mushroom soup (undiluted) over loaf.
Cover with foil and place in oven for 10 to 15 minutes.
In
a
large
bowl,
mix
flour, cornmeal, baking soda, sugar and
salt.
With pastry blender, cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
With fork, stir in shredded cheese, vinegar and cold water just until mixture forms a soft dough. Shape
into a ball, wrap with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour.
(Or place dough in freezer for 30 minutes.)
Mix and set in refrigerator for 15 minutes the jello, water and ice cream.
Add pineapple, banana and mandarin oranges.
Top with chopped pecans and let set all day.

Cream Crisco and sugar; add beaten eggs. Mix nuts, cherries, flour, salt and baking powder. Add milk and flour alternately, beginning and ending with flour. Add vanilla. Bake in three 9-inch layers in 375° oven. Cool and ice with Coconut Icing.
Wash chicken pieces and pat dry.
Put flour, bread crumbs, seasonings and cheese in a bag and mix well.
Shake chicken pieces, a few at a time, to coat.
Dip coated chicken in egg, beaten with water.
Shake chicken in flour mixture again; set aside.
Fill an electric pan or large, heavy skillet with the oil (no more than 1/3 its depth).
Heat oil to 375°.
Fry chicken 11 minutes, skin side down.
Turn chicken and fry 10 to 15 minutes. Let stand at least 7 minutes before serving.
Serves 4 to 6.
Mix all ingredients together except breads.
Scoop out center of bread to form a bowl shape out of the sides and bottom.
Fill with sour cream mixture.
Use the insides of bread to eat with dip.
Beat eggs and add to sugar.
Stir together.
Add enough milk to make 2 pints of mixture.
Pour into unbaked pie crust and bake at 400° until set (about 40 minutes).
Use bottom rack in oven. Do not overcook.
Sprinkle nutmeg and cinnamon over top to taste.
Place each chicken breast half on a sheet of wax paper. Flatten to 1/4-inch thickness with mallet or rolling pin.
Place one slice of ham and one slice of cheese in the center of each chicken piece.
Sprinkle evenly with parsley and pepper.
Roll lengthwise and secure with toothpicks.
Dip each chicken breast in egg.
Coat well with bread crumbs.
Melt butter and brown chicken on all sides.
Remove chicken to a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Reserve drippings in skillet.
Add remaining ingredients to reserved drippings and stir well.
Pour sauce over chicken.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Cook garlic, parsley, oregano, salt and pepper in oil for a few minutes.
Do not brown.
Add clams with liquid and wine.
Simmer about 10 minutes.
Cook 1 pound linguini and drain.
Place in a serving dish; spoon sauce on top and serve immediately.

Dissolve strawberry gelatin in 1 cup of the boiling water. Add 1/2 cup of the cold water. Pour into 8-inch square baking pan. Dissolve 1 package of the lime gelatin in remaining 1 cup boiling water. Add remaining 1/2 cup of cold water. Pour into 8-inch square baking pan. Refrigerate both gelatins until firm, about 4 hours. Cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Bring 1 cup of the pineapple juice to boil in small saucepan. Add remaining package of lime gelatin and sugar; stir to dissolve. Add remaining 1/2 cup cold pineapple juice; refrigerate until slightly thickened. Stir combined whipped topping and dressing into lime gelatin; refrigerate until slightly thickened. Fold in gelatin cubes. Pour into 6 1/2 cup mold. Refrigerate overnight or until firm.
Unmold. Makes 12 servings.
Heat fat in heavy skillet; add beef and cook until browned. Add onion; cook on low heat for 5 minutes.
Spoon off excess grease.
Add remaining ingredients.
Heat to boiling; reduce heat and cover.
Simmer for 20 minutes or until macaroni is tender. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
Heat oven to 375°.
Brown meat and drain.
Stir in salsa, tomato sauce and taco seasoning.
Simmer, stirring frequently for 5 minutes.
In separate bowl, combine cottage cheese, eggs and oregano.
Line bottom of lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish with half of the tortillas, overlapping edges.
Top with half the meat mixture.
Spoon cottage cheese mixture over meat.
Arrange remaining tortillas over cheese mixture.
Spread remaining meat mixture over all and top with shredded cheese.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until bubbly.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
In large skillet, brown ground meat with onion.
Add chilies, tomato sauce and cream.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Take package of 12 corn tortillas; stack and cut into thin strips.
Heat oil in large frying pan.
Saute the strips, turning often.
Lightly grease a 2-quart casserole and place half of the strips in it.
Cover with half of the meat sauce.
Sprinkle with 1 1/2 cups shredded cheese. Layer rest of strips, then meat sauce and top with another 1 1/2 cups cheese.
Bake at 350° about 25 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.t: Mexican Yuletide Cookies(Very Good Christmas Cookie)
d: Beat butter until creamy.
Gradually add sugar, beating until fluffy.
Blend in vanilla; add flour to creamed mixture and blend well.
Stir in oats and nutmeats.
Shape dough to form 1-inch balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake in preheated oven, 325°, for 20 to 25 minutes.
While warm, sift confectioners sugar over cookies.
Spray sheet cake pan with Pam.
Spread pecans on bottom of pan.
Spread coconut over pecans.
Pour cake mix over coconut. Mix cream cheese, margarine, powdered sugar, vanilla and enough milk to make consistency of cake mix.
Pour over other ingredients and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Sift all dry ingredients.
Mix eggs, water and oil in another bowl and beat.
Add to dry ingredients, beating well.
Add pumpkin and nuts.
Pour in 3 small or 2 large loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour (a little longer if oven is full).
Wrap in foil.
Store in refrigerator or freeze.

In large mixing bowl, combine cake mix, buttermilk, egg whites, egg and oil, beating until well blended. In a small bowl, combine the brown sugar, coconut and pecans together. Add to first bowl. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Let cool and frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.
Break up angel food cake and layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan (press down to form a makeshift crust).
Cut up strawberries (all but 10 to 15) in small pieces and layer over cake.
Cook rice and set aside.
Brown hamburger meat, onion and soy sauce.
Mix everything together, then cut pumpkin top out and clean out; put mixture together in pumpkin.
Draw a face with a permanent marker on the pumpkin and put it in the oven.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
Microwave apple juice on High 1 minute or until thawed.
Stir in cornstarch, cinnamon and nutmeg. Stir in apples and margarine. Cover with wax paper.
Microwave on High 4 minutes. Stir. Microwave on High 5 minutes or until apples are fork-tender. Cool 20 to 30 minutes.
Spoon into crust.
Cream the shortening and sugar.
Add egg yolks and milk alternately with graham crackers and baking powder.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Pour into baking cups and bake in a 350° oven for 15 minutes.
In double boiler, melt white chocolate with Eagle Brand milk. Remove from heat; add remaining ingredients.
Cool and eat.
Mix cake mix according to directions, except add four eggs. While cake is baking, cook strawberries, adding sugar.
While cake is hot, punch holes into it with a fork and pour hot strawberries over cake.
Let cake cool.

recipes.t: Rice Krispie Treats(A Favorite At Youth Fellowship)
d: Dissolve each package in 1 cup boiling water; set aside to cool.
When cool, add 1 cup vodka to cherry Jell-O and pour into glass or ceramic serving dish.
Chill.
When slightly firm, add a layer of sliced bananas.
Repeat with orange layer (adding 1 cup vodka to orange Jell-O).
When slightly firm, add more bananas. Finally, add the top layer of lemon, not neglecting to add 1 cup vodka.
Pare turnips and boil in salted water.
Drain; mash (makes 2 cups mashed).
Add light cream or evaporated milk, egg, oleo, brown sugar and corn meal or Cream of Wheat.
Bake 40 minutes in 350° oven.
Cream sugar and butter.
Beat egg yolks and whites separately; mix together.
Stir lightly with sugar and butter, then add vinegar and raisins.
Pour into unbaked pie shells.
Bake about 35 minutes or until set, in 350° oven.
Serve with whipped cream.

Beat egg whites and salt until soft peaks form. Add superfine sugar gradually, beating well between each addition. Make sure sugar is completely dissolved. Mix together granulated sugar and cornstarch; lightly fold into meringue with lemon juice. This mixture will make one large Pavlova.

Shape the meringue on the baking sheet covered with parchment paper or try foil for it will easily peel away from the Pavlova when it is cooked. Place in an oven preheated to 225°. Bake for 40 minutes or more until the Pavlova is dry to the touch. Do not allow it to color. Turn off the oven; open the door and leave it in the oven to cool. This dries it out and makes it crisp. Pavlovas should be light, dry and pale in color.
Sift flour, sugar and baking soda together.
Add oil, water, eggs and vanilla.
Mix well.
Put in the rest of the ingredients. Mix well.
Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350°
for 45 minutes or until done.
Mash flour and oleo together.
Add cheese, salt and seasoning.
Add Rice Krispies.
Form into small balls.
Bake 18 minutes at 350°.
Cream sugar and oleo.
Add vanilla and flour.
Mix well. Shape in crescents or balls.
Bake at 375° for 8 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet.
Remove from cookie sheet and roll in powdered sugar.
Mix all ingredients, except peanut butter, into a well combined mixture.
Roll out on wax paper, using some sugar to keep from sticking.
Spread peanut butter over dough.
Roll up in jellyroll fashion.
Let sit in refrigerator 3 hours.
Cut into 1/4-inch slices.
Preheat oven to 450°.
Combine baking mix, milk, cheese and 1/4 teaspoon garlic in a mixer bowl.
Mix until soft dough forms.
Beat for 30 seconds.
Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.
Combine margarine and 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder in bowl.
Brush over warm biscuits.
Serve immediately.
Yields 10 to 12 servings.
Brown beef, drain.
Add soup, salsa, milk, 1/2 cup cheese and tortillas.
Mix well.
Spoon into a 2 quart baking dish.
Cover and bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup cheese.
Serves 4.
Preheat oven to 375°.
In bowl, combine oregano, paprika, basil, onion, garlic, pepper and bread crumbs.
In another bowl, place egg whites.
Dip chicken in egg white, then bread crumb mixture.
Spray shallow pan with nonstick spray.
Place chicken in pan.
Bake, uncovered, 1 hour or until chicken is brown.
Turn once.
Cut crust off bread.
Flatten bread with a rolling pin. Spread each piece with a light layer of cream cheese.
Roll slices of bread tightly.
Cut rolls into quarters.
Prepare a mixture of cinnamon and sugar.
Dip each roll into melted butter, then roll in the cinnamon and sugar mix.
Place rolls on a cookie sheet and freeze.
When rolls are frozen, store in plastic baggies.
When ready to serve, place rolls on a cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° until rolls are bubbly and puffy.
In large mixing bowl, beat eggs, sugar and salad oil.
Sift flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt.
Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk.
Generously grease and flour a 10-inch Bundt pan (or use smaller pans).
Pour batter into pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Melt margarine.
Saute onion.
Add other ingredients and bake in oven at 325° for 1 hour, uncovered.
Peel eggplant.
Soak in salted water in refrigerator for several hours or overnight.
Soak dry bread crumbs in evaporated milk plus whole milk.
Saute green peppers, onion and celery in butter until tender; drain well.
Mix the bread crumbs, eggplant and sauteed vegetables.
Add eggs, salt, sage and chopped pimiento.
Blend well.
Cut filo dough into 2 sections.
Melt butter or margarine in pan or microwave.
Pour it over dough.
Put dough on greased and floured pan evenly.
Spread crushed peanuts and almonds on dough. Put rest of dough on top of other section of dough.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes, or until golden brown in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Mix juices.
Add champagne or ginger ale and sherbet.
Makes 2 1/2 quarts.
Lemonade, pineapple and orange juice, all frozen type.

recipes.t: Rich And Charlie Salad(Same As Pasta House)
d: Mix first 6 ingredients together and put in refrigerator.
When ready to serve, pour over lettuce and onion.
Blend powdered sugar and cocoa in mixing bowl.
Add milk and butter.
Cook on High for 2 minutes (in microwave).
You do not need to mix these ingredients thoroughly before microwaving. Remove bowl from microwave and stir just to mix ingredients.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Stir until blended.
Pour into a greased 8 x 8-inch pan.
Place in freezer for 20 minutes.
Dissolve gelatin in 1/2 cup soda.
Bring other 1/2 cup soda to a boil.
Mix soda/gelatin mixture with the hot soda; add dry milk and mix well.
Add extracts and sweetener.
Place over ice and whip until fluffy.
Chill until set and cut into squares.
Melt unsalted butter and saute onion and red and yellow bell peppers.
Add the corn and rice and then the cream.
Stir well. Cook down a bit until slightly thickened.
Add the Parmesan and season with salt and pepper just before serving.
Brown sausage, onion, pepper and celery.
Drain. Add kidney beans, tomatoes, juice and cooked rice.
Let simmer.
Sprinkle breasts with parsley and garlic salt.
Roll up; secure with a toothpick.
Roll in butter, then dressing mix. Place in heavily greased baking dish.
Sprinkle remaining crumbs over chicken; moisten lightly with water.
Bake at 325° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Bring cream cheese and
Cheddar cheese to room temperature. Mix together.
Stir
in
liquid smoke.
Shape into ball or log and roll in chopped nuts.
Refrigerate.
Mix softened cream cheese with enough mayonnaise to make it spreadable.
Add chopped green olives with pimentos and chopped nuts.
This is good on wheat bread!
Cook broccoli according to directions adding an extra 1/4 cup water.
When done, drain the juice, adding it to the chicken soup. Mix until smooth.
Grease 1 1/2-quart casserole; add half the broccoli, then half stuffing mix and half chicken soup.
Repeat. Add cut up cheese to the top.
Bake in 350° oven 30 minutes. Serve immediately.

Brown meat in skillet, drain, stir in corn and salsa. Arrange chips in a large shallow pan. Spoon mixture over chips, and top with cheese. Bake at 400 degrees for 2 minutes until cheese is melted. Serve with sliced greed onions, tomatoes, salsa, and sour cream.
Mix until creamy the cream cheese and Eagle Brand milk.
Add cherry pie filling, crushed pineapple and Cool Whip.
Mix well and fold in 1/2 bag marshmallows.
Mix 1 1/2 c of the flour, sugar, salt and undissolved yeast in large bowl.
Cut margarine into small pieces; combine with milk and water.
Heat until warm (105-115 degrees).
Stir into dry ingredients. Stir in eggs, almonds, peel, nutmeg and enough remaining flour to make soft dough.
Grease top of dough and cover tightly; refrigerate 2 to 24 hours.
Fry pork loin cubes with onions.
Add water.
Cube potatoes; slice carrots.
Add to mixture; season to taste.
When vegetables are cooked, thicken mixture of water, cornstarch and Gravy Master.
Combine oats, flour, brown sugar, salt and soda in a large bowl.
Melt margarine.
Stir in vanilla and Karo.
Pour over oat mixture; mix well.
Press into bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Spoon crunchy peanut butter over hot candy.
Sprinkle with chocolate pieces.
Let stand for 5 minutes.
Spread mixture over candy, making swirls and cool. Makes 24 (2-inch) squares.
Dissolve yeast in warm water.
On medium speed with electric mixer, beat in honey.
Gradually add 3 cups flour.
Add remaining flour to form soft dough.
Knead on lightly floured board until smooth (about 10 minutes).
Cut into 4 equal sized pieces of dough.
Form each piece into 5 ropes about 10-inches in length. Arrange on greased baking sheets about 1-inch apart.
Let rise in warm place for 15 minutes.
Brush each rope lightly with butter and sprinkle with seasoning.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
Makes 20 breadsticks.
In heavy saucepan, combine cornstarch and water.
Stir in milk and egg yolks.
Cook and stir until thick and bubbly.
Remove from heat.
Add margarine and vanilla; cool slightly.
Slice 2 bananas and dip in lemon juice; drain.
Arrange on bottom of crust.
Pour filling over bananas and cover bananas with filling.
Chill 4 hours, until set.
Spread whipped cream on top.
Slice remaining banana; dip in lemon juice.
Drain and arrange on top.
Beat egg in a medium bowl, just enough to mix.
Mix in corn, salt, flour, sugar and butter.
Beat until well blended.
Dissolve gelatin in 1 cup boiling water; add 2 cups cold water.
Pour in gallon container; add pineapple and orange juice. Add cold water to fill container.
Serve over crushed ice.
Combine popcorn, raisins and peanuts in a large bowl.
Mix both sugars, water and corn syrup.
Bring to a boil without stirring.
Remove from heat and add vanilla.
Pour syrup over popcorn mixture.
Mix well with wooden spoon.
Butter hands and form quickly into balls.
After sauteing onion in butter, mix in soup and cream.
Stir in rice, which has been cooked, and large jar of Cheez Whiz.
Bake for 45 minutes at 425°, covered, then for 20 minutes uncovered.
Pare apple and slice thin.
Add sugar mixed with flour, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Toss to cover.
Place in pie shell and top with margarine.
Bake 40 minutes at 350°.
Saute chopped bacon and onion together over slow fire in stock-pot until bacon is crisp and onion is transparent.
Add cup of hot water and let stand.
Boil potatoes and carrots in remaining hot water.
When partially done, add bacon mixture.
Add tomatoes and clams, with liquid, to pot; break bay leaves and add with salt and pepper to taste.
Cook slowly, stirring frequently, an hour or more, adding water if needed.
Makes about six servings.
Prepare instant mashed potatoes by instructions on box.
Boil hot dogs.
Cut each open and place on a cookie sheet.
Fill with mashed potatoes.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Fold American cheese from corner to corner.
Place half a slice on each hot dog. Bake at 325° until cheese begins to melt.
In medium bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt.
In large bowl, cream brown sugar, sugar, butter and vanilla.
Beat in egg whites.
Gradually beat in dry ingredients alternately with water. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts.
Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto lightly greased baking sheets.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.
Saute onions, mushrooms and pheasant; add water chestnuts. Cook rice according to package directions.
Make a white sauce with the flour, butter, milk, chicken broth, salt and pepper.
Toss pheasant-mushroom mixture and rice together.
Pour sauce over and toss again.
Combine potatoes, celery, eggs, onions, pimientos and seasonings.
Add combined salad dressing and mustard.
Mix lightly.
Chill.
Makes 6 servings.
Cut up bananas on top of crust.
Mix in bowl sweetened condensed milk and lemon juice.
Spread this over the bananas. Pour pineapple
on top
of this.
Spread Cool Whip over this. Garnish with coconut, cherries, pecans or walnuts.
Mix cake mix, pudding, water, oil and eggs together.
Beat for 2 minutes.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 30 to 35 minutes in a 350° oven.
Bring confectioners sugar, orange juice, water and butter to a boil.
Pour over cake while it is still hot.
Move oven rack to position slightly above the middle of oven. Heat oven to 500°.
Grease rectangular baking dish, 13 x 9 x 2-inch.
If fish fillets are large, cut into 4 serving pieces; pat dry.
Mix sour cream, lemon juice and chili powder.
Dip fish into sour cream mixture; coat with chips.
Place in baking dish. Drizzle butter/margarine over fish.
Bake, uncovered, for 10 to 12 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork.
Makes 4 servings (195 calories/serving).
Protein 18, Carbohydrate 4, Fat 12, Cholesterol 60, Sodium 190.
In large skillet, brown and drain ground beef.
Add soup mix, oregano, garlic salt, tomatoes and water.
Bring to a boil.
Add macaroni.
Cover.
Cook 20 minutes, stirring occasionally until macaroni is tender.
Stir in Parmesan and top with Mozzarella.
Soften the cream cheese.
Add sugar and flour.
Mix well and blend in eggs, one at a time.
Stir in half and half and vanilla flavoring.
Pour over crumbs.
Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.
Cool completely before removing rim.
Before serving, spoon cherry preserves over the top.
Slice bread almost to bottom in 15 places.
Spread every other slice hole with Italian dressing.
Place 1 slice of turkey or corned beef with cheese and tomato into prepared section.
Wrap in foil.
Chill.
Later bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cut into blank section and serve.
Heat milk and margarine until margarine melts.
Set aside to cool slightly.
Break bread into small pieces; place in ungreased casserole or souffle dish.
Separate eggs.
Beat yolks until lemon colored.
Slowly add yolks to milk; add vanilla.
Pour over bread. Bake in pan half filled with water 55 to 60 minutes at 325°. While pudding is baking, beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Add sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time and beat until stiff.
Remove pudding from oven.
Spread choice of fruit pie filling on top. Cover completely with meringue.
Return to oven until meringue is lightly brown.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
Combine margarine with flour.
Mix 3 ounces of sugar with 2 eggs.
Beat into margarine-flour combination.
Spread on ungreased 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking pan.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.
Remove from pan.
Spread preserves on dough.
Combine 1/2 pound of sugar with 4 eggs and vanilla.
Fold in walnuts.
Pour over top of preserves and bake at 350° for 1/2 hour longer.
When cool, dust with confectioners sugar.
Cut into diamond shapes.
Place cut up chicken in a 9 x 13 baking dish.
Combine peach syrup, lemon juice, soy sauce and peach halves.
Pour over chicken.
Dot with margarine.
Bake at 375° for 1 1/2 hours. Baste often.
Place vanilla wafers in bottom of a glass or Tupperware dish. Then slice strawberries over wafers.
Mix very good Eagle Brand milk and 1 1/2 cups water.
Mix pudding and Cool Whip.
Then mix all together and pour over strawberries and vanilla wafers.
Prepare oven to 350°.
In bowl, beat unsalted butter, brown sugar and granulated sugar.
Add eggs, vanilla, unsifted flour, baking powder, cinnamon, salt and sunflower flakes.
Spoon onto baking sheet; bake for 10 minutes.
Makes 20 cookies.
Stir together first 3 ingredients.
Lightly coat cutlets.
In large skillet, saute garlic in oil over medium-high heat for one minute.
Discard garlic. Add cutlets and cook 2 to 3 minutes, turning once, until slightly brown.
Remove and keep warm.
Stir in juice or wine.
Stir constantly for 2 to 3 minutes, until thickened and liquid reduces.
Stir in parsley.
Pour over cutlets.
Serve on a platter.
Alternate scoops of vanilla, raspberry and chocolate ice cream into 6 tall glasses.
Drizzle the syrup over the top.
Melt the margarine over low heat. Stir in the marshmallows until all are melted.
Remove from heat. Stir in the butterscotch morsels until well blended. Add the Rice Krispies and mix well (it will be sticky).
Press lightly into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan and cut when cool.
In a large frying pan on low heat, dice garlic and brown in the olive oil.
Pour in 1/2 can of tomatoes and simmer.
In a large bowl, mix hamburg, eggs, cheese, parsley, salt, pepper and bread; then tomato mixture.
Wash peppers; cut in half and remove seeds. Stuff peppers.
Place peppers on lightly oiled baking dish.
Bake at 325° for about 30 minutes.
Spoon remaining tomatoes over top of peppers and bake for another 30 minutes.
Wash and pat spinach leaves dry.
Tear into bite size pieces. In large saucepan, simmer spinach with a small amount of water for 3 minutes.
Drain thoroughly.
Heat oil, soy sauce and sugar in a skillet.
Add spinach and onion.
Cook and toss until spinach is well coated, 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in water chestnuts.
Makes 4 servings.
Dice onion, cheese and pepper and mix with other ingredients. Season to taste.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Cool and slice. Can be wrapped in foil and put in freezer.
Combine boiling water, oats, honey, margarine and salt.
Stir until melted.
Add sour cream.
Cool until lukewarm.
Soften yeast in warm water.
Add yeast, eggs and 2 cups flour to oat mixture. Beat until smooth.
Add enough flour to make a stiff dough.
Knead until smooth and elastic.
Place in greased bowl.
Cover and let rest 20 minutes.
Divide in half, shape each half into a loaf. Place each in a greased loaf pan.
Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 12 to 24 hours.
When ready to bake, remove from refrigerator 10 minutes.
Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes. Remove from pans and cool on racks.
Scald cream slowly in microwave until there is a light film on top.
Set aside and cool to room temperature.
Lightly beat egg yolks, sugar, vanilla and cognac in a mixing bowl.
Whip egg yolk mixture slowly into cooled cream.
Place small baking ramekins in a casserole filled with 1/2-inch very hot water.
Pour custard into ramekins.
Bake at 350 degrees until firm but not solid, about 20-30 minutes.
Under cooking or over cooking is not a major hazard...just don't cook it until it is solid and definitely not until it is brown on top.
Remove ramekins from pan and cool. Chill in refrigerator overnight.
When ready to serve, sprinkle brown sugar across the top of each one.
Place ramekins in pan and surround with ice cubes.
Put under broiler just until sugar is caramelized.
Beat banana, peanut butter, eggs, vanilla and butter until creamy.
Add flour, baking powder and nutmeg.
Beat well.
Stir in peanuts.
Drop by spoonfuls.
Press with a fork.
Bake at 375° for 5 to 8 minutes on greased cookie sheet.
Beat eggs.
Blend in margarine and fruit pulp.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Stir into fruit mixture only until moistened.
Fill greased or baking cup-lined muffin tins 3/4 full. Bake in a 375° oven until golden (20 to 25 minutes).
If desired, reheat before serving.
Yields about 2 dozen.
Total fat:
2.7 g; calories:
In saucepan, bring 1-inch water to a boil.
Place steamer rack or metal colander in saucepan and add sprouts and carrots.
Cover and steam 6 to 8 minutes.
In medium skillet, melt margarine.
Add sugar and stir until dissolved.
Add walnuts and cook, stirring frequently, until brown.
Stir in sprouts, carrots, salt and cinnamon.
Toss until well coated.
Beat 4 egg yolks until thick and lemon-colored.
Set aside. Cream 1 cup softened butter until fluffy.
Set aside.
In a medium saucepan, combine sugar, coffee and water.
Bring to boil, stir until sugar and coffee dissolves.
Cook over medium-low heat, without stirring, to soft ball stage (236°).
Quickly pour the hot syrup in a steady stream into egg yolks, beating constantly, at high speed of electric mixer.
Continue beating until thick and smooth.
Cool.
Beat in reserved butter, a tablespoon at a time. Cover bowl and refrigerate for 30 minutes, until firm enough to spread easily.
Beat eggs; add sugar, sour milk and jam.
Sift together flour, spices, baking powder and soda and add through sifter to first mixture.
Stir in melted shortening and beat thoroughly.
Bake in two greased layer cake pans in a moderate oven (350°) for 25 to 35 minutes.
Spread with Fluffy White Icing.
Trim beans and cook in boiling salted water until tender, about 10 minutes.
Drain.
Cut bacon into approximately 1-inch pieces.
Cook in large frying pan until crisp.
Remove bacon with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Pour off all but 2 tablespoons bacon fat.
Add beans to frying pan.
Stir over medium heat until heated through.
Stir in bacon, pepper and lemon juice.
Crumb Mixture:
Mix graham cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup sugar and melted butter together.
Press into spring-form pan, 10-inches or 11-inches.
Set aside.
Mix corn flakes and Bisquick.
Dip chops in water, then in Bisquick, flake mix.
Place in shallow pan and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Then pour soup over chops and return to oven for 20 to 30 more minutes.
Preheat oven to 375°.
Butter large baking dish.
Cut potatoes into quarters.
Mix olive oil and melted butter together.
Pour over potatoes.
Bake 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes or so. Combine lemon juice, thyme, salt and pepper.
Pour over baked potatoes.
Mix thoroughly.
Bake an additional 15 minutes. Remove from oven and serve on platter.
Serves about 6.
Tastes great as cold leftovers!
Mix baking mix, milk and cheese until soft dough forms.
Beat vigorously 30 seconds.
Drop dough by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown.
Mix margarine and garlic powder; brush over warm biscuits before removing from cookie sheet.
Serve.
Mix the mustard, flour and salt in a double boiler.
Add egg yolks; beat well.
Slowly add hot milk until thick.
Add lemon juice.
Pour over beans.
Preheat oven to 400°.
In medium saucepan combine nectar and apricots; heat to boiling.
Remove from heat, stir in butter and cool.
In large bowl combine flour, sugar and baking powder.
In separate bowl beat together egg and almond extract; stir in apricot mixture.
Add to flour mixture and stir just until moist. Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full with batter. Sprinkle almonds over top of each cup.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes.
Makes 1 dozen muffins.
Cream the butter, sugar and eggs.
Add dry ingredients, then peanut butter.
Add bananas last.
Bake for 16 to 18 minutes at 250°.
Bring water to boil and add bouillon cubes and vegetables. Cook about 10 minutes or until carrots are tender.
Add tomato juice and drained green beans.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Can be cooked in a crock-pot.
Chop onion and green pepper.
Slice jalapeno peppers and mix with chili powder and red pepper.
Drain baked beans.
Heat beans and chili sauce and add mixture.
Cook 1 cup of rice.
Mix cooked rice and chili mixture together.
Will feed 8.
Mix broccoli, cheese and bacon in bowl.
Chill.
Mix mayo, sugar and lemon juice in bowl.
Chill.
Pour dressing over broccoli mixture just before serving.
Cut the first 5 ingredients together like pie crust.
Add the egg and milk; mix together.
Spread in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Top with the rhubarb.
Sprinkle with the jello.
Mix the soft butter, 1 1/2 cups sugar and 1/2 cup flour.
Sprinkle on top. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

Place chicken between two pieces of wax paper and gently pound to 1/4-inch thickness. In small bowl, place egg, water, salt and pepper; stir to mix well. In shallow dish, place coconut. Dredge chicken, first in egg mixture, then in coconut, pressing to coat well. In large non-stick fry pan, place olive oil and butter over medium heat. Add chicken and cook until done.
Saute mushrooms in butter.
Mix flour and soup mix with sour cream (will be thick) and add to mushrooms.
Mix well and heat through.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Peel eggplants and slice lengthwise into approximately 8 (1/4-inch thick) slices.
In a large frying pan, heat oil and brown slices on both sides.
Add more oil as needed. To make eggplant rolls, fold slices of ham in half lengthwise and place one on each slice of browned eggplant.
In small bowl, mix Ricotta, garlic and parsley.
Spoon the cheese mixture on top of ham; spread evenly to the edges.
Top with slice of Mozzarella. Roll eggplant and place, seam side down, in baking dish.
Makes approximately 16 rolls.
Spoon tomato sauce over rolls and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake 30 minutes.
Add salt to mashed potatoes.
Place margarine in top of double boiler, over boiling water until melted.
Add mashed potatoes, confectioners sugar, coconut and vanilla.
Mix well.
Turn onto greased cookie sheet and spread evenly.
Place in cool place to harden.
Cut into small squares.
Dip in Chocolate Dip Mixture.
Wash rice.
Combine with meat, rice, salt, pepper, onion and green pepper.
Shape into small balls (1 to 1 1/4-inch across). Heat tomato soup and water.
Add Worcestershire sauce in cooker. Drop meat balls into soup mixture.
Cover pressure cooker and place pressure regulator on vent and cook 10 minutes, if pressure cooking.
Let rock slowly and drop on own accord.
If using a boiler, cook, covered, for about 45 minutes or bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour or until done.
Melt marshmallows, oleo and brown sugar over low heat. Mix into popcorn.
Put apricots on bottom of an 8 x 8 glass pan.
Pour dry cake mix over fruit.
Pour melted margarine over all.
Bake 350° for 35 minutes.
Serves 6.
Mix vinegar, sugar and salad oil.
Bring to a boil.
Remove from heat and cool.
Place carrots in shallow dish.
Sprinkle with chopped vegetables.
Pour cooled vinegar mixture over all. Refrigerate several hours before serving.
These will keep for weeks in the refrigerator.
Serves 12.
Melt shortening in skillet.
Brown kolbasi pieces; add green peppers and saute until soft.
Add rest of the vegetables and seasonings and simmer for 3/4 of an hour.
Add flour and cook slowly for 10 minutes, stir or it will scorch.
Serve with potatoes.
Makes 4 servings.
Combine slightly beaten egg yolk with flaked tuna.
Add rice and seasonings; chill.
Fold in beaten egg white.
Shape into 10 patties.
Roll in bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve hot with tomato or cheese slice.
Serves 10.
Combine water, baking soda and dates in a small bowl and let stand until cool.
Mix sugar, salt and butter until light.
Beat in eggs.
Add date mixture.
Combine flour and baking powder and gradually add to the batter.
Fold in nuts.
Pour batter into a loaf pan that has been well buttered.
Let stand 20 minutes before baking.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Bake 1 1/4 hours.
Loosen loaf from the pan and invert on a cooling rack.
Pour 2 ounces or more rum or bourbon evenly over the bread before wrapping in plastic wrap for storage.
Makes one loaf.
Rinse chicken and pat dry.
Brown in margarine in skillet. Arrange in single layer in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Add onion and garlic to drippings in skillet.
Saute until tender.
Add half and half, Worcestershire sauce and pepper, stirring to deglaze.
Pour over chicken.
Bake, tightly covered, at 325° for 2 hours or until tender.
Serve over rice.
Yield: 8 servings.
Preheat oven to 325°.
Saute the onions in butter.
Arrange in the bottom of the pie shell.
Combine milk, sour cream, flour and salt.
Add to beaten eggs and mix well.
Pour over onions and bake 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with bacon and parsley.
Let set 10 minutes before cutting into 6 to 8 wedges.
Preheat oven to 325°.
Grease and flour a 5 x 9-inch loaf pan. In a large mixing bowl, stir together eggs, maple syrup and honey.
Add oil or melted butter, strawberries, milk and vanilla and mix well.
Spread cut loaf with butter.
Put in a 350 degree oven for 8 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Mix remaining ingredients together and spread on bread.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Place under broiler until it's puffy and light brown.
Score fat edges of roast.
Place meat in shallow baking dish. Combine lemon peel and juice, cooking oil, green onion, sugar, salt, Worcestershire, mustard and pepper.
Pour over roast. Cover; let stand 3 hours at room temperature or overnight in the refrigerator, turning roast several times.
Place carrots, onions and broth in 4-quart saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and cook until carrots are tender.
Remove 1 cup and chop fine.
Blend with cheese; return to saucepan.
Season to taste.
May be pureed all together, if preferred.
Melt butter in a small pan over moderate heat.
Add onion, garlic and season with sugar, thyme and pepper.
Cook 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until onions are golden in color and translucent.
Place the split bread on a baking sheet and broil until golden.
Spread half the onion and garlic in a thin layer on each half of bread.
Sprinkle each half with a handful of cheese and return to broiler for 30 seconds, or until the cheese bubbles. Makes 4 servings.
Soak the sole in lemon juice for 20 minutes and drain.
Spread the mustard on the bottom of the fish.
Generously shake on the Parmesan cheese.
Take 2 to 3 pieces of asparagus and place in the center of the fillet.
Roll the fish.
Place in greased baking dish.
Pour white wine over fish.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until fish is done.
Sprinkle with dill and paprika for color.
Combine soy sauce, water, sugar, onion, garlic salt and ginger.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Mix meat and crumbs and stir in soy mixture.

recipes.t: Traditional Leg Of Lamb(Greek Name: Arni Psito)
d: Wash leg of lamb.
Slit with sharp knife in various places on both sides of lamb.
Thinly slice garlic and insert the slices into slits made in lamb.
Season with salt and pepper.
Brush with melted butter.
Squeeze lemon juice over lamb and place in a roasting pan, fat side up.
Melt over hot water the chips and peanut butter.
Add powdered sugar and noodles; mix thoroughly.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper.
Cool in refrigerator.
In a medium bowl, stir together butter, cheese, mayonnaise, garlic, parsley and oregano; set aside.
On a lightly floured surface, roll thawed dough into a 14 x 12-inch rectangle (if dough shrinks back after rolling, let rest for a few minutes, then roll again).
Evenly coat dough with butter mixture.
From 12-inch side, roll up dough jelly-roll fashion.
Seal seams.
Divide log of dough into 12 equal slices.
Place slices in a 9-inch round cake pan.
Place slices close together (they can be touching). Let rise in warm area until rolls are almost double in size or until the rolls fill up the pan.
Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown and done in the center. Remove from oven and pan to cool on a wire rack.
Soak bread crumbs in small amount of milk.
Mix with ground beef and remaining ingredients, except cooking oil, soup and water.
Shape into patties.
Brown lightly in cooking oil.
Add soup and water.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done.
Combine all fruit, preparing bananas and peaches last.
No sugar or dressing is needed.
Serves 15.

recipes.t: Ham And Chicken In Noodle Soup(4 Servings)
d: Sprinkle the chicken wings with the wine, salt and pepper. Steam for 20 minutes.
Cut the meat into thin strips or tear it into shreds with your hands.
Heat the stock and season with salt and pepper.
