Cook the noodles in a generous amount of water. Drain and place in a warmed tureen or individual deep soup bowls. Pour the hot soup over the noodles.
Arrange the chicken, ham and snow peas on top and sprinkle with the green onion.
1. Cut the sausages, peppers and onions.
The pieces should be about 1 centimeter thick.
Combine mayonnaise and chili sauce, stirring well.
Spread butter on one side of each slice of bread; spread other side with mayonnaise mixture.
Arrange cheese, corned beef and sauerkraut on mayonnaise side of 6 slices of bread.
Top with remaining, buttered side out.
Place sandwiches on a cookie sheet and broil each side until browned.
Yield:
6 servings.
Sift first 7 ingredients into ungreased 8 x 8-inch square pan. Make 3 holes in flour mixture.
Place oil in one hole, place vinegar in 2nd hole; pour almond extract in 3rd hole.
Pour water over all and mix with fork until blended.
Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes.
Using slow cooker or crock-pot, add all cans of ingredients on high.
Brown together the ground beef, green pepper, onion, garlic, salt, pepper and chili seasoning, then add to canned ingredients. Heat through and serve.
Great with shredded Cheddar cheese on top.
On individual salad plates, place chopped endive (leave some rounds).
Sprinkle with Bleu cheese and chopped walnuts.
Soften gelatine in cold water.
Add boiling water and sugar and stir until gelatine dissolved.
Add rest of ingredients and mix well.
Pour into sherbet glasses and chill until firm.
Delicious topped with a dollop of sweetened whipped cream and sprinkled with toasted slivered almonds.
Brown roast that has been floured, salted, peppered and garlicked.
Put roast in baking pan with water to the top of roast. Cook at 300° to 350° for 2 to 3 hours.
Add carrots, potatoes and onions.
Squirt ketchup on top.
Cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until potatoes are done.
This will make your tongue slap your brains out.
Beat egg whites with baking powder until stiff, but not dry. Blend in flour, artificial sweetener, almond extract, cereal and coconut.
Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.
Yields 24 cookies.
Combine soup mix, soups, sour cream, milk, sherry and mushrooms.
Add two thirds of this mix to the 2 uncooked rices in a bowl and mix well.
Pour into a 3-quart casserole.
Place chicken breasts on rice.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Pour remaining one third of soup mix over the top.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350 covered for 11/4 hours.
Remove cover and bake 1/2 hour longer.
Crumble and brown hamburger with onion. Stir in soups and water. Sprinkle with potatoes. Bake for 1 hour at 350° or until potatoes are tender.
Dissolve jello in water.
Add cranberry sauce and lemon juice. When cool, pour into oiled loaf pan; chill until thickened.
Whip cream cheese until light and fluffy.
Fold in whipped cream, pineapple and nuts.
Spoon mixture over gelatin.
Chill until set. Yield: 10 to 12 servings.
Peel potatoes; chop roughly.
Cook in boiling salted water until tender.
Drain and mash until smooth.
Beat cream cheese and softened butter until smooth.
Add milk and eggs, beat together. Add mashed potatoes to cream cheese mixture and beat until smooth. Chop bacon, saute in frying pan for 2 minutes; add to potato mixture with chopped shallots.
Cool mixture.
Form tablespoons of mixture into balls.
Coat lightly with flour, dip in combined beaten extra egg and milk and coat with breadcrumbs.
Coat again with egg and milk mixture and breadcrumbs.
Deep fry in hot oil until golden.
Makes about 100 balls.
Melt sugar and syrup together.
Add peanut butter and mix well over low heat.
Remove from stove and add nuts, coconut and Special K.
Spread in buttered pan, 8 x 8-inch.
Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler and then spread on other mixture in pan. Do not refrigerate.
Cut in squares after it cools.
Heat oil in preheated wok and stir-fry chicken and green pepper.
When chicken turns white, add rest of ingredients and stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes.
Serve over rice.
Serves 4.
Cut 1/2 cup butter into flour.
Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of water.
Mix with fork until blended.
Round into ball and divide in half.
Spread each half onto ungreased baking sheet, making 2 strips 12 x 3-inch about 3 inches apart.
Sprinkle pecans evenly in bottom of well greased bundt pan. Combine white sugar and cinnamon.
Cut biscuits into quarters. Roll in sugar mixture and layer in pan over pecans.
Combine margarine, brown sugar and water; heat to boiling and pour over dough.
Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool 5 minutes and invert on platter.
Combine oil, vinegar, basil, salt, pepper and garlic, blending well.
Pour over onion and mushrooms.
Let stand at room temperature 2 hours, or refrigerate overnight.
Stir occasionally. Place spinach in serving dishes.
Arrange mushroom mixture over top.
Serve immediately.
Serves 6.
Melt shortening.
Brown meat.
Stir in consomme, wine, soy sauce, garlic and onion salt.
Heat to boiling.
Reduce heat to low and cook until meat is tender (a crock-pot can be used also). Blend cornstarch and water; boil until thick.
Pour over meat mixture.
Pour in rice.
Mix jello and Knox gelatine with water by package directions. Put cream cheese in while still warm.
Let congeal a little before adding remaining ingredients.
Saute peppers in butter.
Add salt, pepper, mustard, mayonnaise and Worcestershire sauce.
Gently add crab and place mixture in casserole.
Combine pimentos, crumbs, butter and paprika.
Sprinkle on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until crumbs are brown.
Beat eggs just to blend.
Add cream.
Sift in dry ingredients; beat with rotary beater until batter is smooth.
Let stand for 2 hours to allow batter to thicken.
Heat griddle to 375° or until water "dances" when dropped onto it.
Butter lightly.
Beat batter again.
Drop 2 tablespoons of batter for each pancake.
Turn when brown.
Fill each pancake with strawberries and roll up.
Arrange 3 on each serving plate.
Sift powdered sugar over all and top middle pancake with whipped cream.
Garnish with a "perfect" strawberry on top.
The pancakes themselves, without the filling, are good with just strawberry butter.
In medium-size pan, bring the milk to a boil.
Drizzle the rice in slowly so that the milk continues to boil.
Add sugar, cinnamon, salt, rind and butter; stir occasionally.
Boil, uncovered, for about 5 minutes.
Remove the rind and cinnamon stick and pour the mixture into a 2-quart bowl or individual dishes.
Sprinkle lightly with cinnamon.
Serve with a dollop of light cream.
Serves 6 to 8.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease 13 x 9-inch pan.
Crush 4 cups of cereal with bottom of a cup in the baking pan.
Spread evenly a layer of peanuts, raisins, chocolate pieces and the remaining 2 cups cereal.
Drizzle sweetened condensed milk evenly over mixture. Bake 20 to 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Kids love them.

recipes.t: Baked Ham With Macaroni And Veggies
d: Prepare macaroni/fettucini, following directions except add an extra 1/2 cup water plus the vegetables.
When noodles/macaroni are done, remove from heat, drain and add cheese sauce.
Mix well and serve with ham.
Wash ribs well.
Put salt, pepper, Five Spice, Dale's and Italian dressing on meat to marinate.
Wrap in foil and put in refrigerator overnight.
Heat grill or smoker.
Place meat on grill for 3 to 4 hours.
Add soaked wood chips.
Close lid and cook, turning every hour.
Cook macaroni as directed.
Melt butter in a saucepan. Add onion and green pepper. Cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Cut dried beef into small pieces. Add to onion mixture and continue cooking until brown. Stir in soup, milk, pepper and paprika.
Heat to boiling.
Combine macaroni with beef sauce.
Put in casserole. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
In large skillet, saute ground beef and onion, stirring frequently until meat is tender. Drain off fat.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Simmer 20 to 25 minutes.
Serve topped with shredded cheese, chopped chili peppers, and sliced green onions, as desired.
Combine
sugar,
flour and salt and stir in milk slowly. Cook over
boiling water until thickened, stirring constantly. Cover and
cook
minutes longer, stirring constantly.
Add mixture to
egg
yolks,
stirring
vigorously;
cook
1 minute longer. Add
butter, vanilla and pecans.
Cool.
Place filling into a 9 inch baked pastry shell.
Top with meringue.
Bake cake or use the shortcake sponges.
Make sauce of the brown sugar and water, boiled for 1 or 2 minutes.
Place sliced bananas on the cake and pour sauce over them.
Top with Cool Whip.
Mix until soft the brie, milk and Nature's Seasons.
Set aside.
Top and tail the peas and blanch in boiling water for 3 minutes, then rinse in cold water immediately.
Drain and pat dry. With sharp vegetable parer, split snow peas on curved side. Place cheese in a pastry bag and squeeze in pea pod.
Serve chilled.
Brush chicken with melted
butter
and arrange in glass baking dish.
Blend soup and sour cream together until smooth. Stir in rest of ingredients;
pour over
chicken
and bake at 350° for 40 to 45
minutes
or until
fork-tender
and nicely browned.
Serve from dish.

In a large iron skillet, melt the butter. Add a layer of sliced potatoes, onions and bell pepper. Repeat layers until all vegetables are in the skillet. Add water. Cover and cook over medium heat for 35 minutes. To serve, drain off any liquid or fat; turn out onto a platter and garnish with paprika and bacon, if desired. Yield: 8 servings.
Dissolve gelatin in the boiling water.
Add cranberry sauce. Stir until completely mixed.
Add the orange juice and grated rind.
Chill until partially set.
Grate the apple.
Pare the grapefruit.
Remove all membrane and cut into small segments. Fold apples and the grapefruit sections into gelatin.
Turn into oiled one-quart mold.
Chill.
Serves 6 to 8.
Dissolve gelatine in hot water.
Add sugar, lemon and pineapple juice.
Set partially.
Add remaining ingredients. Chill in oiled pan until set.
Should be made a day or two before serving.
May be kept (refrigerated) for several weeks.
Freeze a
x 3-inch chunk
of
streak-of-lean meat. Slice thin.
Wash and boil, covered, at least 5 minutes. Drain and pat dry.
Dip in buttermilk and into flour (self-rising). Fry to a golden brown in a skillet with 1/2-inch oil on medium heat.
Drain on
paper towel. It's
crisp and golden brown. Serve with
hot biscuits, sweet corn, sliced tomatoes and iced tea.
Makes the best meal.
Melt 1/4 cup margarine and line casserole dish with it.
Toss 1/2 of cooked spaghetti in melted butter.
Pour 1 1/2 cans of tomato sauce over it.
Add 1/2 pound pepperoni, 1/2 pound cooked hamburg with onions and 1/2 can grated cheese.
Add remaining spaghetti and repeat.
Bake, uncovered, for 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.t: Oven Barbecue Brisket(Must Prepare Ahead.  Serves 8 To 10.)
d: Sprinkle each side with celery salt, onion salt and garlic salt.
Pour liquid smoke over brisket and place in refrigerator overnight.
Turn once or twice.
When ready to bake, sprinkle salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce in same pan with all ingredients.
Cover and bake for 5 hours at 275°.
Add 6 ounces barbecue sauce and bake 1 more hour, uncovered.
Layer sliced potatoes in bottom of baking dish.
Spread 1/2 of stewed tomatoes on top of potatoes.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, oregano, salt, pepper and 2 tablespoons olive oil.
Place salmon on top of potatoes.
Cover with tomatoes, cheese, oregano, salt, pepper and olive oil.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender.
Slice beef into very thin strips.
In medium bowl, whisk together cornstarch and broth until smooth; set aside.
In large skillet over medium-high heat, heat half the oil.
Cook beef in 2 batches, until browned, stirring often.
Set beef aside.
Heat rest of oil.
Add onion, celery and garlic powder; cook over medium heat, until tender-crisp.
Pour off fat.
Add tomatoes.
Stir cornstarch mixture and add.
Cook until mixture boils and thickens, stirring constantly.
Return beef to pan; heat through.
Serve over rice.
Grease an 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish.
Mix sugar, corn syrup and water in a 2-quart glass measure.
Microwave, uncovered, on High, stirring twice, 15 to 17 minutes, until syrup reaches a hard-ball stage or forms a hard but pliable ball when a small amount is dropped in cold water.
Meanwhile, beat egg whites in a medium-sized bowl until soft peaks form.
Gradually add gelatin, beating until whites are stiff and glossy.
While beating constantly, slowly pour the hot syrup into the egg-white mixture and continue to beat 6 to 8 minutes longer, until mixture is very thick.
Stir in nuts and vanilla.
Spread evenly in prepared dish. Let stand at room temperature until completely cool and set, about 4 hours or overnight.
Brown meat and onion; drain off grease.
Stir in milk and cheese until well blended.
Add remaining ingredients.
Turn into a 2 to 2 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
In medium saucepan, melt butter and chocolate over low heat. Can melt in microwave.
Cool several minutes.
Combine sugar and sour cream and beat until smooth.
Frost cooled cake.
Cook noodles per directions; drain.
Mix all other ingredients saving 1/2 of Monterey Jack cheese for topping.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish, sprayed with Pam.
Bake at 350°, covered, for 30 minutes.
Bake, uncovered, for 10 minutes.
Serves 10 easily.

recipes.t: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Wheat Germ Cookies
d: Cream butter and sugar.
Add milk, vanilla and eggs.
Beat. Add flour, wheat germ, baking soda and powder.
Beat.
Add oatmeal, chocolate chips and nuts.
Bake at 350° until set.
Brown meat with onions; drain.
In casserole dish, add meat, creamed corn, tomato soup, noodles and olives.
Mix and add soup can of water.
Cover and bake 45 minutes at 350°, then uncover and bake for 15 more minutes.
Top with cheese, let melt and serve. Serves 4 to 6.
Soak overnight or by quick method 2 cups dry pigeon peas, pinto beans or kidney beans, water and salt.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer just until tender, about 40 minutes.
Drain beans, reserving liquid.
Heat in large covered skillet the oil or margarine; add garlic, green onions, tomato, parsley, pepper and drained beans.
Saute about 5 minutes.
Add rice and reserved bean liquid.
Bring to a boil; cover, reduce heat to simmer and cook 20 to 25 minutes without stirring.
Brown chicken on all sides in oil in large skillet.
Remove from skillet.
Cook and stir vegetables and garlic in same skillet over medium heat, 4 to 5 minutes or until tender.
Stir in sauce and wine.
Add chicken and cover.
Reduce heat to low and simmer 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
Let berries thaw and put through sieve if you wish.
Combine concentrate of lemonade with berries and berry juice. Add ginger ale and sparkling water just before serving.
Pour over ice in punch bowl.
Sliced bananas make an interesting garnish for this rosy lemonade punch.
Makes about 36 (4 ounce) servings.
Drain pineapple, reserving juice.
Add water to juice to make 1 cup.
Dissolve strawberry gelatin in 1 cup boiling water.
Add 1/2 cup of the measured liquid and chill until thickened.
Add pineapple.
Pour gelatin mixture into mold.
Chill until set, but not firm.
Meanwhile, dissolve lime gelatin in 1 cup boiling water.
Add remaining measured liquid and the lemon juice. Gradually blend into softened cheese, beating until smooth.
Chill until thickened.
Blend in whipped topping.
Spoon into mold over clear layer.
Chill until firm, about 4 hours.
Unmold.
Garnish with pineapple slices, cherries and mint leaves, if desired. Makes about 5 or 10 servings.
Preheat oven to 325°.
In a large bowl, combine sugar, eggs, oleo, syrup, Crisco and vanilla. Beat until creamy.
Brown 209 in hot oil.
Blend in flour, seasoning, catsup, water and celery.
Cook until celery is tender, stirring constantly for about 5 minutes.
Add cheese and leave on stove until melted.
Split buns and remove some of the soft centers. Fill with mixture and toast in oven.
Serve immediately.

recipes.t: Green Beans In Tomato Basil Sauce
d: Cook beans until tender.
Meanwhile, prepare sauce.
Lightly brown the garlic in olive oil.
Remove garlic.
Let oil cool a bit and add tomato and basil; fry for 10 minutes over medium heat. Add a little water if mixture seems too dry.
Then add cooked beans with 1/4 cup more water and stir on low heat until water is evaporated and beans are just lightly frying in the tomato-oil sauce.
Salt and pepper to taste.
You may serve at this point or even better refrigerated for a few hours.
Reheat.
Serve. Freezes well.
Serves 4 to 6.
Combine dry pancake mix with sugar and water.
Mix well. (Batter should be quite thick.)
Dry hot dogs by patting with a paper towel.
(Batter sticks best to dry hot dogs.)
Dip hot dogs in batter, then roll in corn chips to coat well.
Fry in small amount of hot oil until golden brown and crusty.
Put beer in blender first.
Blend in other ingredients.
Remove insides of bread loaf and replace with cheese mixture.
Dunk removed pieces of bread into cheese mixture.
Drain pears, reserving 1/2 cup.
Dice pears and set aside. Dissolve gelatin and salt in boiling water; add cold water, pear syrup and lemon juice.
Measure 1 1/4 cups into an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan (I use metal mold sprayed with Pam).
Chill until set, but not firm.
Gelatin should be sticky to the touch.
Cook turkey about 5 minutes or until no longer pink.
Add taco seasonings and water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Place kidney beans in an 8 x 2-inch casserole.
Layer cooked turkey on top of beans, then tomatoes.
In a small bowl, mix corn bread mix, adding water according to package directions, with onion, cheese and peppers. Spread mixture on top of turkey and beans.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until corn bread mix is golden brown.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
Combine jelly and water in a saucepan; cook over low heat, stirring frequently until jelly melts.
Let cool.
Stir in juices; cover and chill.
Just before serving, stir in ginger ale.
Yields 7 cups.
Drizzle fish with lemon juice; let sit.

Put in baking pan. Mix mayonnaise, dill weed and 2 tablespoons lemon juice. Brush on one side and grill or broil. Turn fish and brush on the other side; cook (5 to 8 minutes per side depending on thickness of fish).

recipes.t: Italian Zucchini Quiche(A.K.A.:  Immigrant Pie, Italian Pie)
d: Saute zucchini and onion in butter for 10 minutes.
Stir in parsley, salt, pepper, garlic powder, basil and oregano.
Combine eggs and cheese and stir into zucchini mixture.
Separate crescent rolls into 8 triangles and press over sides of ungreased 10-inch pie pan to form crust.
Spread with mustard and pour vegetable mixture into crust.
Bake in a 375° oven for 20 minutes or until center is set.
Cool 10 minutes before serving.
Serves 6 to 8.
Combine sugar and cornstarch.
Slowly add scalded milk to beaten egg yolks.
Stir in sugar mixture.
Cook and stir in top of double boiler until custard coats spoon.
Add vanilla.
To one cup of custard, add chocolate bits.
Stir until melted.
Pour on cooled pie shell.
Soften gelatin in cold water.
Add to remaining hot custard.
Stir until dissolved.
Chill until slightly thick. Beat egg whites, adding sugar gradually until mixture stands in stiff peaks.
Fold custard-gelatin mixture.
Pour over chocolate layer and chill until set.
Garnish with whipped cream or shaved chocolate.
Prepare pudding mix according to package directions, using milk.
Pour into bowl.
Stir in cookie pieces, marshmallows, chocolate morsels and nuts.
In each of 6 parfait glasses, layer a heaping 1/4 cup pudding with 1 tablespoon whipped topping; repeat layers.
Top with chocolate-covered graham crackers, chocolate morsels and nuts.
Makes 6 servings.
Clean birds and season with salt and pepper.
Fill cavities with onion, parsley, onion tops and bell peppers.
Cut sausage in small pieces and add this to the bird's cavities.
Wrap birds with bacon strips and bake at 375° for 60 to 65 minutes, applying sherry sparingly over birds every 15 minutes.
Cook chocolate pudding.
Cool for 5 minutes.
Combine with dry German chocolate cake mix.
Mix by hand.
Pour into lightly greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
It will be thick.
Leave it a little lumpy in the pan.
Sprinkle chocolate chips on top with nuts.
Cool completely, then put powdered sugar in strainer to decorate.
Mix together first 3 ingredients and pour into baking dish (I spray with Pam).
Pat to cover bottom of dish.
Pour in apple pie filling.
Spread over cake mixture.
Mix brown sugar, cinnamon and chopped nuts.
Pour over mixture.
Mix sour cream, 1 egg and vanilla.
Drizzle over cake.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.
Stir broccoli, onion, garlic and pepper together in 8-inch dish.
Cover tightly and microwave on High 3 to 4 minutes; stir. Put chicken and water chestnuts on top of first layer.
Cover with waxed paper and microwave on High 3 minutes.
Mix sour cream and milk and pour over second layer.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Cover with waxed paper and microwave on 70% power for 3 to 5 minutes.

recipes.t: Oil And Garlic Sauce(All'Olio E Aglio)
d: Heat oil in skillet; add garlic and cook until browned.
Stir in water; add parsley and pepper.
Simmer about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese (optional).
Pour over pasta and eat.
Crumble beef and saute with onions until meat is slightly browned.
Stir in chili, chili powder, chicken soup, hominy and olives.
Spread in 2-quart casserole.
Cover and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Sprinkle with cheese and continue baking 5 to 10 minutes longer.
Brown pork chops in heavy frying pan over medium heat, turning as needed to brown evenly; drain off excess drippings.
Sprinkle chops with salt.
Place 2 lemon slices on each chop.
Mix catsup and honey; pour over chops.
Cover; cook slowly until chops are fork-tender, about 1 hour.
Remove chops from sauce; set aside to keep warm.
Blend water and cornstarch; stir into pan drippings. Cook, stirring constantly, until sauce thickens.
Serve with chops or rice.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.
Brown hamburg, celery and onion in melted butter or margarine.
Add other ingredients and simmer slowly, about 1 hour.
Spread mayonnaise on bread slices; then place layers of first 5 ingredients on one slice of bread.
Put cheese on top of this. Broil until cheese melts.
Put top slice of bread on.
Cut in half and serve!
Combine molasses, butter and brown sugar in large pot; bring to boil.
Remove from heat.
Add 1 cup flour; let cool.
Dissolve the baking soda in the vinegar.
Beat egg.
Add spices to egg. Add egg mixture to soda and vinegar mixture.
Combine with molasses mixture.
Add flour until it is a good consistency for rolling (about 4 to 5 cups).
Rolls out extremely well.
Never sticks.
Good for cookie cutters.
Bake at 350° for about 8 minutes.
These cookies stay nice and soft if stored in an airtight can.
Dough refrigerates and freezes well.
Boil together the first 4 ingredients until soft ball forms when dropped in cold water. Combine the remaining 3 ingredients. Beat until smooth.
Pour hot mixture over butter-sugar mixture and beat until smooth and creamy.
Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces.
Place in small bowl.
Add sherry, soy and ginger.
Stir to coat.
Stir broth into cornstarch; set aside.
Use 10-inch pizza pan.
Spread cream cheese over the bottom of pan.
Add, in the order given, all remaining ingredients.
Cover with Saran Wrap and refrigerate overnight.
Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Mix well.
Add sour milk.
Sift flour, baking soda and cream of tartar.
Add to creamed mixture.
Mix well.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Stir together the crumbs, margarine and granulated sugar; press onto bottom and 1/2 inch up sides of a 9-inch spring-form pan.
Bake 10 minutes and cool.
Mix until creamy the cake mix, eggs, water and Dream Whip. Spread rhubarb and sugar over top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cake will crack on top.
Heat oven to 350°.
Oil a 2-quart casserole lightly. Heat oil in medium saucepan on medium-high heat. Add onion. Cook and stir until tender.
Stir in flour, salt, pepper and 1/8 teaspoon paprika. Blend in milk. Cook and stir on medium-high heat until sauce comes to a boil and is thickened.
Layer 1/3 of the potatoes on bottom of casserole. Top with 1/3 of the sauce.
Repeat twice. Cover.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Uncover. Bake 15 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender. Sprinkle with paprika and parsley. Serves 8.
Score salami (crisscross) on top.
Bake in 325° oven for about 2 hours.
Serve on small cocktail rye bread and pumpernickel bread.
Beat eggs, add oil, milk, sugar, flour and meal.
Add chopped ingredients, cheese and corn.
Stir well.
Grease a large iron skillet and sprinkle with meal.
Heat slightly.
Pour in batter. Bake at 400° about 45 minutes or until browned.
Melt margarine in 3-quart saucepan.
Add onions, cook until tender.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cover; heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer 15 to 20 minutes.
Simmering time may vary due to type of pan and amount of broth used.
Adjust recipe as needed.
(If you have a rice cooker, coat bottom of pan with nonstick vegetable spray, add all ingredients and push the cook button!)
Serves 4 to 6.
Mix flour, butter and walnuts; press in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes; cool.
Soften cream cheese; mix with powdered sugar and spread over crust.
Mix pudding as directed on package except use only 3 cups milk.
Add 1/2 of large carton Cool Whip with pudding; place mixture on top of crust.
Top with remaining Cool Whip.
For best results, let set in refrigerator 1 day.

Place pork chops in baking dish. Cover pork chops and bottom of baking dish with Italian dressing. Sprinkle with garlic powder, salt and pepper to taste. To spice it up a little, shake a few drops of Texas Pete or some other hot sauce on each pork chop.
Mash bananas and add dates and oil.
Mix with fork.
Add remaining ingredients, mix well and let stand for 3 minutes.
Bake for 25 minutes at 350° on ungreased cookie sheet.
Store in icebox.
Scrub potatoes thoroughly and rub skins with oil; bake for 1 hour or until done (or microwave).
Let cool to the touch.
Slice skin away from top of each potato; carefully scoop out pulp, leaving shells intact.
Mash pulp; stir in butter and next 6 ingredients.
Spoon potato mixture into shells.
Top with marshmallows and pecans.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until marshmallows are golden brown.
Follow directions on package for cooking rice.
Add ground beef and onion after having browned them together.
Cook on low heat for 15 minutes or until rice is tender.
Add sugar, salt and pepper the last 5 minutes of cooking time.
Makes approximately 4 servings.
Dissolve gelatin in hot applesauce.
Add pineapple and 7-Up. Mix well.
Put in mold and chill.
Beat hot apples with sugar and butter.
When slightly cooled, add whiskey, cream, nutmeg and beaten egg yolks.
Add beaten whites last and more whiskey if you wish.
Pour into pastry lined pie pan (no upper crust); bake at 425° for 10 minutes to set crust.
Reduce heat to 325° and bake for 30 minutes longer. Decorate cooled pie with sweetened whipped cream.
Mix
sugar,
cocoa,
margarine and
milk
in saucepan; bring to rolling boil.
Boil for 2 minutes; remove from heat. Quickly stir in remaining ingredients.
Spoon by the teaspoonful onto waxed paper.
Let cool.
Boil chicken; debone and cut into bite size pieces.
Chop onion and chili peppers.
Cut tomatoes into bite size pieces.
Add mushroom soup, salt and pepper.
Mix together beef, onion, green pepper, bread crumbs, salt, egg, ketchup, horseradish, mustard and milk; blend well.
Pack firmly into 9 1/2 x 5 1/4 x 2 3/4-inch loaf pan.
Spread ketchup over top of loaf.
Bake in oven at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Crush cornflakes to make 1 cup.
Beat egg whites, adding sugar gradually, until stiff and glossy.
Fold in salt, cocoa, vanilla, cornflakes and walnuts.
Drop tablespoons 2 inches apart on greased baking sheets.
Bake at 300° for 25 minutes.
Makes 2 1/2 dozen.
Cream sugars and margarine until fluffy.
Add eggs and vanilla; beat well.
Stir together the flour, baking powder, soda and salt.
Add to creamed mixture.
Stir in oats, raisins and coconut.
Form into 1-inch balls.
Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Place rump roast in a slow cooker.
Pour in condensed cream of mushroom soup and condensed beef broth.
Cook on low for about 8 hours.

Cook the noodles according to the package directions; drain. Meanwhile, in a soup pot, cook the sausage over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes, or until no pink remains, stirring to crumble the sausage; drain.
Add the noodles and the remaining ingredients; mix well.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, or until heated through and the cheese is melted. Serve immediately.
Mix milk, egg, honey and vanilla in blender until frothy.
Add banana and unthawed strawberries.
Mix until thick.
Combine cake mix, one egg and margarine.
Press into 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.
Combine cream cheese, powdered sugar, lemon extract and 3 eggs.
Beat well.
Pour over dough layer.
Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.
Cool overnight.
Yields 4 dozen.
Crush graham crackers.
Put milk in top of double boiler; add marshmallows and heat until marshmallows are melted.
Drain cherries; cut in halves and add all the fruit and nuts to the crushed crackers.
Pour the milk and marshmallow mixture over the cracker mixture.
This is really an icebox cake but I baked mine one hour in a slow oven (250°) as it gives the nut meats a toasted flavor.
Be sure to mix well and bake in a greased, paper lined loaf pan.
Mix shortening and sugar until creamed.
Add egg and cream. Add bananas and mix well.
Add dry ingredients and mix well.
Add vanilla.
Put into muffin or loaf pan that has been greased.
Bake muffins at 375° for 15 to 18 minutes.
Bake loaf at 350° for about 60 minutes.
The riper the bananas, the better the muffins.
Cream Crisco and brown sugar.
Add vanilla.
Beat in eggs. Mix flour, soda and salt.
Mix into sugar mixture.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheets. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.
Remove to cooling racks.
Makes 4 to 5 dozen.
Heat oil in 2-quart saucepan.
When hot, add onion and celery. Cook over moderate heat, stirring occasionally with wooden spoon, until onions are tender, not brown.
This will take 5 minutes. Add hot dogs and cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook rotini according to directions on the package, then drain and rinse several times with cold water.
Drain again.
Combine cooled rotini, pineapple chunks, grapes, coconut and slivered almonds.
Toss with the yogurt.
Add mandarin oranges, strawberries and kiwi.
Toss, then chill 4 hours.
Serves 8 to 10.
Layer cream cheese, beans and cheese in microwave dish.
Cook on High 2 to 3 minutes uncovered until cheese melts.
Serve with tortilla chips.
Place serving size portions of fish on well-greased grill. Spray grill well before putting on fish.
Baste fish with sauce and sprinkle with paprika.
Cook about 5 inches from hot coals for 8 minutes.
Baste with sauce, then turn and cook for 7 to 10 minutes longer or until fish flakes or turns shiny white.
Serves 4.
Combine sugar, syrup and water in saucepan.
With candy thermometer bring to 300°.
In cast-iron skillet (buttered) add peanut butter.
Add hot syrup and stir.
Put on buttered cookie sheet.
Cut into squares.
Cook potatoes; combine with remaining ingredients, except celery.
Cover.
Refrigerate overnight.
Just before serving, add celery and Boiled Dressing.
In a medium saucepan, combine flour, sugar and milk; mix well. Add peas and pepper; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; simmer for 10 to 12 minutes or until peas are heated through and sauce has thickened. Yield: 4 servings.
Brown meat and onion.
In a 3-quart pot, place chili seasoning, stewed tomatoes, tomato sauce, beans and garlic salt. Add meat; bring mixture to boiling.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Stir in olives and heat a few minutes longer.
Serve topped with a dollop of sour cream and chopped green onion.
Makes 6 servings. Good served with corn muffins or corn chips and lettuce wedges with a creamy dressing.
Cut wings into 3 pieces, discarding wing tip pieces.
Place remaining pieces in foil-lined 15 x 8-inch baking pan.
Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl.
Brush over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours, turning chicken and basting with sauce frequently.
Serves 12.
Brown meat in olive oil.
Add onion, cook until tender. Stir in other ingredients
in
order
given
except olives and cheese. Bring the mixture to
a
boil, reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Spoon into baking dish and top with cheese.
Broil
until
cheese
is
melted and garnish with stuffed olives.
In a large bowl, beat together eggs, milk, taco sauce, onion and salt until well blended, reserving a few pieces of chilies for garnish.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Pour into 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
Bake in preheated 350° oven until knife inserted near center comes out clean, about 35 to 40 minutes.
Garnish with reserved chilies.
Slowly warm cream cheese and stir in salsa and chicken.
Wrap in warm tortillas and serve with lettuce, onion, tomatoes, etc.
Trim pork; slice into 2-inch wide pieces.
Flatten with a mallet.
Coat pork with mix of flour, salt and pepper.
Fry in 1 1/2 tablespoons margarine.
Add cider vinegar to pan dregs; cook down.
Add cream; simmer for 15 minutes.
Add mustard and remaining 1 tablespoon margarine.
Cook 2 minutes.
On ungreased jelly roll pan, lay out the rolls, pinching together to make a large rectangle.
Bake 10 minutes in a 400° oven until golden brown.
Cool completely.
Mix artichoke hearts, 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese, salad mix, mayonnaise and Parmesan in bowl. Spread onto crust.
Sprinkle with remaining Cheddar cheese and paprika.
Bake in a 325° oven for 10 minutes, or until cheese melts.
Cut into squares.
Fry hamburger.
Set aside in casserole dish.
In saucepan, boil cauliflower until tender.
When done, layer over hamburger. Combine butter, flour, milk and water.
Cook on low until thickened to gravy.
Pour over hamburger/cauliflower.
Top with shredded Cheddar cheese.
Bake 1/2 hour at 375°.
Serve over mashed potatoes.
Trim fat from steak.
Combine orange juice and next 3 ingredients in an 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish; add steak, turning to coat.
Cover and marinate 10 minutes.
Remove steak from marinade, reserving 1/4 cup marinade.
Place steak on a rack in a roasting pan coated with cooking spray.
Broil 5 1/2 inches from heat 5 minutes.
Turn steak and broil an additional 2 minutes. Top steak with green onions; broil 2 minutes or to desired degree of doneness.
Slice steak diagonally across grain into 1/4-inch slices.
Place steak and onions on a serving platter; set aside and keep warm.
Peel, core and cut tomatoes into wedges.
Slice zucchini. Over low heat, saute onions and garlic in butter until onions are tender and golden.
Stir in basil, sugar, salt and pepper.
Add zucchini and cook about 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes; cover and cook 5 minutes longer or until zucchini is tender and tomatoes are heated through.
Makes 6 servings.
Can be done in microwave.
Chop or cut into small pieces marshmallows, cherries, nuts, prunes and dates.
Mix marshmallows with cream.
Roll graham crackers into fine crumbs.
Combine chopped dried fruit with crumbs mixed together.
Stir mixture into cream and marshmallows. Mold and wrap in foil; refrigerate for 24 hours.
Slice and serve.
Put chocolate in first, then nuts.
I want some pretzels and grapes in and candy last.
Layer cooked noodles in greased casserole dish. Put soups on top, mix rest of ingredient together and pour over top. Cover and bake 350 degrees for one hour.
In a large saucepan, heat butter and vegetable oil.
Add onions, leeks and potatoes until lightly brown, 10 to 12 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Pour in chicken broth and milk. Increase heat and bring to boil, stirring constantly.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer for approximately 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Remove and pour through strainer using back of spoon.
Discard pulp.
Return to saucepan and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve with warm crusty bread.
Serves 4.
Cut a thin slice from stem end of peppers.
Remove seeds and ribs.
Precook peppers in boiling water for 5 minutes; drain. Combine meat, rice, seasonings and egg.
Mix tomato sauce and gravy; add 1 cup to meat-rice mixture.
Stuff peppers.
Place in shallow baking dish.
Pour remaining tomato sauce mixture around peppers.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Makes 6 servings.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Sift flour and salt on waxed paper. Beat together margarine, sugar, egg and vanilla in large bowl until well mixed.
Blend in flour mixture.
Stir in chocolate pieces.
Shape dough on lightly floured surface into logs (2 x 1/2-inch).
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake in 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes.
Cool on wire racks.
Dip ends of cookies into Chocolate Coating; roll ends in chopped nuts.
Place on waxed paper until set.
Wash and drain greens early in day and chill in a crisper. Mash garlic and salt together until garlic disintegrates.
Add salt mix to mayonnaise, vinegar and Worcestershire sauce. Chill. Mix all and add dressing and crackers when ready to serve.
Place each chicken piece between 2 sheets of waxed paper; flatten to 1/4-inch thickness, using a meat mallet or a rolling pin.
Combine flour and pepper; stir well.
Dredge chicken in egg and then in flour mixture, shaking off excess flour; set aside.
Cook and mash potatoes, beat in rest of ingredients.
Top with 2 Tbsp. melted butter and 1/2 c. shredded Cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes in buttered 2 qt. casserole dish.
Mix salad dressing, mayonnaise and sugar.
Set aside.
Rinse baby green peas with cold water and drain.
Do not cook.
Sprinkle fish with salt and pepper.
Dip into salad dressing, then into crumbs.
Fry over medium heat in small amount of hot oil until crisp and fish flakes.
Serve with lemon.
Cook rice as directed but use olive oil instead of vegetable oil and omit the salt.
When rice is done, sprinkle soy sauce and toss until rice is brown (lite).
Drain bean sprouts well; add to rice.
Add chopped sliced ham, shrimp, (pork), garlic powder and water chestnuts.
Scramble eggs and fry in butter; add to rice. Top rice with raw scallions.
Mix and serve.
Peel eggplant; cut in slices.
Cook in boiling, salted water for 10 or 15 minutes or until tender.
Drain and mash.
Saute onion in butter until soft.
Combine eggplant, onion, crumbs, soup, 3/4 cup cheese, pimentos and seasonings.
Add well beaten eggs.
Pour into greased baking dish.
Top with other 1/4 cup of grated cheese.
Bake in moderately hot oven for about 30 minutes at 375°.
Dissolve jello in hot water.
Blend in mayonnaise, cold water, vinegar and salt.
Chill until partially set.
Beat until fluffy. Add remaining ingredients.
Pour into individual molds or a 1-quart mold.
Chill until set.
Brown bacon; remove from pan and set aside.
Reserve 1/2 cup drippings.
In remaining drippings, saute onion and celery until tender.
Mix in 1/2 cup flour.
Add vegetable juice, tomatoes, stock, sugar, oregano and reserved bacon.
Add additional flour that has been mixed with a little water, if mixture is not thick enough.
Texture should be similar to that of a thick white sauce. Simmer about 30 minutes.
Add lettuce to soup in pot and serve immediately or top individual servings with lettuce.
Makes about 2 gallons or 15 to 20 large servings.
Dissolve jello in hot water.
Add pineapple (not drained). Stir well and cool in the refrigerator for a few minutes.
Place sour cream in same bowl.
Stir and add nuts.
Store in refrigerator.
Place scallops in a bowl.
Add vermouth, garlic, salt and pepper and mix well.
Let stand for 1 hour, then drain well.
Pat dry with paper towels.
Roll scallops in bread crumbs and shake off excess.
Melt butter over fairly high heat and saute scallops 2 minutes until golden.
Remove with slotted spoon.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges.
Puree about 2 cups strawberries in blender.
Slice the rest. Reserve 3 for garnish.
In saucepan, combine sugar, gelatin, salt, water and lemon juice.
Stir over low heat until dissolved.
Add pureed strawberries; cool thoroughly.
Fold sliced strawberries and Kirsch into gelatin mixture.
Whip 1/2 cup of the cream; gently fold into gelatin mixture.
Pour into crust.
Chill for 3 hours or until firm.
Add cream just before serving.
Preheat oven to 325°.
Score ham with diagonal cuts in a diamond pattern.
Place ham on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Insert a meat thermometer; bake ham until thermometer registers 140° (about 2 hours).
Meanwhile, in a large saucepan combine cider, honey, vinegar, mustard, and chili powder.
Bring to boiling; reduce heat.
Boil gently, uncovered, about 15 minutes, stirring frequently (watch carefully, as mixture will bubble up). You should have about 2 cups of mixture.
Remove half of the mixture to a small bowl. Stir in butter and 1/4 teaspoon of the pie spice; set aside for sauce.
Cook noodles according to package directions.
Drain and keep warm.
In large saucepan, melt butter.
Stir in sour cream, heavy cream, cheese, chives, salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Cook over low heat until hot and bubbly.
Add noodles.
Serve immediately.
Serves 4 or more.
Cut cream cheese and margarine into Bisquick until crumbly. Blend in 1/3 cup milk.
Knead on floured surface.
On wax paper, roll dough into a 12 x 8-inch rectangle.
Turn onto greased baking sheet; remove paper.
Spread preserves down center of dough.
Make 2 1/2-inch cuts at 1-inch intervals on long sides.
Fold strips over filling.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes or until brown.
Mix lettuce, onions, bell pepper, olives and beans.
Just before serving, add Fritos, cheese and dressing.
Shake pepper, salt and garlic over each breast.
Mix wine, Worcestershire and oregano.
Put chicken in shallow casserole. Pour wine mixture over; cover with plastic wrap (punctured). Microwave on High for 15 minutes.
Let stand for 5 minutes.

recipes.t: Stack-Up Vegetable Or Seven Layer Salad
d: In a 2-quart serving bowl, layer lettuce, pepper, corn, zucchini, tomatoes and celery.
Spread mayo or other dressing over celery.
Seal edges of bowl tightly with plastic wrap.
Chill several hours or overnight.
Sprinkle with cheese and bacon before serving.
Put Saran Wrap into mold.
Press crabmeat into cream cheese in mold.
Cover with Saran Wrap.
Refrigerate.
Blend shortening and sugar.
Add eggs, well beaten.
Add soda, flour and salt, which have been mixed together.
Add hot water. Mix together until well blended.
Lastly, add nuts and chips. Flavor with vanilla; drop by half teaspoons onto a greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Yields 150 cookies.
Boil the cauliflower.
Boil shrimp.
Mix and simmer the shrimp soup, sour cream and a small amount of milk to thin mixture. Drain shrimp and add to soup mixture.
Pour over drained cauliflower.
Dissolve sugar in boiling water.
Refrigerate until well chilled.
Pour chilled mixture into chilled punch bowl.
Add lemon juice, apricot nectar and frozen juice concentrates.
Stir until well combined.
Add ginger ale.
Top with scoops of sherbet; garnish with fresh mint leaves, if desired.
Brown bacon.
Cook rice while bacon is frying.
Remove cooked bacon.
Drain half of bacon grease.
Saute green onions and mushrooms in leftover grease.
Push to side of pan.
Add eggs and scramble.
Crumble bacon.
Add to pan.
Stir.
Add cooked rice and soy sauce.
Season with garlic powder to taste.
Stir well. Simmer 10 minutes.
In a medium, combine mayo, sour cream, blue cheese, onions and bouillon. Mix well. Stir in nuts, cover and chill. Stir before serving. Serve with vegetables.
Mix together the rice, cheese, parsley, onion and salt. Combine eggs, milk and Worcestershire sauce and add it to the rice mixture.
Mix well.
Pour into a greased 10 x 6-inch baking dish (or spray with Pam cooking spray, then pour in rice mixture). Bake in a slow 325° oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until set. Serves 6 to 9.
Toss in bowl lettuce, eggs and onion.
Whisk together Miracle Whip, vinegar and sugar until smooth.
Combine.
Dissolve chocolate in 5 teaspoons boiling water.
Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs, one at a time, mixing well.
Mix flour and baking powder.
Add alternately with milk; mix thoroughly.
Stir in vanilla.
Grease three layer cake pans.
Bake at 350°
until done for 25 to 30 minutes.

In a large saucepan, cook the onion, celery, garlic and curry powder in margarine about 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Stir in cornstarch and bouillon granules. Blend in tomato paste. Stir in water and applesauce. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 2 minutes more. Remove from heat. Cool saucepan quickly in ice water, stirring occasionally.
Pour into 1 1/2 cup containers and freeze.
Blend the first 4 ingredients well.
Chill 4 hours.
Scrape out pineapple half and fill with mixture.
Top with almonds. Serve with crackers.
Mix onion, garlic and beef and brown lightly.
Add tomato sauce and 3/4 of the olives.
Mix sour cream, cottage cheese and chopped chilies.
Set this mixture aside.
Crush tortilla chips and put into a baking dish that has been oiled or "Pamed" for the crust. Save some of the chips for garnish.
Spoon meat mixture over the chips, spread cheese mixture over the meat.
Grate Monterey Jack cheese over all; garnish with the leftover chips and 1/2 cup of the sliced olives.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Grind fresh cranberries. Combine banana and 1/2 cup sugar. Set aside.
Process cottage cheese in food processor until blended.
Place in bowl and set aside.
Press spinach between paper towel until barely moist.
Add spinach and remaining ingredients to cheese mixture; stir well.
Cover and refrigerate about 3 hours.
Serve with fat-free crackers or raw vegetables.
Do not drain anything.
Combine Jell-O and water, then add frozen berries when slightly cool, to thaw.
Then add marshmallows and last, rest of ingredients after cool.
Heat oven to 350°.
Spray a shallow 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray.
Arrange 4 slices of bread over bottom of baking dish, tearing to fit.
Top with half of the tomato slices.
Spread garlic over tomatoes, then sprinkle with half the chives.
Season with salt and pepper.
Crumble Cheddar cheese over chives and drizzle with half the oil.
Top with remaining bread slices, pressing firmly to fit.
Arrange remaining tomato slices on top, then sprinkle with remaining chives, Parmesan cheese and additional pepper to taste.
Drizzle with remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons oil.
(If making ahead, cover and refrigerate, then proceed.)
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, or until cheese on top is golden and tomatoes are soft. Serve immediately.
Brown onion in 1 tablespoon of oil.
Add ground beef and sear; pour off excess grease.
Add tomato sauce and cook over low heat for 15 minutes.
Add beans, macaroni, salt and pepper to meat mixture.
Pour in 2-quart greased casserole dish.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
Flatten each biscuit to 1/4-inch thickness.
Place on cookie sheet.
Spread each with tomato paste and top with desired topping.
Sprinkle with oregano and cheese.
Bake at 400° for 6 to 8 minutes or until lightly browned.
Mix oleo, raisins, eggs, sugar and milk.
Heat over low heat 10 minutes.
Turn off heat and add nuts, cereal and vanilla.
Mix well.
Cool and roll into balls or put in pan after mixing and cut into squares when cool.

recipes.t: "Cajun" New Orleans Cooking School Bananas Foster
d: Slice the bananas in 3 slices lengthwise, then cut in halves. Melt the butter in a skillet or frying pan.
Add brown sugar (you may also add 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon, if desired) and cook over low heat, stirring into a thick paste.
Add vanilla and banana liquor and stir well.
Cook 3 minutes.
Add banana slices and cook over medium heat, basting well with the sugar and butter mixture.
Cook about 5 minutes.
Heat the rum in a metal cup, ignite and pour over bananas.
(Rum will have faint blue flame in cup and will flame up when poured over bananas.)
Stir well to blend, then serve mixture with pieces of bananas over vanilla ice cream.
Allow eggs to reach room temperature, then beat eggs in separate container and set aside.
Scald milk in saucepan; add butter/shortening (cut into pieces) until melted and set aside to cool.
Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water.
When milk mixture has cooled, add yeast mixture; stir slightly to mix.
Sift flour, sugar and salt.
Add milk/yeast mixture.
Combine all ingredients thoroughly.
Place in a large bowl that can be tightly closed in refrigerator for 8 to 12 hours to rise.
After rising, shape and bake at 400° until done.
Brown vermicelli in butter on low heat, add salt and pepper to taste.
Remove from heat and add broth.
Return to heat and add rice.
Cook on medium high until comes to boil, lower heat and cook until 95% of broth evaporates.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and set aside.
In a medium bowl, stir together flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt; set aside.
In another medium bowl, combine 1/3 cup sugar, chocolate and walnuts; set aside.
In a large bowl with an electric mixer at high speed, cream shortening and remaining 1 cup of sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs and vanilla at low speed.
Alternately stir in flour mixture and water, just until blended.
Stir in dates.
Cook the ground beef in boiling salt water until done.
Drain well and mix with the carrots, pepper and onion.
Combine with enough mayonnaise to make a spread.
This must be used at room temperature to be good.
Do not refrigerate.
Layer ham, turkey and roast beef on a hoagie roll.
Heat in microwave.
Add mayonnaise, lettuce, tomato and onion.
Cream together sugar and shortening.
Add one egg at a time, beating well after each addition.
Place halibut in baking pan.
Set oven to broil.
Melt butter and garlic together.
Place lemon slices on fillet.
Pour butter and garlic mixture on top of fillet.
Reserve some mixture to baste halibut as it broils.
Broil for 15 minutes.
Layer ingredients in the order given.
Mix the taco seasoning with the refried beans.
Spread beans on large dinner plate, leaving about a 2-inch margin.
Layer each (onions, tomatoes, avocado, olives and peppers).
When placing cheese, sort of mold it and alfalfa sprouts with hands to form a ball-like mound. Chill and serve (scoop) with nacho chips.
Brown meat and onions in a large Dutch oven.
Drain.
Add soups, beans, tomatoes and enchilada sauce.
Simmer 20 minutes. Turn off heat.
Add chips and place into two casserole dishes. Top with cheese.
Put into hot oven long enough to melt cheese.
In a large skillet, cut up squash (skin and all if young squash).
Add margarine, salt and pepper and enough water to cover squash.
Bring to a boil.
Turn heat down and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
Keep mashing with a fork and add water as it cooks out. When squash is the consistency of mashed potatoes and the liquid is gone, cook slowly turning with spatula until the squash is a golden brown.
Makes a small bowl full.
Very good and worth the effort.
Sprinkle with bread crumbs.

recipes.t: Bake While You Sleep Cookies(All Night Cookies)
d: Preheat oven to 350°.
In medium size bowl, with electric mixer at high speed, beat egg white and salt until soft peaks form.
Beat in sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time until stiff and glossy.
Stir in nuts and chocolate chips.
Drop mixture by rounded teaspoon onto foil covered cookie sheet.
Place in oven.
Close door.
Turn oven off.
Do not open door.
Leave cookies in oven overnight.
Remove from foil; store in airtight container.
Makes about 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.t: Batesville Cheese And Green Chili Pie
d: Sprinkle Jack cheese and 1/2 the Cheddar in bottom of pie crust.
Distribute chillies over cheese.
Beat eggs and half and half, salt and cumin.
Pour over cheese in the pie crust. Sprinkle remaining cheese over pie filling.
Bake at 325° for 40 minutes or until pie sets.
Melt butter in skillet on medium heat.
Add onion, pepper and beef.
Cook until meat is brown.
Drain off excess fat.
Drain tomatoes, measuring juice.
Add water to juice to make 2 cups.
Add juice, tomatoes, sugar, salt, thyme and bay leaf.
Cover and simmer 5 minutes, then add rice.
Simmer 5 more minutes.
Discard bay leaf.
Serves 4.
Brown ground meat slightly.
Add next five ingredients until onion looks clear.
Put in a 9-inch deep dish pie crust and put pie crust on top.
Bake at 350° until brown.
Drain beans and marinate at least 1 hour in Ranch and Italian dressing combined.
Sprinkle with dill weed, salt and pepper to taste.

In a large bowl combine bread cubes and raisins. In a medium saucepan combine milk and 1/4 cup butter. Heat stirring occasionally until milk is steaming and butter is almost melted. pour hot milk mixture over bread and raisins. Let stand for 10 minutes. Meanwhile grease a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish and set aside. In a small bowl slightly beat eggs. Stir in 1/2 cup sugar, cinnamon, vanilla and nutmeg. Stir the egg

mixture into the bread mixture. Pour it in the casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 50 to 55 minutes or until the surface is puffed and a knife inserted near center comes out clean. Cool slightly.
In a large bowl, combine confectioners sugar, cracker crumbs, peanut butter and butter.
Stir until well blended.
Line a 9 x 13-inch baking pan with a double layer of aluminum foil, extending foil over ends of pan.
Grease foil.
Press mixture into pan.
Heat orange juice to boiling.
Empty package of orange flavor into a large bowl.
Add boiling orange juice to gelatin and stir until dissolved.
Break up jelly with a fork and stir it into the dissolved gelatin.
Add 1/4 cup cold water, salt and lemon juice.
Chill until slightly thickened.
Whip heavy cream and fold lightly into the thickened gelatin mixture.
Pour into 1-quart mold.
Chill until firm.
Turn out and decorate with holly leaves.
For the holly berries, select a few cranberries from a can of whole cranberry sauce or use fresh cranberries.
Brown hamburger in frying pan, then add taco mix according to package directions.
Let simmer.
Grease 2 cupcake pans; line the pockets of the cupcake pans with biscuit dough.
Spoon in hamburger; fill to top.
Top with cheese.
Bake for 10 minutes at 350°.
Spread chili in a ceramic pie dish.
Layer salsa, cream cheese, scallions, olives and Cheddar cheese on top.
Microwave on High one minute or until cheese melts.
Serve with taco or tortilla chips.
Easy!

Peel yams and grate if using fresh. Stir together the yams and melted butter. Add eggs, beating after each one. Add milk, molasses and vanilla. In another dish, stir together flour, salt, cinnamon, sugar and nutmeg. Add to yam mixture and blend well. Pour into a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 325° for 2 1/2 hours, stirring several times during
the first hour. Serve hot or cold. May be reheated.
*If you use spicy barbecue sauce or salsa, sauce will have more of a kick.
Scald milk.
Stir in sugar, salt and butter. Cool to lukewarm. Measure water in a bowl and sprinkle in the yeast. Stir to dissolve and add the cooled milk mixture.
Add the onions and flour.
Stir until well blended, about 2 minutes. Cover and let rise until dough has doubled (about 1 hour).
Stir down and beat 1 minute. Turn into a greased 1 1/2-quart greased casserole dish. Bake about 1
hour at 375°.
Dice potatoes in 1-inch cubes.
Mince garlic finely.
Add potatoes to a shallow baking dish; top with remaining ingredients, dotting butter over top.
Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Prepare or purchase your favorite yeast dough.
Roll dough out flat on the countertop until it is 1/2-inch thick.
Spread cinnamon, mixed with sugar, over the dough until the surface of the dough is covered.
With your fingers, gently roll the dough evenly into a roll and cut off 1-inch thick sections.
Put the rolls into a greased cake pan so that they have 1/2-inch between each other.
Cover the pan with a cloth and let the dough rise until it has doubled in size.
Bake the rolls for 35 to 45 minutes at 375°.
After the rolls are done, cover them with a powdered sugar glaze.
Soften gelatin in 1/2 cup skim milk.
Bring remaining 1/2 cup skim milk to a boil.
Pour gelatin milk mixture into boiling milk; stir to dissolve gelatin.
Add evaporated skim milk.
Chill until syrupy.
In food processor, combine remaining ingredients and milk mixture.
Beat until mixture begins to thicken. Pour into 8 x 8-inch square pan.
Freeze until firm.
Remove from freezer 15 minutes before serving time.
Serves 6, 77 calories.
Cream sugar and margarine.
Add eggs and mix well.
Add buttermilk,
then
dry
ingredients and vanilla.
Mix well and bake in
2 layers at 350° for approximately 25 minutes.
After cake is cooled ice with Buttermilk Icing.

recipes.t: Roast Potatoes With Peppers And Onions
d: Preheat oven to 400°.
Arrange potatoes and peppers alternately in spoke pattern in a large, shallow 12-inch round baking dish.
Pile the onions in center.
Scatter garlic on top. Drizzle with olive oil.
Sprinkle with rosemary, salt and pepper. Bake until veggies are lightly golden and tender, about 45 minutes.
Serves 4.
Contains 245 cal, 4 g protein, 11 g fat, 35 g carbohydrates, 700 mg salt and 0 mg cholesterol.
Place cake on serving plate.
Slice a 1-inch layer from top of cake and set aside.
Cut around cake 1 inch from outer edge down to 1 inch from bottom.
Then cut around cake 1 inch from inner edge down to 1 inch from bottom.
Gently pull out cake from between cuts, leaving 1 inch on bottom.
Tear removed cake into pieces.
Sift flour on board.
Add sugar.
Cut in butter with knife until crumbly.
Add egg yolks and mix well.
(This takes quite a while.)
Beat 2 egg whites a little; brush on cookies and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 375° until brown.

recipes.t: Fermented Fruit And Fermented Fruit Friendship Cake
d: Do not drain fruit.
Combine peaches, 2 1/2 cups sugar and yeast in a one gallon glass or crockery jar with loose fitting lid; stir to mix.
Stir daily for 10 days.
On the 10th day add the pineapple and 2 1/2 cups sugar.
Stir daily for 10 more days. Add cherries, fruit cocktail and remaining sugar and stir daily for 10 more days.
Drain fruit, reserving juice for the next batch.
Makes enough fruit for 4 cakes.

recipes.t: German Pickled Herring In Sour Cream
d: Mix sour cream, apples, onion, pickle and sugar in a medium size non-aluminum bowl.
Gently stir in herring.
Cover and refrigerate at least 24 hours or up to 5 days.
Serves 12; only 60 cents per serving.
Contains 162 calories and 11 grams fat.
Grease a 9 x 6-inch baking dish.
Place potatoes in saucepan. Add boiling salted water to half cover them.
Cover and boil for 20 minutes or until tender.
Drain, cool, then peel and cube.
Place in baking dish.
Melt butter or margarine in skillet.
Saute onions for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour over potatoes.
Stir with fork to mix.
Bake in preheated oven at 425° for 1 hour.
Just before serving, place under broiler for a few minutes to brown.
Serves 10 to 12.
Finely chop onions, celery, green peppers, cucumbers and tomatoes.
Prepare salad dressing mix according to package directions using half the oil called for in instructions.
Pour over prepared cut vegetables and marinate in refrigerator one hour. Add tomato juice and chill, covered, overnight or at least six hours.
Serves six.
Cover raisins with hot water and soak for 15 minutes.
Drain. Separate eggs and beat yolks lightly.
Stir in vinegar, butter, spices, walnuts and raisins.
Beat egg whites until stiff and gradually beat in sugar.
Fold into raisin mixture.
Turn into pastry-lined pie pan.
Bake at 425° for 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake 35 to 45 minutes longer, or until pastry is browned and filling set.
(Crust browns quickly, so keep checking pie as it bakes.)
Brown beef in small amount of oil.
Add taco seasoning and cook as package directs.
Shred lettuce, grate cheese and cut other ingredients.
Heat shells as package directs.
Let each person assemble as desired.
Preheat oven to 375°.
Grease and flour 12 medium muffin cups.
In medium bowl, beat egg, cottage cheese, honey and butter together.
Add oats and orange peel until well blended. Gradually stir in flour and baking soda.
Divide batter among muffin cups.
Bake about 25 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Mix the vinegar, salt and sugar well.
Pack cucumbers in jars. Add large hunk of dill, garlic bud and red pepper (optional). Pour vinegar mixture over cucumbers.
Seal and set in sun for 7 days.
Wait 2 weeks before opening after you bring in out of sun. (Put in a place that they can get sun all day.)
Beat bananas, egg whites, oil and brown sugar until smooth. Add flours, baking powder, baking soda and spices.
Mix until well blended.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Scoop heaping tablespoon of dough onto sprayed cookie sheet.
use butter knife sprayed with Pam to round out a hole in the middle of each one.
Sprinkle with sugar and walnuts.
Bake at 425° for 6 to 10 minutes until golden. Eight ounces of pumpkin can be substituted for bananas.

Combine first 3 ingredients. Mix with hot water. Cook until thick and bubbly. Stir constantly as it burns easily. Let cool completely. Then fold in whipped topping and mandarin oranges. Chill until set.
Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups boiling water.
Add orange and lemon juices and chill.
Fold in peaches and blueberries.
Pour into 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish and refrigerate until firm.

Brown beef and add sauce. Cook spaghetti according to directions on box and then drain. Spoon 2 tablespoons sauce on bottom of baking dish. Layer spaghetti, sauce and cheese. Repeat the layers. Bake at 350° until bubbly around edges (about 30 minutes). This makes a lot, so you may want to reduce the amount of ingredients.
Brown ground beef with garlic salt and pepper to taste.
Just before done, add onion and pepper.
Drain well.
Pour into casserole dish and spread evenly in bottom.
Drain corn well, cover with meat mixture.
Add mashed potatoes, spreading evenly over meat mixture.
Cover with the cheese.
Bake at 350° until heated and cheese has melted.
Serves 4.
Saute onion in 1 tablespoon margarine. Add 1 cup rice.
Saute 10 minutes.
Add the tomato (cut up).
Boil 2 1/2 cups water.
Add the bouillon to the water.
Add the mushrooms.
Add liquid to rice mixture. Cover and simmer until liquid is gone.
Combine tuna and mayo; season with celery, onion, salt and pepper.
Spread tuna on toast; top with tomato.
On paper plate, heat sandwiches at Medium 2 to 2 1/2 minutes.
Top with cheese. Heat at Medium 1 3/4 to 2 1/2 minutes or until cheese is melted. Makes 4 servings.
Mix sugar and cocoa, then add milk to mix.
Add other ingredients except vanilla.
Boil 2 to 3 minutes.
Beat with electric mixer until thick.
Add vanilla.
Cook pasta according to package directions. Clean all vegetables and place in large bowl.
Mix cooled pasta and vegetables together.
Top with your favorite Italian dressing, shredded Cheddar cheese and Parmesan cheese.
Serves a large crowd.
Keep refrigerated.
Do not store longer than 24 hours.
It becomes soggy.
Dissolve
yeast
in
lukewarm
water
with
2 teaspoons sugar. Set
aside.
Beat
the
eggs and egg yolks in a mixer; add
1/2 cup sugar and beat again.
Add softened margarine and shortening and
mix
well.
Then add the yeast mixture, milk, lemon rind, salt and 4 cups of flour and beat well.
Put in a larger
bowl, add remaining flour a little at a time and knead in
bowl until smooth, about 12 to 15 minutes.
Dough may be a little
thin.
Pat top
of dough with melted margarine, cover with
towel
and
let rise in a warm place away from draft for about one hour or until doubled in size.
Punch dough down and knead again in same bowl for about 2 or 3 minutes and let rise again until doubled in size.
Mix batter of flour, 1 cup sugar, milk and cornstarch.
Put 3/4 cup sugar on top of first mixture (use more sugar for cherries).
Add boiling water over all, then berries or cherries. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
Combine the first 4 ingredients; beat until fluffy.
Combine dry ingredients and add milk and blueberries.
Sprinkle top with cinnamon/sugar mixture (optional). Bake 25 minutes at 375°.
Beat egg and slowly add hot chicken broth to egg while stirring.
Add Crisco shortening.
Add salt, if needed.
Add all-purpose flour to suit.
Roll out and cut.
These can be used for chicken and dumplings, chicken pot pie, etc.
Cream butter with Sweet 'N Low until light and fluffy.
Add egg; beat until light and fluffy again.
Fold flour thoroughly into creamed mixture.
Stir in walnuts and vanilla.
Shape into long roll, 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Wrap in wax paper.
Chill at least overnight.
The longer you chill, the better the cookies.
Brown bacon lightly; add onion.
Cook until tender and lightly browned.
Add potatoes and water.
Cook until tender (1/2 hour). Add corn.
Bring to a boil.
Add soups; bring to a boil, stirring until well blended.
Before serving, heat milk and add to the mixture.
Scald, peel and chop tomatoes.
Chop peppers and onions into a 2-quart pot.
Mix all ingredients well.
Salt and pepper to taste. Cook on low heat until rather thick.
Melt bark and oil. Dip crackers in mixture; dry on wax paper.
Preheat oven to 350° and grease and flour pans.
Beat oleo and brown sugar on high speed.
Add honey.
Beat on low.
Stir in beaten eggs and flour mixture alternately.
Fold in bananas and walnuts.
Bake for 55 to 65 minutes.
Yields 1 loaf.
Halve squash; remove seeds.
Place cut side down on greased baking sheet.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until squash is tender.
Scoop out pulp, leaving shell.
Stir together pulp, sugar, butter, salt and orange peel.
Add enough orange juice (about 2 teaspoons) to make a fluffy consistency.
Refill shells; sprinkle with pecans.
Bake 10 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.
Fry onion in olive oil.
Remove onion and fry hamburger and sausage in oil.
Boil noodles until tender.
Drain.
Add meat, noodles and all ingredients along with the cup of grated cheese. Mix and put in casserole dish and bake in moderate oven (350°) for about 40 minutes.

recipes.t: Doug Cooper'S Apricot Cashew Glazed Turkey
d: Heat a small pan over moderate heat and saute cashews in oil for approximately 1 minute, then add in apricots and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in orange juice and Zinfindel.
Reduce to half. Finish by adding syrup and jelly.
Let cook until it thickens. Lightly season turkey slices and grill for approximately 4 minutes on each side.
Slice turkey on an angle and serve over glaze. Serve with yam slices.
Sift dry ingredients.
Add sugar, oil, eggs and coffee; mix. Then, add pumpkin and pudding mix, then nuts.
Grease pans.
Bake for 50 to 60 minutes at 350°.
Let cool on rack.
Mix crumbs, sugar and cinnamon with butter in warm frying pan. Brown very lightly.
Whip the cream.
Make alternate layers of crumbs, applesauce and whipped cream in a large, clear serving bowl.
Each layer should be about 1/4 inch high.
Top with whipped cream.
Sift flour, soda and salt together.
Cream the shortening and sugars.
Add eggs and flavoring.
Add chocolate chips, nuts, oatmeal and sifted flour mixture.
Bake at 350° to 375° until brown.
Brown bacon strips until crisp.
Cook chopped onion in bacon fat until yellow.
Stir in flour.
Add and bring to a boil the vegetable liquid, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper.
Stir in cooked green beans.
Stir gently until heated through. Serve with crisp bacon sprinkled over top.
Brown hamburger; drain.
Put in bottom of casserole dish. Place sliced potatoes over hamburger, then pour in soup and water. Salt and pepper to taste.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Combine flour, baking powder, salt and sugar.
Blend well. Add onion, bacon, cheese and zucchini.
Mix egg, milk and oil. Blend well.
Add wet mixture to dry ingredients.
Stir until just moistened.
Fill greased or paper lined muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake at 375° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Yield: 12 muffins.
Mix Jell-O and water and let set slightly. Mix remaining ingredients and fold into Jell-O mixture.
Whip Dream Whip as soon as Jell-O is made.
Cool in refrigerator.
Mix corn meal, flour, salt, baking powder, onion, egg, milk, water and bacon drippings together and drop by teaspoonsful into hot deep fat.
Cook until golden.

recipes.t: Easy Italian Sauce And Pasta Shells
d: Cook the pasta according to package directions.
Saute the onion in the olive oil until softened (about 5 minutes).
If more liquid is needed, add the water.
Add the crushed tomatoes and the basil.
Mix well and cook, uncovered, on medium until the liquid is reduced.
Stir occasionally.
Makes 4 servings.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Peel potatoes and onions; cut into round slices.
Place on bottom of baking dish.
Cover entire bottom, making a second layer and layering onions over taters. Place chicken breasts over the onions and potatoes.
Cover lightly with safflower oil.
Sprinkle lightly with pepper, parsley and oregano.
Cover entire dish with stewed tomatoes.
Bake 1 hour. Serves 4.
Brown ground beef and mix in taco seasoning.
Spread bean dip on chips to desired thickness.
Preheat oven to 400°.
Place chips on cookie sheet.
Put 1 teaspoon seasoned ground beef on each chip.
Cover with grated cheese and green chili slices.
Use hotter peppers, if you like.
Heat chips for 3 to 5 minutes.
Top with sour cream and olive slices.
Serve.
Mix
water
and
sugar to boil for 20 minutes, then add remaining ingredients except 7-Up and cherries.
Stir and pour mixture in freezer plastic containers and freeze.
Mix cornstarch with 1/2 cup milk, add 1 1/2 cups milk and cook in double boiler until thick, beating constantly to avoid lumping. Blend sugar, eggs, salt and evaporated milk in electric mixer.
Add hot cornstarch mixture and beat well.
Add whipping cream, remaining milk and vanilla, pour into electric mixer.
Pack with layers of ice and salt.
Cover freezer tightly and store.
Cook sugars, milk, butter and cocoa for 1 1/2 minutes at a rolling boil.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla, nuts, oats and peanut butter.
Blend well.
Spoon onto wax paper and cool.
Boil water and stir into Jell-O.
In blender, grind up cranberries with a little water.
Cut up apple, orange and celery. Grind in with cranberries.
Drain off as much juice as you can. With mixer, blend can of cranberry sauce into Jell-O.
Add drained cranberry mixture.
Refrigerate a few hours or overnight before serving.
Beat egg whites and salt until frothy.
Dip chicken breasts in Parmesan cheese, egg and cracker crumbs. Brown in 1/2 cup oil in skillet.
Arrange in baking dish in single layer.
Arrange 1 slice of 1/4-inch jack cheese on each breast. Adding oil to skillet if necessary, saute sliced fresh mushrooms until tender.
Add wine and saute slowly for 5 minutes.
Spoon mushrooms over chicken (not too much liquid).
Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Bottom Layer:
Cream the butter with the sugar.
Blend in the egg yolks, flour, baking powder and vanilla.
Using heel of hand, fit dough into bottom of a 10 x 12-inch baking pan.
In a bowl, combine butter, honey and cinnamon. Pour into a buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Spread to coat bottom of pan.
Cover the bottom of a Bundt pan with brown sugar, about 1/2 inch deep.
Evenly distribute cherries around the bottom of the pan; set aside.
Mix cake as per the instructions on the box. Pour batter into Bundt pan on top of cherries and brown sugar. Bake at 325° until done.
Allow cake to cool for at least 1/2 hour before turning cake onto a plate.
Makes a beautiful cherry upside-down cake.
Peel onion, leaving root intact.
Cut onion vertically into quarters, cutting to within 1/2-inch of root end.
Cut each quarter vertically into thirds.
Place onion in boiling water for 1 minute; remove and place in ice water for 5 minutes.
Loosen "petals" if necessary.
Drain onion, cut side down.
Place flour in a Ziploc bag; add onion, shaking to coat.
Dip onion in egg.
Place fine cracker crumbs in a Ziploc bag; toss onion to coat.
Chill onion for 1 hour.
Pour oil to depth of 3-inches in an electric fryer or heavy saucepan.
Heat oil to 375°.
Fry onion 5 to 7 minutes or until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels.
Sprinkle with salt, if desired.
Serve with sauce of your choice.
Slice cucumbers and onions.
Then pour sugar, water and salt over them.

In punch bowl, combine tea, juice, wine and concentrates.
Chill.
Before serving, add club soda.
Serve with ice and garnish with lemon and apple slices.
Makes 20 servings.
Cut corn kernels from cobs.
Measure 2 2/3 cups without packing down.
In a small skillet saute butter, onion and bell pepper until wilted.
In a medium bowl sift together cornstarch, sugar, salt, pepper, milk and eggs.
Mix well, then add the corn and onion mixture.
Pour in a pan and bake in a 300° oven about 1 hour or until knife inserted into center comes out clean.
Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes before cutting and serving.
Makes 6 servings.
Soak rice in water in a heavy saucepan for 30 minutes.
Drain and discard water.
Saute rice in butter in the same pan.
Add stock, salt, paprika and pepper.
Stir to blend spices.
Cover; bring to a boil and cook 12 to 15 minutes or until rice is almost tender.
Remove from heat and let stand, covered, until ready to serve.
Serves 4 to 6.
Blend cheese and soup in bowl.
Add tuna, rice, green onion, parsley and pepper.
Spoon in 1 1/2-quart glass baking dish.
Top with cheese and paprika.
Microwave on High 3 to 6 minutes or until heated through.

recipes.t: Cold Lemon Souffle(Light And Tart; Rich, But Not Heavy)
d: Beat egg yolks and 1 1/2 cups sugar.
Gradually adding lemon juice until mixture becomes thick.
In saucepan over low heat, sprinkle gelatin over water.
Add 1 teaspoon sugar and stir until dissolved.
Cool and add to lemon mixture.
Partially whip 1 pint cream until thickened but not stiff and fold into mixture. Combine egg whites, salt and cream of tartar.
Beat until stiff peaks form and fold into mixture.
Line sides and bottom of 2-quart glass bowl with ladyfingers and fill with lemon mixture. Chill and serve topped with whipped cream.
Or pour mixture into parfait glasses, chill and garnish with twist of lemon.
Serves 12.
Melt marshmallows in milk, cool, add liqueurs and salt.
Fold in whipped cream.
Put 1/3 mixture on each layer of angel cake and top, letting it run down the sides.
Store in refrigerator.
Mix all ingredients, except ham slices, until well combined. Spread the cream cheese mixture on each ham slice and roll up. Slice each ham roll-up to 1/4 to 1/2-inch thickness.
Arrange on platter and serve.
Prepare ice ring in advance, if desired.
In blender container, puree strawberries.
In large punch bowl, combine pureed strawberries and remaining ingredients, except ginger ale. Stir until sugar dissolves.
Just before serving, add ginger ale and ice ring.
Makes 3 1/2 quarts.
Salt and pepper the beef to taste and form into a ball.
Put on a platter.
Surround the ball with sliced onions and serve with rye bread.
Have salt and pepper shakers handy.
Put cookie crumbs at bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan.
Mix the cream cheese, butter and sugar; set aside.
Mix pudding, milk and vanilla.
Add cream cheese mixture; fold in Cool Whip.
Put cookie crumbs on top and bottom.
Cool in icebox for 4 hours.
Mix all ingredients except Oreos in bowl.
Separately blend Oreo cookies until fine.
Cover bottom of a planter with Oreos. Layer pudding mixture, Oreos, pudding, Oreos, pudding, etc.
Cover top with Oreos.
Wash beans thoroughly and place in large kettle.
Cover with water.
Add 1 tablespoon of salt and soak overnight.
In morning, drain.
Add two quarts of water and smoked turkey leg, ham or ham hocks.
Bring to boil and simmer slowly until beans are done, 3 to 3 1/2 hours.
Mix spice seasoning, salt and water.
Add to nuts.
Stir well before adding oil. Then mix and toss well before spreading on microwave dish (leave center area open).
Cook on High 3 minutes. Stir well and leave center open.
Cook on High 5 more minutes. Cool to room temperature. Stores well.

Pour half of the vodka into a separate container, set aside. Pour all of the honey in with the bottled vodka. Shake WELL. This may take some time. After that is well mixed add the juice from the 2 lemons, top off with the set aside vodka.
Beat eggs lightly and add water, salt and Tabasco.
Set aside. Chop onion and garlic; set aside.
Melt butter in skillet; add cubed potatoes.
Saute in butter until soft and very lightly brown on edges over medium heat; do not let butter burn.
Add onion and garlic and let wilt slightly.
Pour eggs over and scramble. Serves 2 to 3.
Cook macaroni and drain.
Fry onion in margarine.
Fry bacon. Stir in soup, milk and 3/4 of the cheese.
Heat slowly while gently stirring.
Add macaroni and mix well.
Turn into small casserole.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cream the butter and sugars.
Beat in egg, baking soda, baking powder, salt and vanilla.
Stir in flour and oats.
Mix well.
Add jelly beans. Drop by spoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown.
Makes 3 to 3 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.t: Tuna Casserole With Peas And Potatoes
d: In small bowl, mix milk and soup; mix well.
In casserole dish, layer potatoes, peas, tuna and milk-soup mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until potatoes are done.
Predrain fruit.
Mix buttermilk and instant pudding; mix well. Add fruit and mix.
Immediately put into glass dish or plastic bowl (no aluminum).
Top with Cool Whip.
Brown meat in skillet.
Add onion and saute.
Drain liquid. In a large kettle over medium heat, add tomato juice and tomato paste.
Add turkey and onions.
Season with chili powder, salt, pepper and sugar to taste.
Set oven control to broil.
Split English muffins; toast. Stir cheese, margarine and marmalade until light and fluffy. Spread about 1 tablespoon cheese mixture on each muffin half; sprinkle with 1 tablespoon almonds.
Broil until almonds are light brown and mixture is hot and bubbly, 1 to 2 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.
Combine fruit and chill.
Fold coconut into whipped milk. Arrange alternate layers of fruit mixture and whipped cream in parfait glasses.
Garnish with additional coconut and whole strawberries.
Place the apples and walnuts in a food processor and pulse until fairly finely chopped.
Transfer to a bowl and stir in red wine, honey and cinnamon.
Serve chilled or at room temperature. Makes about 1 1/2 cups.
The Apple Haroset can be refrigerated, covered, for up to 6 hours.
Heat oven to 350°.
Spray a 13 x 9-inch baking dish with nonstick spray.
Cut chicken, onion and green pepper into strips. Saute with Pam.
Sprinkle with enchilada seasoning.
In a medium bowl, combine sour cream, yogurt, soup and chilies.
Mix well. Sprinkle a small amount of cheese in tortilla and spread about 3 tablespoons sour cream mixture down the center of each tortilla along with chicken mixture.
Roll up and place in baking dish. Cover with salsa and remaining sour cream mixture.
Cover with foil. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Remove foil.
Sprinkle with cheese. Return to oven and bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes.
Garnish with lettuce and tomatoes. Makes 6 servings.
Add the milk and rice slowly and heat with egg yolks, sugar and salt in a double boiler.
Beat the egg whites with 2 tablespoons sugar and lemon juice and spoon over top.
Bake in oven at 425° until delicately brown (about 5 minutes).
Serve from the baking dish.
Meringue is best if served within an hour.
The pudding can be made ahead of time and meringue added just before ready to serve.
In 8 x 12-inch baking dish, combine vegetables and 1/2 can French fried onions; arrange chicken breasts on vegetables.
In small bowl, combine wine, bouillon, garlic salt and pepper; pour over chicken and vegetables.
Sprinkle chicken with paprika.
Bake, covered, at 375° for 40 minutes or until chicken is done.
Baste chicken with wine sauce and top with remaining onions; bake, uncovered, 3 minutes or until onions are golden brown.
