Combine rice crumbs and seasoning mix. Whisk egg in a shallow bowl. Dip fish in egg then coat in rice crumb mixture. Cover and chill for 10 mins.
Meanwhile, steam vegetables until tender. Remove kernels from cob then combine vegetables in a large bowl. Add butter and toss until combined. Season. Cover with foil to keep warm.
Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add fish and cook for 2-3 mins per side, or until fish is golden brown and cooked to your liking. Drain on paper towels.
Serve fish with vegetables and lemon wedges.
In a large pan heat the olive oil ( medium heat )and saute the onion and the peppers, for about 3 min.
Add the mixed vegetables, tomato, tomato sauce, beef and simmer ( medium heat ) for about 3 min.
Add the egg mixture, mix well, and simmer ( low heat) two more min.
Season with salt and cayenne pepper and serve.
Process cilantro, onion, red peppers and garlic in food processor until finely chopped.

Heat oil in 12-inch skillet over medium heat and cook sofrito mixture, Pasta Sauce and Bouillon partially covered, stirring occasionally, 30 minutes. Remove cover and cook, stirring frequently, 20 minutes or until thickened. Refrigerate or freeze until ready to use.

recipes.t: Berry Nutty Whole Wheat Banana Bread
d: Preheat oven to 350°. Brush 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with additional I Can't Believe It's Not Butter!(R) Spread; set aside.

Combine mashed bananas, I Can't Believe It's Not Butter!(R) Spread, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla in large bowl with wooden spoon. Stir in flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt until blended. Stir in berries, nuts and flax seeds. Spoon into prepared pan.
Bake 1 hour to 1 hour 10 minutes until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 20 minutes on wire rack; remove from pan and cool completely.

Combine 3/4 cup water with 1/4 cup brown sugar and yeast, stir. (Proof yeast Let set about 10-15 minutes until bubbly.) Combine eggs, milk, oil and remaining 1/4 cup water, and whisk together. Add yeast mixture, oatmeal and all but 1 cup of flour. Mix in mixer with dough hook or by hand. Add as much of remaining flour as necessary (until dough pulls away from sides of bowl.) If using dough hook, knead about 3-4 minutes. If doing by hand on floured surface, knead in 1/2 to 1 cup all-purpose flour until dough is smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes. Place in greased bowl; cover loosely with plastic wrap<

Punch dough down several times to remove all air bubbles. Shape dough into rolls and/or small loaves. Brush dough with beaten egg; sprinkle with sesame seed or rolled oats. Cover; let rise in warm place until doubled in size; about 30 minutes.
Heat oven to 375F. Uncover dough. Bake at 375F for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Immediately remove from cookie sheet.
Preheat oven to 340 F Peel & slice apples
Toss with 3 tblsp coconut sugar, vanilla, cranberries, apricots, 1 tbsp coconut oil, tapioca flour melted into water, pour into baking dish
Mix together almond flour, 2 tbsp melted coconut oil, 1 tbsp coconut sugar, apple pie spice, pinch of salt & lay on top of apples for the "crumble"
Bake for 45 min. & check for slightly browned crumble
Adjust sugar to taste. This recipe is treat-sweet enough for kids.
For full instructions please go to http://www.lilybellekitchen.com/tomato-pesto-and-mozzarella-tart/
Cut tomatoes into bite sized pieces or slices. Tear basil leaves into small pieces.
Combine basil, tomato and corn in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil. Stir and let chill for 1 hour for flavor mix.
Just before serving add salt black pepper, lemon juice and stir well .
Mix oil, vinegar and seasonings in small bowl. Place chicken in large resealable plastic bag or glass dish. Add marinade; turn to coat well.
Refrigerate 30 minutes or longer for extra flavor. Remove chicken from marinade. Discard any remaining marinade.
Grill over medium-high heat 6 to 7 minutes per side or until chicken is cooked through, turning frequently.
Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
Add the oil to a nonstick pan and heat on medium heat.
Add the onions and saute for 5 minutes.
Add the zucchini and saute for 10 minutes.
Remove from the heat, and allow to cool.
Place the zucchini mixture to a blender and add the cheeses, egg, basil and milk. Season with a pinch of salt and black pepper to taste.
Line a pie dish with the short pastry and fill with the mixture.
Fold over the edges of the excess pastry to form a border.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown.
Cook the potatoes in boiling salted water for 20 mins, until tender. Drain, refresh with cold water and slice.

In a saucepan, bring the stock, onion and 4 tbsp oil to a boil. Stir in the vinegar and season with salt, black pepper and a pinch of sugar. Remove from the heat, add the potatoes and allow to stand for 30 mins.

Meanwhile, mix the veal, mustard, egg and bread and season with salt and black pepper. With wet hands, shape into 8 balls. Heat 3 tbsp oil in a frying pan and fry the meatballs for 8-10 mins, until cooked through and browned all over.
Fold the cucumber and oregano into the potato salad and allow to stand for 5 mins. Arrange on plates with the meatballs and serve.
Pour egg whites into one bowl and mix breadcrumbs and black pepper into the other bowl.
Place chicken breast into egg whites and flip to ensure that both sides of the breast are coated.
Remove chicken breast from egg whites and place in breadcrumb mixture until it is evenly coated with a layer of breadcrumbs.
Repeat steps 2 & 3 for the other chicken breast.
Preheat oven to 385° F and heat frying pan over a medium-high heat.
Add coconut oil to pan and fry both chicken breasts for approximately 1-2 minutes on each side or until coating becomes lightly browned.
Place both chicken breasts on baking tray and bake for 30 minutes at 385° F.
In a large bowl, combine buttermilk, sour cream and egg. Add squash and zucchini. Sift flour and baking soda over top then fold in. Season.

Heat oil in a large saucepan. Working in batches, lower heaped tablespoons of mixture into hot oil. Fry for 4-5 mins, turning with a slotted spoon, until fritters are golden and cooked through. Drain on paper towels.
Serve with beet dip and mixed greens.
In a pan on medium heat, add the milk, cream, and sugar. Stir until the sugar melts, add the gelatin and vanilla.
Pour mixture in glass cups.
Garnish each glass with 3 blackcurrant buds, and refrigerate until the next day.
For the sauce, in a sauce pan, add brown sugar, currants, and blackcurrant juice. Bring to a boil on medium heat.
Pour the sauce in a blender for 1 minute, then return to pan, and bring to a boil again.
Pour on top of the solid panna cotta, and refrigerate until serving time.
To serve, garnish with fresh raspberries.
Brown chicken and onion, add garam masala and seasoning 2.
1/2 pt water boil, cover simmer 40 minstill cooked 3.add cream,remove bay leaf and cardamon, decorate with almonds and onions.
Preheat oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
In a medium bowl, combine milk and baking powder, mix until well dissolved.
With an electric mixer, beat butter and sugar until pale and creamy.
Add the flour, oats, raisins, nuts and milk mixture.
Mix until everything is well incorporated.
Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1 cm.
With a round cookie cutter of 5 cms diameter, cut circles of dough.
Arrange them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for about 15 minutes until golden.
HEAT oven to 350°F. Combine cereal and peanuts in large bowl.
HEAT butter, peanut butter and cinnamon in small saucepan over low heat until butter and peanut butter are melted. Stir until blended.
POUR slowly over cereal mixture, mixing well. Spread in 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
BAKE 10 to 12 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cool before serving.
Put the yogurt into a saucepan and whisk, add in the egg yolk and water, whisk again.
Place on stove and heat on medium heat (do not let it boil) add in the rice and stir.
Leave on medium heat until rice is cooked, 10 minutes or more depending on rice.
After the rice is cooked take of heat.
In a small saucepan or frypan melt the butter, add the tomato paste and stir well.
Once they have combined pour on top of the soup.

recipes.t: Giant Financier With Blueberries And Almonds
d: Preheat oven to 170 degrees Celsius (340 degrees Farenheit)
In a small saucepan melt the butter over low heat until it has a slight smell of hazelnuts and takes a little amber color.
Pass through a fine sieve, set it aside.
In a small salad bowl, mix together the flour, sugar and almond powder.
Whisk the egg whites with a fork, and add them to the flour mixture.
Gradually add the melted butter, mix well.
Pour half the mixture into a 20x20 cm square pan greased and lined with parchment paper.
Sprinkle with frozen blueberries, and add the rest of the batter.
Sprinkle with slivered almonds.
Bake for about 30 minutes until lightly browned.
Let it cool before cutting.
Sprinkle with confectioner's sugar.

First we need to prepare the sugar syrup.Dissolve sugar well with water and heat in medium flame.Once it dissolved add 1 teaspoon milk and you will see dirt accumulating in the top.Remove that and continue heating for 5-7 minutes.Add cardamom and essence.The sugar syrup needs to be warm but not hot until we soak jamuns.
Take milk powder and all purpose flour in a bowl.Add baking powder,salt and ghee to it.Mix well.
Next add the curd and knead to a very soft pliable dough.If needed just sprinkle some water here and there and knead to really soft dough.
Next add the curd and knead to a very soft pliable dough.If needed just sprinkle some water here and there and knead to really soft dough.

Heat oil in a kadai,keep the flame low.Once the oil is hot fry the rolled gulab jamuns in hot oil until they are dark brown. Remove from oil and drop in the prepared sugar syrup.Repeat the same in batches.
Allow the jamuns to soak until the sugar syrup reaches room temperature.
Serve or refrigerate.
Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsuis.
Heat the milk and butter in the microwave.
In a bowl, mix the egg and egg yolk with the buckwheat flour. Pour in the milk and butter mixture. Mix well to avoid lumps.
Remove the skin from the chorizo and cut it into small cubes. Add it to the batter along with the grated cheese. Add salt and a few pinches of Espelette pepper.
Fill a mini fluted mold pan's cups 2/3 full with the batter.
Bake for 20 minutes. Let cool before unmolding.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a large baking tray with parchment paper.
Combine ground chicken, parsley, 1 egg and flour. Season. Divide into 16 balls then stuff each with 1 piece mozzarella.

On a floured work surface, roll out each portion of puff pastry into a 9 1/2 inch square. Cut each rolled portion into quarters (you should have 16 squares). Wrap each meatball in puff pastry. Whisk remaining egg then brush over parcels. Transfer to prepared pan and bake for 15-20 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Serve with chili sauce.
Combine salad ingredients and toss. Combine dressing ingredients and shake well. Pour over salad and toss just before serving.
Chefs Notes: Feta cheese is low in fat and black olives contain the "good" type of fat.

recipes.t: Warm Gingered Chicken Salad With Crispy Greens
d: In small bowl, combine Hellmann's(R) or Best Foods(R) Light Mayonnaise, vinegar, soy sauce, honey, ginger and salt. Reserve 1/4 cup mayonnaise mixture for grilling. Stir orange juice into remaining mayonnaise mixture; reserve for greens.
Grill or broil chicken, brushing with reserved 1/4 cup mayonnaise mixture, 12 minutes or until chicken is thoroughly cooked, turning once.
In large bowl, toss lettuce and watercress with reserved orange juice mixture. To serve, arrange sliced chicken over greens, then top with snow peas and oranges.
Preheat the oven to 160 degrees Celsius (320 degrees Fahrenheit).
Combine the egg whites with the melted butter. Add the sugar, shredded coconut, and flour and mix well.
Place paper cups in a muffin pan. Fill the cups 2/3 full with the batter then place a square of chocolate in the center.
Bake for 12 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring the cupcakes to a wire rack to cool completely.
Preheat the oven to 220C.
Beat the egg yolks with the powdered sugar until light and foamy.
Sift the flour with the cocoa and a pinch of salt.
Add the flour mixture to the beaten egg yolks.
Beat the egg whites to soft peaks and fold them carefully into the batter.
Line a rectangular baking sheet measuring 22 x 30 centimeters with wax paper and pour the batter inside.
Bake for approximately 10 minutes.
Remove the cake from the oven, let it cool slightly, then roll up the cake in the wax paper.
Cool completely.
Unroll the cake and spread with a generous amount of Nutella, then roll it up again.
Refrigerate the cake roll.
Serve the cake sprinkled with powdered sugar and cut into slices.

Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil, in 12-inch nonstick skillet, over medium-high heat and cook onion and red pepper, stirring occasionally, 4 minutes or until tender. Reduce heat to medium, then stir in 1-1/2 cups Pasta Sauce. Simmer, stirring occasionally, 5 minutes or until sauce is thickened.

Heat remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil in same skillet, over medium heat and cook quesadillas, two at a time, turning once, 4 minutes or until golden brown and cheese is melted. Cut quesadillas into wedges and serve with remaining Pasta Sauce, heated.
Evenly spread sauce mixture on tortillas, leaving a 1-inch border. Top with cheese and fold in half; set aside. Clean skillet.
Wash barley thoroughly. Drain.
Heat little olive oil in the pot and add barley. Heat for 2-3 minutes while stirring it.

Add hot water ( or preferably pre-cooked broth). Stir once and let cook on the low heat for 40 minutes without stirring the barley again. Do keep an eye on that the water would not disappear completely... if so, just add little extra boiled and hot water.
While the barley is cooking cut your veggies and sausage. Fry them in little olive oil till soft. I normally start with potato, carrots, then onion and last the sausage.
Add the fried ingredients to the barley, add little butter if you like, spices and mix well.
Garnish with your favorite greens. Buon Appetito!!!
Light grill - place foil on rack.
Marinate liver in lemon juice, cumin, salt and garlic pepper while charcoal is getting hot.
Place liver on grill, brown on both sides.
Then place tomatoes, bell peppers, onions on top of meat and cover with foil, cook until done, approximately 10 minutes.
Serve with Spanish rice.
In a large pitcher combine the ginger beer, vermouth, lime juice and ice cubes. Sweeten with simple syrup, to taste, if desired.
For simple syrup, in a small saucepan combine 1 cup water and 1 cup sugar. Cook and stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves. Chill until ready to use. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.t: Peppered Pork Roast With Cherry Salsa
d: Heat oven to 350 degrees F. Rub pepper and garlic salt onto all surfaces of roast; place in a shallow pan and roast for 45-60 minutes (20 minutes per pound, until internal temperature reads 145 degrees F. Let roast rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Meanwhile make the cherry salsa, combine onion, green pepper, jalapeno, dried cherries, jam, vinegar and cilantro; mix well. (Can be made ahead up to one day; cover and refrigerate).
Arrange sliced pork on a serving platter; dress with Cherry Salsa.

recipes.t: Coconut Israeli Couscous Studded With Pomegranate
d: Smash the cardamom pods open with the flat side of your knife (that's right, like a garlic clove).
Combine the milk, coconut milk, and cardamom in a saucepan and place over low heat. Bring to just below a boil, stirring every once in awhile. It will be a little foamy.
Strain the cardamom pods out since the shells are not so good to eat.
Add the couscous and simmer on low for 10-12 minutes, until all the liquid absorbs. The couscous should be tender but still with some chew to it.
Add olive oil to a deep saute pan over medium-high heat.
Add onion and cook until soft.
Add the rice and when it starts to brown, add the broth and salsa.
Simmer, covered, for about 20 minutes. You may need to add more liquid.
Melt shortening in large skillet. Add rice and brown. When rice is a golden brown, reduce heat and add onion, bell pepper, tomatoes, garlic and pepper.
Mix well and add 1 1/2 cups warm water or enough to just cover the rice.
Add salt. Cover and let simmer until almost dry. Add remaining water, cold, a little at a time, cooking over low heat until fluffy.
Rinse the chicken livers under cold water until clear and place them in a bowl. Add the mustard, fish sauce, peppercorns, tamari and salt and pepper.

Heat the olive oil in a saute pan over medium heat. One at a time add the chicken livers and cook until crisp, about one minute per side. When the livers are browned and medium rare, remove from the pan and set aside. In the same pan, add the butter and onions. Cook until burnt and put the livers back in the pan. Deglaze with port wine and more butter. Place livers over spinach leaves and pour the port wine reduction over to wilt spinach.
Preheat oven to 400 degrees
Toss vegetable florets in 1 Tbs. Olive Oil, salt, fresh cracked pepper, and celery seed
Place on a sheet pan in a single layer, into preheated oven
(While vegetable florets are roasting, prep your shallots and garlic)
Set timer for about 12 minutes, turn over roasted vegetable florets
Back in the oven for another 12 minutes, set your timer!
Remove roasted veggies from oven, and set aside
Sweat chopped Shallots and Garlic in 1 Tbs. Olive Oil and 1/2 Tbs. Unsalted Butter in a heavy bottomed pot, medium heat
Cook until soft about 5 minutes. DO NOT BROWN! Add Roasted Veggies to the pot
Add Chicken Broth and Water to the Shallot, Garlic, Veggies and bring to a boil
Boil, then turn down to a simmer. Simmer for 5-7 minutes
Puree in a blender, taste. You will find this to be so tasty, you won't need any additional seasoning.
Whisk icing ingredients until smooth
Mix dry ingredients well
Add applesauce, mix well
Add veg oil, milk, vanilla stir until wet (don't over mix)
Microwave - 45 sec, top with icing
Wash and soak the dhal, rice and red chili together at least 2 to 3 hours before grinding.
Grained coarsely without adding more water along with Saunf.
Add onion, green chili, ginger, chopped coriander and curry leaves along with salt and chopped coconut pieces into the batter then mix well and leave for 20 minutes.
Heat in a Tawa and add batter spread it on round shape and make 4 holes into the Adai and pour 1tsp of oil in each whole cook well on slow flame to both sides.
Then serve hot with Avial or Jaggery.
Melt Country Crock(R) Spread in 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat and cook rice, stirring frequently, 2 minutes or until rice is golden. Stir in Simple Sofrito and cook 1 minute.
Stir in water and Knorr(R) Chicken flavor Bouillon. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer covered 15 minutes.
Stir in green peas and carrots and cook an additional 10 minutes or until rice is tender. Stir in chicken and olives and cook, stirring occasionally, 2 minutes or until heated through.

recipes.t: Oatmeal Pancakes With Cherry And Ginger
d: In a food processor, grind oats to flour.
In a bowl, mix whole wheat flour, oats, sugar, salt and baking powder.
Mix well.
Add whisked egg, milk and melted butter.
Heat a frying pan or crepe maker.
Add 1 teaspoon oil and spread over pan with paper towel.
Pour batter into hot pan and cook until it bubbles form on the top side.
Turn and cook the other side.
Stack Spread top of each cooked pancakes with cherry ginger compote and stack on serving plate.
Place a plain pancake on top of stack.
Drizzle with maple syrup before serving.

recipes.t: Panini With Ham And Onion Compote
d: Cut the bread in half.
Butter them.
Put half a slice of ham and 2-3 tablespoons of onion compote on top.
Close the panini.
Place it on the grill. Cook until bread is crisp and fillings are warmed.

Cook the spaghetti al dente (firm but not hard), in a large pot of boiling salted water according to package directions. Meanwhile, fry the bacon and onion over medium-low heat in a large, straight sided skillet until the bacon is chewy and the onion has softened. Turn the heat off.

In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the yolks, cream and grated cheese, and plenty of black pepper. When the spaghetti is ready drain and toss it into the skillet with the bacon and onion. Quickly pour the egg mixture over the spaghetti and toss everything together well to combine. The residual heat from the bacon, onions and spaghetti will be enough to cook the eggs and make a creamy sauce. Direct heat from the stove top will make an overcooked, scrambled egg, lumpy mess.

recipes.t: Filet Mignon With Camembert And Cider Sauce
d: Slice the meat.
Heat butter in a dutch oven.
Add the minced shallots.
Add the meat and brown.
When everything is nicely browned, add the cider and mix gently.
Remove the cheese rind and cut into pieces.
Place the Camembert in the dutch oven and let it melt.
Season with salt and pepper (not too much salt because the cheese is already salty).
Before serving, add the cream, and mix gently.

recipes.t: Chicken, Apple And Candied Pecan Salad
d: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line a baking pan with parchment paper.
Toss pecans and maple syrup in a small bowl. Spread on prepared pan. Bake 8-10 mins until golden and sticky. Cool.
Toss chicken, endive, arugula, apple and blue cheese in a large bowl. Transfer to a platter. Sprinkle with pecans.
Whisk oil and vinegar in a small bowl. Season. Drizzle over salad just before serving.

In 12-inch skillet, brown ground beef with onion and garlic over medium-high heat; drain. Stir in remaining ingredients. Simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, 20 minutes. Serve, if desired, with shredded cheddar cheese.
In a nonstick frypan, heat vegetable oil over medium-high heat. Add pork and stir-fry quickly. Remove pork from pan and place in a large bowl.
Combine soy sauce, sherry and sesame oil. Pour half over pork strips and toss well. Toss pasta together with green onion, green pepper and almonds.
Arrange pasta mixture on spinach leaves, top with pork and serve remaining soy sauce mixture on side.

Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook onion about 3 minutes or until onion is tender, stirring occasionally. Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Add chicken and cook about 4 minutes, stirring frequently to break up pieces. Stir in tomatoes and next 5 ingredients and cook about 7 minutes or until chicken is thoroughly cooked, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat; let cool.

Roll dough into 5-inch circles on a very lightly floured surface. Spoon 2 tablespoons of chicken mixture into centers. Evenly sprinkle with cheese. Fold each in half, pressing out air bubbles. Moisten edges with water and seal tightly with a fork.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep medium skillet. Cook empanadas, a few at a time, about 3 minutes or until golden brown, turning once; drain on paper towels.

Cut the veggies up a bit: quarter the tomatoes, celery stalks in 1/2 or 1/3, large dice the red onion, red pepper seeds removed cut into large strips. You can leave the basil (leaves removed) and garlic whole.
Place all the veggies into a food processor along with a bit of salt and pepper. Puree until smooth.
Place into a large saute pan over medium low heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Once its simmered I used an immersion blender to smooth it out a little more.
Stir in the chicken and simmer another 10 minutes or so. Toss in al dente cooked linguini with the sauce. Finish off with more fresh chiffonade basil.

Start by rinsing off all produce. Next, place cranberries and coarsely chopped peppers (seeds too, unless you want milder salsa) in blender or food processor. Pulse and stir a few times until well chooped and no large chunks remain
Next chop peeled oranges, tomatoes, and onions into bite sized pieces. You want them to be small enough to fit comfortably on a chip but not minced.
Combine all ingredients in a large sauce pan and cook on meduim~low heat for about 20-30 minutes or until the veggies/fruit are tender.
Remove from heat and place salsa in a large serving bowl, cover and chill for about two hours. Serve it up and enjoy!
In a sauteing pan,brown the onion cut in two halves until almost brown.
Rince the meat under hot water.
In a large pot, boil water, add the meat and cook.
Remove the foam on the surface, then add the onion, peppercorns, bay leaves, and salt.
Cover and simmer over medium heat for at least 3 hours.
Add the vegetables and the bones with marrow and cook for at least another 30 minutes.
Thaw spinach in the microwave.
In a sauteing pan, heat the butter, add the shallot and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the spinach, creme fraiche, and salt and pepper. Saute for 5 minutes, then mix to obtain a creamy mixture.
In a bowl, mix heavy cream with chives and salt.
Grate some horseradish over the applesauce and mix.
Peel potatoes and grate them coarsely.
Heat butter in a frying pan and saute the potatoes stirring frequently.
Serve with slices of toast to eat the bone marrow.

recipes.t: Candied Tomato, Olive, And Pine Nut Cookies
d: Preheat oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
Cut the olives and the candied tomatoes into small cubes.
In mixer bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, butter, mascarpone, salt, and pepper.
Add the egg, tomatoes, olives, and pine nuts.
Gently mix, and take small bits of dough (about 10 grams each), shape them into balls, and flatten slightly with the back of a spoon on a baking sheet.
Bake for 15 minutes.

Heat oil in a medium saucepot over medium heat and cook onion about 4 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally. Add poblano peppers and red pepper and cook about 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add garlic and cook about 30 seconds. Add corn, water and Knorr(R) Reduced Sodium Chicken flavor Bouillon. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered about 10 minutes.
Process soup in a blender or food processor, in batches, until smooth. Return to saucepot. Add chicken and heat through. Serve hot and garnish with reserved red pepper and sour cream.
Quarter the caps. Place them on a broiler pan pre-coated with a little olive oil, bottoms up. Cover the mushrooms with chopped garlic, salt and pepper.
Drizzle half the olive oil over the mushrooms. Put under the broiler for about five minutes. Remove the mushrooms and probe with the fork for softness.
Sprinkle with oregano and parsley and return to oven, this time for another five minutes, checking every two minutes for the perfect tenderness. They should be soft on both tops and bottoms.
Serve hot as a main course with a vegetable-rice mixture.

In deep 12-inch skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat and cook onion and garlic, stirring occasionally, 2 minutes or until onion is tender. Add remaining 1 tablespoon oil and uncooked rice and cook, stirring frequently, until rice is golden, about 8 minutes. Stir in Knorr(R) Shrimp flavor Bouillon Cubes blended with boiling water. Simmer covered over low heat 15 minutes. Stir in shrimp, clams, chilies and cilantro. Simmer covered 15 minutes or until rice is tender, shrimp turn pink and shells open. Discard any unopened shells.
Heat a small non-stick pan on high until very hot.
Turn heat to medium and add the chopped pecans.
Using a wooden spoon, stir continuously for approximately 1 minute.
Add 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon sugar and continue to stir constantly for 1-2 more minutes being careful not to burn the nuts.
Remove nuts from heat and set aside.
Add chick peas, pumpkin, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt to the bowl of a food processor.
Begin processing on low speed.
While processing, slowly add the sunflower oil.
Process on high speed until smooth and creamy and no chunks remain. You may have to stop to scrape down the sides and continue processing.
Once the hummus has a smooth consistency, transfer to serving bowl and garnish with toasted pecans and additional cinnamon sugar.
WHISK preserves in small bowl until smooth. Add sour cream and cinnamon. Whisk until blended.
ARRANGE fruit slices on platter. Serve with dip.
Heat oil in a pan add mustard seeds, when crackles add the urad dal and curry leaves.
Add the onions and green chili, saute till onions turns pink.
Now add the tomatoes and fry for few minutes, add turmeric, chili powder, salt and enough water.
Bring this mixture to boil.
Take a small bowl make a smooth paste out of besan flour and water.
Add this besan paste to the boiling mixture, mix well and simmer until the besan is cooked and the chutney thickness.
Serve hot with Chapati.
Mix together first 3 ingredients and press in ungreased 9 x 13 glass pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes; cool.
Mix together next 3 ingredients and spread on cool crust.
Beat together puddings and milk and spread on creamy layer.
Cover top with more Cool Whip and sprinkle Heath bar bits on top of Cool Whip.
Refrigerate.
Prepare Grill for medium indirect heat in two zones. Slice onions into disks and Drizzle with oil and salt and pepper.
In the aluminum pan, combine beer, mustard, garlic powder, celery salt, caraway seeds, hot pepper flakes, and hot sauce. Place on indirect side of grill.

Grill onions on direct heat side of grill until you have dark grill marks and onions have softened. Using tongs, separate onions into rings into the beer mixture. Grill brats over direct heat until outsides turn brown and are about 1/2 way cooked. Place brats over the onions in the pan, close lid, and let them steam until they are fully cooked, about a Half Hour
Serve on the sub rolls with plenty of onions.
Combine cooked noodles with butter.
Add remaining ingredients.
Pour into greased 13x9 baking pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until brown on top.

Prepare a grill to medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate. Season pork with salt and pepper and grill until internal temperature reaches 145 degrees F, about 4 minutes per side. Remove chops from grill and let rest 3 minutes.

Thinly slice pork. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Place a wrap in the skillet and cook until warm and softened, about 30 seconds per side. Transfer to a work surface and spread 3 tablespoons barbecue sauce over wrap. Top with 1/4 of the pork, arranging it in a line across the wrap, stopping about 2 inches short of one edge. Top with 1/4 of the onion, 1/4 of the pineapple, and 1/4 of the cheese. Fold one side of the tortilla up and over the fillings, tucking the fillings in tightly, then fold in the 2-inch edge. Continue rolling the tortilla toward the other side, securing it with a toothpick if necessary.
Repeat with the remaining tortillas.

recipes.t: Completo Hot Dog -- Best Dog Of Life
d: Cook the Frankfurters in boiling water for a couple minutes.
In the meantime prepare buns and toppings; cut buns in half and spread mayonnaise, place the frankfurters/hot dogs in each bun and top with diced tomatoes and mashed avocado.
Add salt to taste and mayonnaise.
Serve immediately.
Place the sugar and water in the Thermomix cup and set for 10 minutes/speed 1/varoma.
After complete, add the grated coconut and coconut milk and set for 8 minutes/speed 4/194°F and add the eggs through the opening after Thermamix starts running.
Remove the mixture from the Thermomix and spread on a baking sheet. Cool.
Once cool, sprinkle with brown sugar and carmalize using a hand torch.

recipes.t: Low Fat Orange And Walnuts Flapjacks
d: Preheat oven, not in a high temperature as you need low and slow baking due to the honey and the orange juice.

Put the oats in a baking tray and make sure they fully cover the tray. Crush the walnuts and sprinkle them across the oats. Do the same with half of the zest from the orange. Mix them with a spoon a little bit.
In a bowl or an electric mixer, put the bananas, the cinnamon, the honey and the other half of the zest and mix them until smooth (about 30-45 secs).

Pour down the mix from step 3 into the tray and mix it until all the oats have some of the mix on them, and you do not see any of the oats uncovered or just loose on the tray. It must become a nice soft mixture all together.
Distribute the mixture evenly on the tray and bake for 30 mins. After that leave it for 5 minutes to cool down, cut them in fair large pieces (around 25) and enjoy.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat and fry the chopped onion and carrot together for 5 minutes until the onion is softened.
Add the mince and continue to cook for 5-7 minutes until the meat has browned, stirring continuously. Pour in the wine and continue to cook for a further 3 minutes to allow the alcohol to evaporate.

Pour in the tomato passata and stir in with the tomato puree and the stock. Season with salt and pepper, turn the heat down to low and simmer, uncovered, for about 1 hour 30 minutes (give it a bit longer if it still looks too thin). Stir every 15 minutes or so. Once it's ready, set aside.
Cook the pasta in a large saucepan of salted boiling water until al dente. Drain and tip back into the same pan.

Put the pasta back on a low heat and pour in the sauce. Add the basil and stir for a minute to allow the flavours to combine. Serve straight away - and you really don't need to put any grated cheese on top.
Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
Grease a shallow 2-quart baking dish with butter or cooking spray.
In a large bowl, combine the cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon juice, zest and 1 tablespoon of brown sugar. Stir to coat the apples thoroughly. Set aside.
In a food processor or blender, add the cookies and pulse until crumbly.
Pour the cookies into a bowl with the remaining brown sugar and butter. Using a pastry blender or your hands combine the mixture until clumps start to form, about the size of peas.
Transfer the apples to the baking dish and sprinkle the cookie mixture over top.
Place the baking dish on a baking sheet and bake until bubbling, approximately 55-60 minutes. Remove and cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serving suggestion....top with freshly whipped cream or vanilla ice cream!

recipes.t: Tomato, Basil, Mozzerella Salad With Citrus Oil
d: Combine lemon and orange zest and fresh lemon and orange juice in a small mixing bowl.
Add olive oil and orange oil and stir well.
Season with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Pour citrus dressing evenly over the tomato slices in a medium shallow dish or bowl.
Next evenly divide tomato slices onto four small plates.
Top each tomato with a large basil leaf and one slice of fresh mozzarella.
Season each plat
Pre-heat oven to 300 degrees.
Pour the uncooked oats, dry cereal and sugar into a large bowl.
Add the cinnamon, nuts and salt, mix well.
Pour oil into the measuring cup. Spread it around the cereal mix.
Pour honey into the same cup and the oil left in the cup will help get the honey out of the cup.
Add the vanilla to the bowl and toss everything together until evenly coated.
You may need to break up any clumps of honey with your fingers.
Pour everything out into a large cookie sheet with a lip. You may need to do this in more than one batch.
Bake at 300 degrees for 20 minutes, turning it with a spatula.
Mix minced garlic and wine together (You may add Worcestershire sauce and balsamic vinegar)
Marinate chicken in wine mixture for 2-4 hours. Save the marinade
Heat olive oil in fry pan.
In plastic bag, mix flour, paprika and pepper together.
One at a time, coat chicken with flour mixture and place on plate to dry.
When olive oil is hot, put chicken in pan and brown on both sides. Place browned chicken into baking dish.
Mix honey into reserved marinade. Pour over chicken. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 1 hour.

recipes.t: Chicken Nuggets With Lemon And Capers
d: Cut the chicken breasts into 1 centimeter strips.
Coat the chicken with a thin layer of cornstarch.
Season with salt and pepper.
Heat a little olive oil a wok on medium heat.
Saute the chicken for a few minutes, until lightly browned.
Remove the chicken from the wok and keep warm.
Add the lemon juice to the wok.
Reduce the lemon juice on high heat until you have a smooth sauce.
Add the capers and cook for 4 minutes; then add parsley and chicken.
Mix gently.
Preheat the oven to 210 degrees Celsius (410 degrees Fahrenheit).

Combine the flour and baking powder in a large mixing bowl. Make a well in the middle and crack the eggs into it. Whisk the mixture while gradually incorporating the olive oil. Add the cream and whisk well.
Coarsely chop the olives. Add the olives, sun-dried tomatoes, and drained tuna to the batter. Lightly salt and pepper. Add the herbs. Mix well.
Pour the mixture into a muffin pan. Place it in the oven and bake for 35-40 minutes. Remove the muffins from the oven and let them cool.

recipes.t: Black Bean, Sweet Potato, & Sauerkraut Quesadilla
d: Preheat over to 350 F. Thinly slice the sweet potato with a sharp knife or a mandoline. Bake for 10 minutes.
In a medium bowl, combine black beans, cilantro, and fresh lime juice. Mix well with clean hands.
On one tortilla, spread 1/2 of the black bean mixture.
Top with sliced sweet potatoes, sauerkraut, and shredded cheese. Place the other tortilla on top. Repeat the same process with the second set of tortillas.
Heat a large frying pan over medium heat. With coconut oil or butter, brown each side of the tortilla. Be careful when flipping sides, making sure the contents don't fall out.

recipes.t: Lemon Ginger Maple Soda...Ahhh, So Refreshing!
d: Take out your trusty juicer. Wash the ginger and cut into pieces so it will juice and not clog up your juicer, maybe it only happens to mine. Peel your lemons and cut in half. When you are ready, start juicing. Once juiced add the syrup to the mixture and stir well.
Add the mixture to your soda, stir and taste, if it's not sweet enough add more maple syrup. Keep adjusting until it's to your liking.
You can add some garden fresh basil to add another level of flavour to it! Maybe a ginger basil mojito...I think that will be my next recipe!
In a large bowl, whisk together all ingredients.
In batches, pulse mixture in a food processor until smooth and well combined.
Store in a sealed container in a dry and dark place.
To make hot chocolate, put 1/3 cup of mixture into a mug and mix with hot water or milk.
Top with marshmallows and a sprinkle of cinnamon.
Steam or boil broccoli until tender.
Drain and mash as you would potatoes, leaving small bits of broccoli.
In large skillet, saute onion and garlic in oil.
When onion begins to brown, add broccoli and stir to mix.
Add bread crumbs and cheese and stir until well blended.
Remove from heat and add egg.
Stir again to blend; add seasonings and stir again.
Place in casserole and, when ready to

In a small saucepan, heat oil over low heat. Add spice mix and raisins and cook for 3-4 mins, or until mixture is fragrant and raisins are plump. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Add lemon juice and season.
Combine carrot, zucchini, beans, chickpeas and mint in a large bowl. Add raisin dressing and toss to combine. Season then set aside.
Cut pita bread into 4 pieces then halve. Toast until lightly browned then transfer to serving plates. Sprinkle with feta and extra mint. Serve topped with salad.

recipes.t: Green Olive And Cherry Tomato Madeleines
d: Preheat the oven to 180C.
Sift together the flour with the baking powder.
Melt the butter over a double boiler and let it cool slightly.
In a bowl, beat the eggs with the parmesan cheese.
Add the sifted flour and baking powder, the warm melted butter, the oil, and a pinch of salt.
Combine the ingredients until smooth and uniform in consistency.
Last, add the green olive and cherry tomato salsa.
Place the batter in the madeleine molds and bake for approximately 15 to 20 minutes, they should be lightly golden.
Slowly melt butter and chocolate at a low temperature and cool off.
Mix eggs and sugar until sugar dissolves- add nuts, almonds, flour/starch.
Add the cooled chocolate butter to the rest.
Use a brownie pan, if you have one, and lay out some baking paper.
Fill pan with (about 1/2 inch deep) of batter.
Bake at 350° for about 25-30 minutes.
Slowly melt butter and chocolate at a low temperature and cool off.
Mix eggs and sugar until sugar dissolves- add nuts, almonds, flour/starch.
Add the cooled chocolate butter to the rest.
Use a brownie pan, if you have one, and lay out some baking paper.
Fill pan with (about 1/2 inch deep) of batter.
Bake at 350° for about 25-30 minutes.
Let it cool off for at least 45minutes!
Heat couverture (gluten free chocolate bars can also be used) in a water bath or microwave and spread it on top.
Spritz a skillet with cooking spray and saute the onion with a little salt and pepper. Stir constantly until the onion begins to brown. Remove from skillet and set aside.
Add a little bit more cooking spray to the skillet and saute the mushrooms until golden brown on high heat. Return the onions to the skillet along with the mushrooms.

Whisk the barbeque sauce, mustard, and Worcestershire sauce together. Mix into the mushrooms and onions in the skillet. Add the basil, parsley, and chile flakes. Cook for 2 minutes and remove from heat.
Slice open the rolls and remove a large section of the bread. Fill with the mushroom mixture and a slice of cheese. Broil until the cheese melts.
Serve.
Preheat oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
In a saucepan, melt the chocolate and the butter.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs so they whiten. Add the sugar, then the melted chocolate.
Mix and add water. The consistency will be a bit liquid, but don't worry.
Stir in the flour and baking powder, then the pumpkin puree, pecans, and orange peel.
Butter a pan, pour the batter in, and bake for about 1 hour.
Check if it is done with the tip of a knife. Allow to cool before turning it onto a rack.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Preheat oven to 325°.
Combine flour, sugar, cornmeal, walnuts and baking powder in large bowl; set aside.

Beat I Can't Believe It's Not Butter!(R) Spread, eggs and vanilla in small bowl with wire whisk. Add to flour mixture, stirring until mixture forms a dough. Stir in citron and cranberries. Chill 1 hour.

Knead dough on lightly floured surface. Divide in half. Shape dough into 2 flat logs, about 14 x 1-1/2-inches each on greased baking sheet, with floured hands. Bake 30 minutes or until firm. Cool 10 minutes on wire rack.

Cut logs into 1/2-inch-thick diagonal slices on cutting board. Arrange cookies cut side down on baking sheet. Bake an additional 20 minutes, turning once. Cool completely on wire rack. Store in airtight container.

Heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium-high heat. Add bacon, garlic, green onions and paprika. Cook for 3-4 mins, until bacon is crispy. Add tomato puree and chicken stock. Cover and bring to a boil. Add lima beans and cook for 1-2 mins, to warm through.
Ladle soup into bowls. Swirl in a little olive oil and sprinkle with pepper. Serve with toast.

recipes.t: Walnut And Sage Pesto Brown Butter Pasta
d: Put garlic, walnuts and parmesan into a food processor and blend until crumbly. Add sage, lemon juice and a dash of allspice. Blend until smooth. Drizzle in olive oil until smooth, then salt to taste and set aside.
Drop butter into a large, deep pan over medium high heat and swirl until melted. Cook until brown, bubbly and butter emits a slightly nutty scent, approximately 3-5 minutes.
Add pasta and toss or stir until coated. Scrape pesto into the pan with the pasta and toss to coat. Cook until heated through, approximately 2-4 minutes. Salt to taste.

Let beer stand at room temperature 45 minutes. In large bowl combine flour, Parmesan cheese, parsley, salt and garlic powder. Add oil, egg yolks and beer; beat until smooth. Fold in beaten egg whites. Pour oil into deep pan to 2 inches.
Heat to 375 degrees. Dip zucchini slices into batter. Fry 3 to 4 at a time. Turn once and fry until golden brown and crisp. Drain on paper towels. Serve warm and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bring raspberries, cranberry juice, 2 1/2 cups sugar and pectin to a boil and cook for 3 mins. Allow to cool then pour into a shallow dish and chill for 2 hours.
Combine flour, baking powder, butter, eggs, 2/3 cup sugar, 1 tbsp cold water and a pinch of salt and knead until smooth. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill for 30 mins.
Preheat oven to 325°F. Grease and flour a 15x13 inch rimmed baking tray. On a floured work surface, roll out pastry into a 15x13 inch rectangle and lay in the tray. Bake for 10 mins.

Meanwhile, combine creme fraiche, coconut and remaining sugar. Remove cake from oven and spread raspberry mixture over top. Cover with coconut cream and bake for another 35-40 mins. Let cool on a wire rack then cut into 24 squares.
Peel the potatoes, rinse them well and cut into pieces.
Remove the sausage casing and break it up into pieces.
Fill a pot with water and salt, when the water boils add the potatoes, the fennel seeds, and the pasta and cook until done.
In the meantime, chop the rosemary and set it aside.
Heat the oil in a large pan, add the sausage and brown it well.
Drain the pasta and the potatoes and add them to the sausage in the pan.
Season to taste with salt, a generous amount of freshly cracked pepper, some rosemary, and saute quickly on high heat.
Serve immediately.
Preheat your oven to 375 degrees.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Roll out the pie crust. Sprinkle lightly with cinnamon.
In a small bowl toss together the sliced peaches and the sugar.
Place the peaches in a pile in the center of the pie round. Fold the sides up slightly, pinching the dough together and leaving the center exposed.
Top the center where the peaches are exposed with the oats and diced butter. Sprinkle the entire thing with some more cinnamon.
Pop in the oven for approx 40-45 minutes until the crust is golden. Serve with a lovely side of whipped cream or ice cream! Enjoy!!
Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease and flour 18x12-inch jelly roll pan.
Combine cake mix, eggs, champagne, water and oil in large bowl.
Beat with an electric mixer at medium speed for 2 minutes. Pour into prepared pan.
Bake 18 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool completely on wire rack. Remove cake. Cut cake in half to form 2 pieces about 11x8-inches each.
Blend frosting and red food color.
Spread frosting on one cake half; top with remaining cake half.
Cut cake into 15 rectangles. Pipe frosting on tops and garnish with strawberries.
Preheat oven to 200C. Line a baking sheet with baking paper. In a food processor, pulse mint and onion to chunky paste.
Add chickpeas and sunflower seeds and blend until the mixture resembles coarse bread crumbs.
Add remaining ingredients and continue to blend to a thick paste.
Taste the mixture and adjust seasonings if necessary. Shape into 25-30 balls and place evenly apart on the baking sheet.
Lightly spray the tops with olive oil and place in the oven. After 10 minutes or when the falafels are starting to brown. Flip the falafels then bake for an extra 5 minutes or until golden.

Preheat oven to 350°F. Spray four 3 1/2-inch tart pans with oil; place on a baking sheet. Heat tortillas in a microwave on high (100%) for 15 seconds. Line prepared pans with tortillas; bake for 8-10 mins, or until lightly colored.

Increase temperature to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment. Toss sweet potato and onion with oil and seasoning mix, spread on baking sheet and bake for 20-25 mins, or until tender. Combine with seed mix and cilantro. Spoon into tortilla shells.
Preheat an broiler to high. Spoon salsa over vegetables; top with cheese. Broil for 3-4 mins, or until cheese melts. Top with yogurt and avocado. Serve at once.
Chop unpeeled tangelo; discard the core and seeds. Place in a blender and process for 30 seconds. Add raisins, chopped carrots, eggs, milk, and oil.
Process until well mixed, but not smooth.
In a bowl, combine biscuit baking mix, 1 1/2 cup sugar, and wheat germ; stir in the tangerine mixture and mix until just moistened. Fill greased muffin tins two-thirds full.

Combine 1/2 cup sugar, flour and cinnamon in a small bowl. Cut in butter until crumbly. Add chopped nuts; mix well. Sprinkle over the muffins. Bake at 400 F. oven for 15 minutes, or until light brown. Cool on wire racks.
Peel and chop the melon.

In a blender, puree the melon chunks. Add the pureed tomatoes, olive oil, soy sauce, and lemon juice. Blend for about 5 minutes to obtain a smooth soup. Check the seasonings and add salt and pepper if necessary.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
To serve, pour the soup into glasses with a skewer with mint, ham, and melon.

recipes.t: Roasted Fish With Lemon And Mustard Sauce
d: Preheat oven to 200°C (approximately 400°F).
Blanch fish in boiling, salted water.
Reserve water.
Remove fillets and place in a baking dish.
For the sauce, mix a little fish cooking water, coriander, mustard and lemon juice.
Bring to a boil.
Mix in cornstarch and stir vigorously with a whisk.
Cover fillets with sauce and sprinkle with grated cheese.
Bake in preheated oven until cheese is melted and lightly browned.
Serve with mashed potatoes, if desired.

recipes.t: The Lazy Girl'S Slow Cooker Rice Pudding
d: Soak the saffron strands in 2 teaspoons of lukewarm milk.
Mix together the milk, rice and sugar into the slow cooker.
Cook on high for one hour and then on low for about 6 hours or more.

Stir in-between to ensure the rice is not sticking to the pan or clumping but do this no more than once or twice as you are not supposed to open a slow cooker too many times during the cooking process.
The rice may seem whole and piecey but once you stir the mixture, it will break down well.
About half and hour or even an hour before removing add in the saffron, cardamom and vanilla.
Mix well.
Add in the cashews and raisins.
If it's very thick , then thin it out with some milk before serving.
Beat butter until creamy , add sugar and eggs , lemon juice and brandy. Mix flour and baking powder together and add to above mixture.
Take about 3/4 of the mixture and mix well with hand. Butter a 9" x 12 " pan. Press the dough into pan.
Add the cherries ( drained ) and a little sugar.
The rest of the dough.....mix into crumbs and sprinkle on top.
Bake at 350 degrees for 50 to 60 minutes. When done and cool , sprinkle with icing sugar.
Add garlic, cumin, cayenne, jalapeno and bell pepper to garbanzo bean mixture and mix well.
Season with salt and pepper.
Cover and chill 2 to 4 hours to allow flavors to blend.
Garnish with red pepper slices just before serving.
Heat oven to 350°
Lightly grease loaf pan, 9x5x3 or two mini muffin pans with cooking spray.
Stir together flour, cheese, baking powder, and salt in medium bowl. Add olive oil, egg and milk, stir till combined. Fold in jalapenos.
Pour into pan

Bake 30 to 45 minutes or until golden brown and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes; run knife around edges of pan to loosen. Remove from pan to wire rack. Cool 30 minutes before slicing, if you can wait that long, I didn't.
Mix together the raspberry puree, the currant jelly and sugar and bring to a boil in a small saucepan.
Blend the arrowroot with a little water, mix well to a smooth cream, stir in a little of the raspberry mixture and return to the saucepan.
Bring briefly to a boil and add the liqueur.

Cook the onions, wine and butter in a heavy bottomed pan over a low heat, uncovered, for about 40 minutes, until the onions are soft and most of the liquid has been absorbed. Distribute the onions among the 6 warmed bowls and top with simmering stock.
Place a round of bread on top of each bowl of soup, top this with the grated cheese.
Grill for 2-3 minutes until the cheese melts into a glorious, golden brown mess. Serve immediately.
In a food processor, add onion, and parsley, and minced them really well.
Add meat, spice and mix them with the onion and parsley until the meat becomes like a dough
Now shape the meat into balls, and arrange them in a baking dish.
Cut the tomato into circles and put beside meatballs.
Now peel the potato and cut into thin circles.
Heat a skillet on medium to high heat, add sunflower oil enough for shallow frying.
Fry the potato half way only, and add it to meatballs in the baking dish.
Mix tahini and water, lemon juice and spices to desired consistency, keep it thin , because it will thicken in the oven
Put it into the oven on 375f for 30 minutes, then another 10 minutes on 400F.
You can broil it too for 2 minutes or so if you like.
Serve it hot.
Whisk together the cocoa powder and yogurt in a large bowl until smooth.
Pour into a 9 x 13 pan. Spreading evenly into a thin layer.
Sprinkle the berries and almonds on top. Pressing down lightly.
Chill in the freezer for 2 or more hours. Break up into large pieces and serve!

recipes.t: Grasshopper And Turtles Mini Ice Cream Sandwiches
d: Remove cream filling from chocolate sandwich cookie
Scoop 1TB ice cream in between sandwich cookies
Roll in Sprinkles
Repeat above steps with Caramel Swirl ice cream
Roll in Pecans
Cream the butter then add the sugar and eggs.
Beat the mixture for 1 minute and add the dry ingredients.
When all the ingredients are well blended, mix in the almond extract and ricotta and thoroughly blend.
Form the dough into a ball and cover it with plastic wrap and place it in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
Soak the seaweed, drain and set aside. Sift together the cake flour, baking powder and baking soda.
Blend the eggs, sugar, salt, and honey together. Add the flour mixture to the egg mixture. Mix till all combined.
Add in melted shortening and seaweed to become the cake batter.
Spoon the batter to the greased muffin cups, 80% full and bake at 175C/350F for 20-25 minutes.
Cube tomatoe and avocado. Add oil, garlic, spices. Add lime juice. Add feta. Mix and spread over toasted baguette or crackers.
Preheat oven to 350F Cook bacon in a pan until crisp and set aside to cool Reduce heat and in the same pan cook the onions and garlic until soft but not brown 5-7 minutes. Drain on paper towels
In a large bowl or mixer (using paddle attachment on low speed) combine meat and onion mixture until just combined. Turn off mixer after each step so you don't over-handle the meat.

Add eggs one at a time then add salt and pepper and the remaining ingredients (except sauce) To test the meatloaf for flavor and seasoning make a small patty and cook on the stove. taste to see if meatloaf needs salt and/or pepper.

Form the meat into a loaf on a greased or foil lined pan. Brush the top with sauce and bake for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and brush on a second layer of sauce and bake an additional 30 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 160F. Let sit loosely covered to 10-15 minutes before cutting.
Whisk eggs in a large mixing bowl till frothy, add in sugar in 3 - 4 batches to ensure it is well incorporated.

Add vanilla essence and continue beating until the batter becomes very pale, thick and creamy. Meanwhile, heat up wok, pot or steamer until you get a gentle boil. (Do make sure the pot/steamer is large enough to fit the cake tin and has ample space for the batter to rise and steam to circulate.)
Fold in the sifted flour in thirds, alternating with the soda and ending with flour.
Pour the cake mixture into prepared baking tin or bamboo steam that is lined with greaseproof paper.
Pop it into the pot/steamer, cover and steam on high heat for about 30 minutes or when skewer insert and comes out clean.
Once done, remove the cake from tin, place it on a rack and allow to cool before cutting.

recipes.t: Cretan Chorta Salad With Apaki ( Smoked Pork )
d: Finely chop the salad greens and put in a large bowl. Add the tomato and cucumber.
Mix together. Sprinkle generously with olive oil. Add lemon juice .
Season with salt and pepper and toss together gently. Empty the salad onto a serving dish and sprinkle with crumbled feta cheese ( optional )
In 3-quart saucepot, bring water to a boil. Add cauliflower and garlic and cook covered 15 minutes or until florets are tender; drain.
In food processor or blender, process cauliflower, garlic, Hellmann's(R) or Best Foods(R) Real Mayonnaise and salt until creamy, scraping down sides as needed. Stir in basil and serve immediately.
Thoroughly clean the chicken inside and out with damp paper towels.

Put the oil in a large wok or Dutch oven, add the sugar, and heat gently until the sugar caramelizes. Stir in the soy sauce. Add the chicken and turn it in the mixture to coat thoroughly on all sides.

Add the water, garlic, onion, and chili. Cover and simmer, turning the chicken occasionally, for about 1 hour, or until cooked through. Test by piercing a thigh with the point of a sharp knife - the juices will run clear when the chicken is cooked.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. Increase the heat and reduce the sauce in the pan until thickened. Serve sauce with chicken.
Add a cup of a protein rich base: 2% Greek Yogurt, quinoa, or oatmeal
Add a half cup of a fruity middle: strawberries, peaches, bananas, or cantaloupe
Add an ounce of a nutty topping: Almonds, cashews, pistachios, or peanuts

recipes.t: Marinated Tomato Salad With Herbs (Ree Drummond)
d: Cut the tomatoes into 4 wedges, then cut the wedges in half and add to a bowl. Lop off the tops of the green onions, then slice the white and mostly light green parts really thin. Add to the tomatoes.
Add the olive oil, balsamic vinegar, brown sugar, dash of salt and pepper to a jar. Screw on the lid and shake to combine. Pour the dressing over the tomatoes and toss.
Add the herbs and gently toss to combine. Cover and refrigerate for a couple of hours before serving.
Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F. Spray a medium-sized baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.

Place the chicken breasts in the dish. Using a spoon, scoop the 1/2 cup hummus into a measuring cup to avoid contaminating the rest of the hummus from the raw chicken. Put the remaining hummus away, and spoon hummus from the measuring cup on the chicken. Spread it around until the breasts are evenly coated.
Sprinkle the minced garlic, smoked paprika, cumin, and red chili powder on top of the chicken (or whatever seasonings you choose to use). Squeeze one lemon half over each chicken breast.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the hummus has crisped. Serve immediately.

recipes.t: Grilled Panela Cheese And Bean Salad Tacos
d: Pan sear the panela cheese slices on a hot saucepan lightly sprayed with oil. Add pepper on both sides while searing.
Mix the ingredients for the bean salad. Add salt to taste.
Warm the tortillas.
Place one slice of cheese on each tortilla, then add the bean salad on top and serve.

recipes.t: Grilled Chicken With Roasted Tomato Sauce
d: Combine lemon juice, Olive Oil, vinegar, rosemary, garlic, salt and pepper in large, shallow nonaluminum baking dish. Add chicken; turn to coat. Cover and marinate in refrigerator, turning occasionally, up to 3 hours.
Remove chicken from marinade, discarding marinade. Grill or broil until chicken is thoroughly cooked.
Meanwhile, heat Sauce with lemon peel in small saucepan. Serve chicken with heated sauce.

Mix the onion, ground beef, egg, paprika, cream cheese and 2/3 of the diced peppers. Season to taste and form the mixture into 4 flat patties. Heat the oil in a nonstick pan and fry the patties over a medium heat for about 12 minutes, turning as necessary. Remove them from the pan and let them cool slightly.
Spread the lower half of the bread rolls with mayonnaise, followed by layers of lettuce, and tomatoes and a patty. Sprinkle with paprika and chives and top with the upper half of the bun.

recipes.t: Ondeh-Ondeh ( Glutinous Rice Ballfilled With Palm Sugar
d: Steam white grated coconut with 1/8 tsp salt for 10 minutes.

In a large bowl mix glutinous rice flour, tapioca flour and mashed pumpkin together, slowly add 80g pandan water into it and knead to a smooth dough. If dough is too dry add a little more pandan water into it or little more flour if it is too wet.
Pinch dough into small ball (about 10g), slightly press flat and fill with gula melaka and roll into smooth ball again.
Bring a pot of water to a boil and drop the little dough balls into it.
When they float to the surface and let it boil for another 2-3 minutes.
Remove them with a slotted spoon and shake off excess water.
Roll the cooked glutinous balls over the white grated coconut.
Served warm or at room temperature.
In a large bowl, combine lettuce, arugala, watercress and basil; set aside. Pit, peel and slice mangoes. Chop enough of the sliced mangoes to make 1/2 cup; set aside remaining sliced mangoes.

For dressing, in a blender or food processor combine the 1/2 cup chopped mango, the vinegar, oil, honey, mint and chives. Cover and blend or process until smooth. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Drizzle about half the dressing over salad greens; toss gently to coat. Arrange salad on plates. Top with remaining mango slices, remaining dressing and additional freshly ground pepper.
HEAT oven to 350°F.
STIR brownie mix, melted shortening and egg in medium mixing bowl until evenly moistened. Scoop into 1 1/2-inch balls or drop by rounded tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheet.
BAKE 10 to 11 minutes or just until set. Cool on cookie sheet 1 minute. Transfer to cooling rack. Spread frosting on cooled cookies. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts.
In a bowl, mix the the gelatin powder with the boiling water.
After it's well dissolved, add the ice water and mix again.
In the blender, add the gelatin, condensed milk, and cream. Blend well.
Pour the mixture into a plastic container and freeze for 3 to 4 hours or until solid.
Remove from freezer and beat with an electric mixer for 10 minutes.
Put back in the freezer for another 4 hours.
Before serving, remove from the freezer, and place in the refrigerator for 10 minutes.
Garnish to taste.

recipes.t: Baked Orange And Balsamic Vinegar Drumsticks
d: Preheat the oven to 230 degrees Celsius.
Heat the olive oil in a frying pan and add the chicken legs. Season with salt and pepper and let cook for about 7 minutes, until golden. To avoid splashing, cover the frying pan.
Place the frying pan in the oven, without the cover, and bake for about 15 minutes.
Turn the chicken legs after 7 minutes so the skin gets crispy on both sides.
Remove the pan from the oven, then remove the drumsticks from the pan.
Add balsamic vinegar, thyme, and orange to the pan, and cook for about 2 minutes until soft. Return the chicken to the pan and toss to coat.

recipes.t: Pan Seared Tilapia Fillets With Lemon Cilantro Sauce
d: Season the fillets with salt and pepper.
Add a little oil to a cast iron pan. Slightly brown the tilapia fillets. Remove them from the pan.
For the cilantro sauce, combine the cilantro, parsley, green onions, garlic, seafood stock, peppercorns, lemon juice and sea salt in a blender and blend it until you get a nice, smooth green sauce.
With the cast iron pan still warm, remove excess oil and add the green sauce. Let it simmer for about 2 minutes, then add the heavy cream.
Add the tilapia fillets for about 2 minutes. Serve with chives.
Put milk an gream together in a small caserole in low heat.
Combine sugar an egg yolks and add in the milk-cream.
Combine until 80-82 degrees
Add basil leaves and combine
Remove from the heat and through pests put the cream in another utensil
In a bowl put the gelatine leaves with cold watter until soften
Add the gelatine in the cream and beat it in the blender until have a light color from the basil.
Fill glasses or pots and put it in the fridge for 3-4 hours until stabilized

recipes.t: Baked Bramleys With Dates, Ginger & Salted Caramel Sauce
d: Make the sauce by placing all the ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to the boil, stirring frequently until the butter melts.

Turn the heat down to a simmer, then simmer for 10 minutes until thickened slightly. Remove from the heat and add a good pinch of sea salt, then stir. Leave to cool slightly then taste, adding more salt if needed.
Pre heat the oven to 180C/170C fan.
Cut the apples in half horizontally then use a melon baller to remove the core. Place the apple halves in an ovenproof dish, cutting a little off the bottom so that they sit nicely.
Melt the butter in a small pan then add the chopped dates and ginger. Add a spoonful of the mixture into the middle of each apple half.
Place the apples in the oven and bake for 20 minutes until the apples are soft and golden.
Serve the apples with the salted caramel sauce and a dollop of clotted cream.
Dice the onion.
In a large pan, heat a little oil and saute onion.
In a separate pan, saute sliced chicken thighs and set aside.
When onions are almost cooked, add chickpeas.
Saute for a few minutes.
Add the spinach.
Let stand for a few minutes and season with paprika and salt.
Add chicken and continue to cook briefly, about 2-3 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
Place the butternut squash, tomatoes, and garlic cloves on a baking tray lined with aluminum foil. Drizzle olive oil over them.
Wrap the whole onion in aluminum foil. Add everything to the oven to bake for 30 minutes. Check the garlic cloves after about 10 minutes and remove them first.
Once the vegetables are roasted, peel the garlic and the squash.
Add all the vegetables plus the juice in the pan into a blender along with the water and blend until fine.
Pour the blended mixture into a pot. Stir in the ras al hanout and salt to taste. Heat for about 5 to 6 minutes until hot and serve.
Cook duck in a pressure cooker, according to manufacturer's instructions.
After contents boil, reduce heat and cook for about 15 additional minutes.
If duck is not well-done, return to pressure cooker for a few more minutes.
Shred and cut the giblets - liver, heart and gizzard - into cubes.
Preheat oven to 180°C (approximately 350°F).
Strain 3 cups duck broth into a saucepan and heat over high heat.
Add bacon, 1/2 of sausage, rice and duck.
Season with salt and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and cook for 10 additional minutes.
Place rice in an ovenproof casserole dish and decoratively top with remaining sliced sausage.
Bake in preheated oven for about 20 minutes.
For crispier rice, bake for a few additional minutes.

Mix dressing, soy sauce and garlic. Add 1 tbsp sauce to meat, toss to coat, let stand 5 minutes. Heat oil in a large skillet or wok on medium high heat. Add meat and vegetables. Stir fry 4 minutes or until meat is cooked through. Add remaining sauce, simmer 2 minutes or until heated through. Serve over rice. Serves 4.
Cook rice in salted boiling water.
Chop the onion, cut the peppers into strips.
Cut the sausage into chunks and the bacon into pieces.
Heat a pan and add bacon. When they begin to brown, add onion.
Brown the onion, then add sausage and peppers.
Mix everything together and continue cooking.
Juice the orange.
Grate the chocolate.
Cut up the bananas in chunks and mash them well with a fork.
Place the mashed bananas in a mixing bowl; add the ground crackers, the walnuts, the margarine, and the orange juice; mix it well. Get your kid's hands in there, if you can.
At this point, you can pinch off lime-sized dough with your thumb and index finger to make a dough ball with your hands.
Dirty up the dough ball with the grated chocolate and place it inside of a decorative baking cup.
Put the banana spheres inside the fridge for 1 to 2 hours before serving.
If allergic to nuts, please omit the walnuts or pecans.
MIX chocolate spread, cream cheese, whipped topping and vanilla in small bowl until smooth. Place in decorating bag fitted with a medium to large star tip.
PIPE about 2 tablespoons filling into each end of cannoli.
This recipe will fill 6 (5-inch) or 12 (3 1/2-inch) cannoli shells. For the smaller shells, pipe about 1 tablespoon filling into each end.
Preheat oven to 350°F. Lightly grease and line a 7x11 inch baking dish with parchment paper.

Whisk eggs until frothy. Gradually add sugar and beat until thick and pale and mixture holds its shape (this can take up to 5 mins). Sift flour and cornstarch over top then gently fold in. Combine 2 tbsp boiling water and butter then fold in. Fold in hazelnuts. Transfer to prepared pan and bake for 15-20 mins, until cake springs back when touched lightly. Turn out onto a wire rack to cool.

Meanwhile, to make the ganache, combine chocolate and cream in a microwave-safe bowl. Heat on HIGH (100%) for 1-2 mins, stirring twice, until combined. Let cool, whisking occasionally, until thick and spreadable.
Halve cake horizontally. Spread ganache over bottom layer then top with remaining layer. Cut into 10 pieces. Dust with cocoa powder. Serve with whipped cream.
For the rest of the recipe visit http://www.sixsistersstuff.com/2016/06/mushroom-swiss-melts.html

recipes.t: Shrimp With Garlic Toasted Bread Crumbs
d: Preheat oven to 450°. Arrange shrimp in single layer in lightly greased baking pan curling each one into a circle; set aside.

Combine bread crumbs, parsley, garlic, salt and pepper in medium bowl; toss with lemon juice and water, then spray with I Can't Believe It's Not Butter!(R) Spray Original. Evenly top shrimp with crumb mixture.
Bake 10 minutes or until shrimp turn pink and crumbs are lightly browned.
Preheat oven to 350F
In a saucepan, melt the butter.
In a bowl, whisk the sugar and egg to a pale mixture.
Add the melted butter and continue to whisk while adding the cream. Set aside.
In another bowl, mix the flour, yeast, and a pinch of salt.
Add the crushed pink pralines and mix well.
Make a well in the middle of the flour mixture and pour the butter mixture in the well.
Stir and combine the two mixtures well.
Fill the greased and floured muffin molds to 2/3 full.
Bake for 20 minutes.

recipes.t: Mom'S And My Escarole And Beans
d: Trim and clean escarole. In a stock pot, bring water and chicken broth to a boil. Add escarole and cook, covered, over medium-high heat until wilted (10-15 minutes). Cool, squeeze out excess liquid, and cut up.
In the same pot, heat the olive oil. Add the garlic and saute, making sure the garlic does not brown.
Add the escarole to the pot and simmer uncovered on medium-low heat for, according to my mother, "a while" (another 5-10 minutes).
Add the crushed red pepper and beans to the pot. Cook uncovered for another few minutes.
Serve immediately, adding salt or pepper to taste.

recipes.t: Chunky Date, Banana And Walnut Bread
d: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease and line an 8x4 inch loaf pan with parchment paper.

Beat butter, sugar, flour, baking powder, eggs and banana for 2-3 mins, until light and creamy. Add chopped nuts and dates. Transfer to prepared pan and smooth surface. Sprinkle banana chips and remaining nuts over top. Bake for 50 mins, until a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean. Let cool for 5 mins then transfer to a wire rack to cool slightly. Dust with powdered sugar.
Arrange lettuce, pears, turkey and walnuts on serving platter.
Drizzle with Wish-Bone(R) Raspberry Hazelnut Vinaigrette Dressing and serve immediately.
Cut 3 peppers into 2-inch-long strips and set aside. Process remaining peppers, cream and Knorr (R) MiniCubes in a blender just until smooth; set aside.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large oven-proof skillet over medium heat and brown chicken. Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.

In same skillet, heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat and cook onion about 4 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally. Add cream mixture. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer about 2 minutes or until slightly thickened, stirring occasionally. Return chicken to skillet, then sprinkle with pepper strips and cheese. Bake for 20 minutes or until chicken is throughly cooked.
1. In a small bowl combine garlic, parsley and mayonnaise.
2. Cover and refrigerate an hour for flavors to blend.
Melt the butter with the olive oil in a large frying pan.
Add the onion and garlic into the pan. Once the onion is halfway cooked, add the chili pepper and cook for one minute.
Add the slices of mushroom and cook for another 5 minutes. Set aside for later.
Add salt and pepper to the ground beef and make two round beef patties by hand. Place the meat on the same frying pan and completely cook both sides.
Place the string cheese on top of each beef patty and allow the cheese to melt.
Serve the meat on a plate and add the mushrooms on top of the melted cheese.

Clean the prawns and remove the black thread. I kept the tails on some of the prawns. Slit the large prawns a little. Do not go overboard. It is actually not necessary so you can conveniently ignore this step.
Now mix the cleaned prawns, soy sauce, vinegar, schewan chutney and sugar together. Let the prawns marinate for 20 to 30 minutes.
Take a pan or a wok, add the oil. You can use vegetable oil or groundnut oil, I used the latter. Heat it on a high flame.

After the pan is hot enough hit the marinated mixture to the pan. If you love spicy food or want to add a little bit of zing to the dish, add two slit green chillies just before adding the marinated prawns.
Stir fry the prawns for 2 to 3 minutes.
With a mandolin or shredder or potato peeler, shred the daikon radish and carrots. Dice the cucumber.. Finely chop the mint and parsley.
Mix all of the vegetable ingredients together in a bowl. Lightly toss with the juice of 1/2 of a FRESH orange.

Garnish with either a muffin, and/or seasonal fruit. For extra crunch, top with toasted slivered almonds or pistachios. (One could also use ramen noodles, but I like to keep the nutritional factor to 100% .)

recipes.t: Nectarine Marmalade With Orange And Ginger
d: Boil the jars and lids for 30 minutes to sterilize and then wipe dry with a clean cloth.

Place the fruit and sugar in a saucepan along with the orange juice, rind, cinnamon, and ginger. Cook on medium heat until the fruit releases its juices and the mixture begins to thicken and caramelize, after approximately 1 hour.
Carefully fill the jars with the marmalade and close tightly. Place into a large pot, and boil for 30 minutes to seal.

recipes.t: My Variation On Chao Tom (Vietnamese Sugar Cane Shrimp)
d: If using pre-packaged lemongrass sections, the following has likely been done already, in which case, skip this step). Otherwise, peel the outermost layer from each stalk of lemongrass. Wash them and cut the long stalks into approx. 6-inch section. Using a sharp knife, lightly score each stalk several times toward its middle. Lay these aside.
On a cutting board or in a food processor, finely mince purple basil. Add minced basil to a large mixing bowl.
Add ground pork, curry, and shrimp paste to bowl with basil.
Using your hands or a large spoon, mix bowl contents until uniformly blended.
Brush exposed ends with sesame oil, then grill or bake for 20-25 minutes or until meat is cooked through.

In a bowl, mix flour, baking powder, basil and oregano. Add milk, egg and 2 Tbl. oil; stir to moisten. Add tomatoes, pepperoni, olives and 1/2 the cheese; mix well. Divide batter equally among 10 oiled muffin cups (2-2 1/2"); top with remaining cheese.

Bake in 350^ oven until muffins are well browned - 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand about 5 minutes, then remove from pan. Serve warm or cool. If making ahead, let cool; store at room temperature up to 1 day.
Preheat oven to 200 degrees Celsius.
In a bowl, pour the flour, yeast, sugar, and a pinch of salt. Mix.
Add the butter, cut into small pieces.
Mix with your fingertips to obtain a paste which resembles coarse sand.
Add egg and milk gradually, mix to obtain a homogeneous dough, then add the dried fruits.
Spread the dough on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of 2 to 2.5 centimeters.
Cut your scones with a biscuit cutter, and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the scones with a little milk, and bake for 15 to 20 minutes until properly inflated and very lightly browned.
Optionally, sprinkle seeds or oatmeal on top of the scones before baking.
Preheat oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
Mix the sugar with the lemon zest.
Add the vanilla extract, almond extract, and eggs, and whisk well.
Add the butter, salt, and finally the flour.
Mix very well, and pour in a silicon mold, or a baking pan lined with parchment paper.
Smooth the surface well with a spatula, cover with almond flakes, and sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Bake for 25 minutes.
Unmold only after cake cools down.
Serve warm, or cold.
Pour the passion fruit juice, pineapple juice, rum and coconut ice cream into a shaker. Add some ice cubes and shake.
Wet the edge of a glass with some fruit juice and dip into the grated coconut.
Strain the cocktail into the prepared glass and decorated with a skewer of fresh pineapple, maraschino cherry and lemon balm or leaves.
Preheat the oven to 200°C, 180°C fan oven, Gas mark 6.
Peel the apples, remove the cores and cut the apples into very small pieces. Mix them in a bowl with the berries and honey.
Divide the fruit between the ovenproof dishes.
Mix the flour, sugar and Stork in a large bowl with a fork into a crumble.
Spread the crumble over the fruit in the bowls. Bake the crumble in a preheated oven for 20-25 minutes until golden brown. Serve warm.
Cook the broccoli
Add water, broccoli, sliced celery and sliced banana to the mixer
Mix it until it gets smooth
Decorate with seeds if you wish

recipes.t: Chicken Soup With Mushrooms And Corn
d: Bring stock, 2 cups water, sherry, ginger, garlic and sugar to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 3 mins. Add chicken, mushrooms and corn. Season. Simmer for 5 mins. Add bok choy, spring onions and chili. Simmer for 1 min.
Serve immediately with a drizzle of soy sauce and garnished with spring onions.

Boil the potatoes in a pot of water for 20-30 minutes, or until tender when pierced with a fork. Drain pot. Let potatoes cool for about 10 minutes. Cut into quarters and place in a medium bowl. Add vinegar and chicken broth. Toss gently and let sit until the potatoes have soaked up the liquid.
Once the liquid has been absorbed, add the mayonnaise, dijon mustard, chives and spinach or basil. Mix and add salt and spices to taste. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit. Line a standard 12 cup muffin tin with liners. In a large bowl, mash banana until there are no large chunks. Add milk, egg and vanilla. Stir until evenly combined.
2. Add oats, brown sugar, baking powder. Mix until evenly combined. Add blueberries and fold in to combine. Note: Mixture will be loose, it is okay.
3. Fill liners till about 2/3 full. Wipe off any spills and place in oven till edges are golden brown, about 20 minutes. Remove from muffin pan and let cool.
4. Once cool, store at room temperature or in fridge for up to 3 days.
Heat the oven to 350°F. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper or silicone baking mats. Set aside.

Combine the SunButter, 1 cup sugar, egg, baking powder, vanilla, and lemon juice in a mixing bowl and stir until well blended. Roll tablespoonfuls into balls, roll in the sugar, and place on the prepared baking sheets 2 inches apart. Bake for 11 to 12 minutes.

Let cool for 2 minutes then press a chocolate kiss into the center of each cookie, pressing down slightly. Let cool for 10 more minutes. Can be eaten warm, right away, or saved for later. Store in an airtight container.

recipes.t: Sweet Roasted Carrots And Red Potatoes With Rosemary
d: Preheat oven to 450.
Toss ingredients, excluding chives, together.
Line a cookie sheet with foil and spray with olive oil cooking spray.
